jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
jobs.excerpt: BriefCC. Talent is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist to join the accounting team of a growing company in the luxury technology and home automation industry.
jobs.description:
Brief

CC.Talent is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist to join the accounting team of a growing company in the luxury technology and home automation industry. The ideal candidate will have strong Accounts Receivable experience, advanced QuickBooks Online skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive approach to improving financial processes and workflows.

About the Client

Our client is a premier luxury technology integration company specializing in residential audio/video, lighting control, motorized window treatments, networking, and home automation solutions. They serve discerning clients who expect high-quality experiences, innovative technology, and exceptional service.

The company has a strong focus on continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and operational excellence, encouraging team members to identify better ways of working and contribute to the overall growth of the business.

Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable

  • Generate and distribute client invoices accurately and on schedule.

  • Monitor outstanding accounts and proactively manage collections.

  • Follow up professionally and consistently on overdue invoices.

  • Maintain accurate client account records and payment histories.

  • Process and correctly apply client payments.

  • Reconcile accounts receivable balances and investigate discrepancies.

  • Assist with month-end financial closing and reporting activities.

Process Improvement & Technology

  • Utilize QuickBooks Online effectively for daily accounting activities.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and visibility within accounting processes.

  • Recommend and support automation, workflow improvements, and system enhancements.

  • Investigate recurring issues and identify root causes.

  • Help implement long-term solutions rather than temporary fixes.

  • Support the adoption of new accounting technologies and best practices.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure billing accuracy.

  • Communicate professionally with clients regarding invoices, payment schedules, and account balances.

  • Escalate collection concerns and payment risks when necessary.

  • Support accounting projects and other departmental initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounting Administration, or a related role.

  • Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online is required.

  • Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes and collections.

  • Experience with invoicing, payment processing, reconciliations, and collections.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and data management skills.

  • Comfortable working with cloud-based business systems and learning new technologies.

  • Experience with D-Tools Cloud and Microsoft 365 is preferred.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information.

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams.

  • A proactive mindset with an interest in process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.

Highlights

jobs.description:
About the ClientA fast-growing, U.S.-based hospitality staffing platform connects restaurants, hotels, catering/event teams, and other operators with vetted professionals to fill shifts quickly and reliably. Operating nationwide in dozens of cities, the company supports high-volume, shift-based work with a streamlined, tech-enabled experience. The team values accuracy, speed, and exceptional service for both businesses and professionals.

Why does this role exist?This role ensures accurate, timely, and compliant payroll for a high-volume, shift-based workforce, including complex adjustments, tips, and reimbursements. As the company scales, the Payroll Specialist will streamline investigations (such as W-2 suspensions) and handle employment verification requests with precision and confidentiality. The objective is to protect data integrity, minimize payroll errors, and deliver an excellent experience to internal stakeholders and the workforce.

The Impact you’ll make

Payroll Processing Adjustments
  • Process on-cycle and off-cycle payroll adjustments with a high degree of accuracy
  • Calculate gross-to-net impacts for adjustments, ensuring correct taxes and deductions
  • Enter, validate, and reconcile changes within the payroll platform before payroll close
Tips, Reimbursements Compliance
  • Record and reconcile tips, service charges, and reimbursements within payroll
  • Apply correct taxable vs. non-taxable treatment per federal and state rules
  • Partner with Finance/Customer Success to resolve discrepancies quickly
Investigations Issue Resolution
  • Investigate and resolve W-2 suspensions and related data mismatches
  • Review exception reports, research root causes, and implement corrective actions
  • Document findings and maintain clear audit trails for all resolutions
Employment Verification Documentation
  • Process employment verification requests submitted electronically or from scanned physical mail
  • Maintain organized records, ensuring confidentiality and data protection
  • Adhere to company SOPs and compliance requirements for PII handling
Collaboration Tools
  • Communicate status, blockers, and updates via Slack with speed and clarity
  • Follow and improve payroll SOPs; suggest process and tooling enhancements
  • Coordinate cross-functionally to support smooth payroll cycles

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:
  • Hands-on experience utilizing the company’s payroll platform (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years of U.S. payroll processing experience in an hourly/high-volume or similar environment
  • Proven ability to calculate payroll adjustments, including tips and reimbursements
  • Working knowledge of W-2s, withholding, and taxable vs. non-taxable reimbursements
  • Demonstrated integrity and attention to detail when handling confidential information
  • WFH Set-Up:
    • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
    • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
    • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
    • Back-up computer and internet connection
    • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
Your Superpowers:
  • Technical: Proficiency with payroll systems and spreadsheets (e.g., data validation, lookups, reconciliations); familiarity with U.S. payroll rules and forms; strong documentation habits; comfort working in Slack
  • Analytical: Sharp problem-solving skills, root-cause analysis, and error detection
  • Operational: Organized, deadline-driven, and reliable in high-volume environments
  • Communication: Clear, professional written and verbal communication with cross-functional partners
  • Personal: High integrity, discretion with PII, and a continuous-improvement mindset
You should apply if…
  • You take pride in getting payroll right the first time and enjoy investigative work when issues arise

They act as product experts, industry experts, and the voice of the customer—playing a critical role in helping prospects and customers realize the full value of CoLab.

The team operates across three core functions:

  • Solutions Engineers (SEs): Focus on the pre-sales experience, partnering with prospective customers to evaluate CoLab and understand how it fits into their workflows and engineering challenges.
  • Customer Solutions Engineers (CSEs): Work with existing customers to drive complex deployments and transform how teams collaborate. They help organizations adopt new ways of working enabled by CoLab to achieve ambitious outcomes.
  • Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineers (MFDEs): Partner closely with specific customers to design and build tailored solutions for unique or high-impact problems, working alongside dedicated software engineering resources at CoLab.

While this role is focused on the Customer Solutions Engineer function, the strongest candidates bring a skill set that can flex across all three areas. Solutions Engineers at CoLab are not siloed—they are adaptable, customer-centric, and capable of contributing wherever they can drive the most impact.

All three functions regularly:

  • Prepare and deliver engaging, specific demos that showcase how CoLab addresses customer pain points and delivers unique value.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to solve challenging customer problems across diverse mechanical design and engineering use cases.
  • Understand a customer’s current-state workflows, pain points, and how they map to business outcomes.
  • Map how customers work today to CoLabs capabilities, and challenge them on new ways of working with what CoLab unlocks.
  • Be a trusted advisor to customers and prospects, on what is possible with AI in the context of mechanical engineering today, and in the future.
  • Partner with Product Managers on new product initiatives to incorporate the perspective of a mechanical engineer in what we’re building.
  • Share customer insights with Product to ensure we’re always building what our customers need.
  • Act as an instructor to cross functional teams at CoLab for engineering topics. Example: “What is Injection Molding, what is DFM in this context.”
  • Work with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve go-to-market strategy and enhance the customer experience.

Aerospace & Defense Focus

CoLab is quickly growing its customer base within Aerospace and defense. This roll will work across all types of customers in the short term, with a shift towards prioritizing A&D customers in the medium term (6months).

What You Specialize in as a CSE.

CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't a rollout—it's a change in how an engineering organization works. In aerospace and defense, that change runs into decades-long programs, rigorous configuration control, and processes that exist for good reason. As a Customer Solutions Engineer, you specialize in making new ways of working stick inside that environment, and in proving the value at each step so it spreads.

You will specialize in:

  • Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.
  • Leading change management across engineering teams, turning an initial deployment into a durable way of working, not a pilot that fades.
  • Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't.
  • Clearly articulating business value, ROI, and impact to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.
  • Applying aerospace and defense domain expertise—configuration management, program review gates, supplier and prime dynamics, and the realities of working in export-controlled environments.

What you’ll need:

  • Brings broad industry exposure—whether in automotive, aerospace, heavy equipment, medical devices, or another complex mechanical space.
  • Equally comfortable in front of a whiteboard or a C-level boardroom—able to translate engineering problems into business outcomes.
  • Able to work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, and CS teams.
  • Strong communicator, adept at tailoring technical discussions to different audiences.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple strategic and tactical initiatives in parallel.
  • Industry Domain expert - you have deep knowledge and experience with knowledge of CAD/PLM tools
  • Ability to comprehend use cases and demonstrate industry domain expertise to establish credibility with customers.
  • Ability to break down complex topics into easy to digest information

Who you are:

  • A mechanical engineer by background, with real-world experience in product development, engineering processes, and design in an Aerospace and Defense Environment.
  • Experience with change management, and rolling out new tools/processes in an engineering environment.
  • One team, one mission - you are a team player with an ownership mindset and no ego.
  • Relationship builder - you are able to build trust and strong relationships with customers and internal CoLab stakeholders.
  • Broadcaster - you have excellent communication and presentation skills, with a strong ability to convey your message.
  • Achiever - you are able to make your own content, deliver demos, and autonomously strive to hit tough timelines
  • Bonus points if you have been a solutions engineer or worked in customer success before.

The extra details:

  • Compensation: This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes an executive stock options package.
  • Benefits:
    • Canada: This role offers an extended health and benefits package that includes unlimited paid vacation and RRSP matching.
    • USA: This role offers health and dental insurance (covered at 100% for the employee) and unlimited PTO.
    • Remote/Hybrid Work: Our main office location is in St. John’s, NL where we offer hybrid and remote opportunities. This role has the flexibility to work from anywhere within Canada or the USA.

Travel Expectations

While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are three primary types of travel you can expect:

  • Team Weeks: Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John’s, Newfoundland, and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.
  • On-sites: For most of our large deployment customers, we will visit on-site during kick-off and key expansion opportunities. Most on-sites involve 1-2 days with the customer, with travel on either side. Travel is primarily within North America, and you can expect roughly one trip per month on average.
  • Conferences: Solutions Engineers play a key role at industry events and conferences. These trips typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning later that week. Conference attendance is shared across the team, and you can expect to attend one per year.

We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

jobs.description:
Description

About the Role

﻿Zenity's partner ecosystem is growing fast, and this role owns the opportunity to build our partner marketing function, working alongside the Alliances team that's already generating momentum and relationships ready to be turned into real programs.

You'll own & build partner marketing end to end: channel programs with VARs, co-marketing with hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft, and others as they come into focus), and increasingly, marketing around technical integrations that deserve a real go-to-market story. You'll work closely with the Alliances team and coordinate with Product Marketing to translate integrations into a clear "why does a customer care."

This is a build-and-run seat. You'll take input from a team full of ideas and relationships, turn it into a program with a real plan behind it, run it yourself, and bring in others only when it actually calls for it.

About Zenity

Zenity is the leader in AI Agent Security and the first company to bring an agent-centric security platform to market. As enterprises accelerate AI agent adoption, we are establishing the security framework for how AI agents are secured and governed at enterprise scale. We deliver full-lifecycle visibility, governance, detection, prevention, and response for AI agents from build time to runtime, across SaaS, home-grown platforms, and end-user devices.

Backed by $180M+ in total funding, including a $125M Series C led by Norwest, with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Microsoft's M12, Zenity is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises worldwide.

Join us in shaping how AI agents are secured at enterprise scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and run channel marketing programs with VAR/solution provider partners (education, enablement, co-selling — the "to, through, and with" spectrum, not just distribution)
  • Own co-marketing programs with hyperscaler partners (AWS, Microsoft, and others as relationships develop)
  • Design account-based partner campaigns, not one-off events — think multi-touch programs (enablement → account mapping → joint customer marketing → in-person activation), not a single lunch-and-learn
  • Work cross-functionally with Alliances and Product Marketing to give technical integrations real go-to-market support
  • Build creative, high-leverage co-marketing programs that work at startup scale, not just plays borrowed from bigger, better-funded competitors
  • Represent partner marketing needs directly with partner counterparts at AWS, Microsoft, and VAR/SI accounts, with autonomy to manage those relationships

Requirements

  • 6+ years in partner or channel marketing, ideally with at least one hyperscaler relationship under your belt (AWS or Microsoft preferred; if you've worked with one, you understand the game)
  • Real experience with VAR/solution provider partners — GSI or SI experience is a plus but secondary
  • A track record of building programs, not running checklists — you should be able to walk through a partner program you built end to end: who it was with, what the plan was, how it evolved, what it drove
  • Comfort being slightly technical — you don't need to write the integration blog yourself, but you need to understand enough to know it needs writing and who should write it
  • Startup experience strongly preferred — you'll be figuring out how to be creative with less budget than the AWS/Microsoft partner managers you're used to working with, competing for the same partner attention as much larger co-op spenders
  • Ability to operate with real autonomy — this team default is "you have their Slack and email, go build the relationship," not "run it by me first"

What Success Looks Like

  • You show up to a partner conversation with a multi-month program, not a list of activities for the quarter
  • The Alliances team hands you relationships and ideas, and you turn them into programs on your own
  • AWS/Microsoft co-marketing grows into programs with real, attributable pipeline
  • Technical integration announcements land with a full go-to-market story built around them
  • You're building relationships directly with partner counterparts and running point on them yourself

What We Look For At Zenity

  • Proven ability to build, not just maintain, systems, processes, or relationships
  • Comfort operating in evolving, fast-moving environments where the playbook is still being written
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes, not just activity
  • Experience in high-growth or venture-backed environments
  • Exposure to AI, security, or emerging technology ecosystems

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to be transparent, conversational, and focused on real-world experience.

  • Recruiter/People Team Screen (30-45 minutes) – Introductory conversation focused on your background, partner ecosystem experience, and alignment with the role.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 minutes) – Deep dive into your strategic approach, ownership mindset, and ability to drive measurable partner marketing impact.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership Interviews (2 meetings, 45 minutes each) – Conversations with key stakeholders to assess cross-functional alignment, execution capability, and influence.

Zenity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We enable enterprises to adopt AI agents securely and at scale, and that starts with building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where talented people can do their best work, securely, confidently, and with impact.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $200,000–$215,000 depending on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for equity and performance-based incentives..

Operating at the intersection of business and technology, the Senior SA leads discovery, develops solution designs, validates feasibility, and presents architectures that balance technical depth with business value.

At the senior level, this role owns complex, multi-domain pursuits and acts as a trusted advisor in high-value client engagements. The Senior SA brings deep hands-on expertise across Cisco, Juniper, HPE (Aruba), and Fortinet platforms, along with stronger architectural judgment, commercial depth, and cross-functional influence to shape solutions that improve competitiveness and delivery confidence. The role is highly client-facing, requiring strong communication skills to engage both executives and technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement and Solution Design:
  • Work alongside sales teams to understand customer business goals, challenges, and buying drivers.
  • Lead client discovery sessions to identify business challenges, technical requirements, and constraints across campus, data center, WAN, wireless, and security domains.
  • Develop network and cross-practice solution architectures that are secure, scalable, and aligned to delivery objectives.
  • Perform technical qualification and assessment of client network environments to validate solution fit and identify modernization opportunities.
  • Present solution architectures in a way that aligns technical depth with business outcomes, risk, and investment value.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to refine scope, goals, and deliverables for proposed solutions.
Technical Leadership and Advisory:
  • Serve as the senior subject matter expert (SME) for enterprise networking and network security across the company's portfolio.
  • Lead architecture and design across routing and switching, SD-WAN, SASE/SSE, enterprise wireless, data center and campus fabric, network segmentation, NAC, and next-generation firewall platforms.
  • Maintain deep, current expertise across the primary vendor stack Cisco, Juniper, HPE (Aruba), and Fortinet — including competitive positioning, licensing models, and roadmap direction.
  • Advise on adjacent domains including cloud connectivity, data center infrastructure, cybersecurity, unified communications, and endpoints where they intersect the network.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex network design decisions and resolve solution tradeoffs with limited oversight.
Proposal Development:
  • Develop cost modeling and LOE estimates, including hardware, licensing and subscription models, partner solutions, and PS/Delivery requirements.
  • Estimate required resources, costs, and timelines for proposed solutions.
  • Lead development of solution narratives, assumptions, estimates, and scope framing for larger pursuits.
  • Prepare and deliver technical pitches, proposals, and Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Support RFP responses by designing solutions, answering technical questions, and aligning delivery resources.
  • Document solution architectures and ensure consistency across proposals and implementations.
  • Support account executives in technical presentations and demonstrations.
Collaboration and Delivery Alignment
  • Partner with delivery and engineering teams to validate scope, resource requirements, and feasibility.
  • Lead internal alignment across sales, delivery, and specialty teams for complex pursuits.
  • Conduct internal handoffs to delivery, clarifying assumptions and ensuring continuity.
  • Collaborate with vendor and distribution partners on solution positioning, deal registration, and specialized pricing
Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Sharing:
  • Contribute reusable assets, reference designs, and solution blueprints to the presales function.
  • Actively mentor Solution Architects and help raise standards for discovery, design quality, and client engagement.
  • Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and best practices, sharing insights with colleagues and customers.
  • Participate in internal review meetings, debriefings, and retrospectives to improve presales processes and solution delivery.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Technical Skills:
  • In-depth understanding of enterprise networking and network security technologies, including routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), switching, VLANs/VXLAN, QoS, multicast, and network automation.
  • Demonstrated design experience across the primary vendor stack: Cisco (Catalyst, Nexus, ACI, Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Meraki, ISE), Juniper (MX/EX/QFX/SRX, Mist, Apstra), HPE Aruba (CX switching, wireless, ClearPass, EdgeConnect), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Secure SD-WAN).
  • Experience designing SD-WAN, SASE/SSE, Zero Trust network access, and segmentation architectures.
  • Strong background in enterprise IT architecture across adjacent disciplines such as cloud, storage, virtualization, cybersecurity, unified communications, and data management.
  • Proficiency designing multi-practice solutions spanning multiple technology domains.
  • Familiarity with cost modeling, licensing and subscription structures, and delivery resource planning.
  • In-depth understanding of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models, including multi-cloud and hybrid cloud connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect).
  • Familiarity with automation and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and network observability platforms.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2).
  • Experience with solution architectures for verticals such as financial services, healthcare, retail, education, and public sector.
Business and Soft Skills:
  • Strong client-facing presentation and communication skills, including with senior technical and business decision-makers.
  • Ability to align technical solutions with business challenges and value drivers.
  • Proven experience supporting presales engagements and proposal development.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and creative solution design.
  • Ability to manage multiple pursuits and priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with pipeline management and CRM tools.
  • Capable of working independently and as part of cross-functional teams.
  • Cultivates and nurtures strong relationships with key client stakeholders to foster trust.
Education and Certifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Expert-level network certification strongly preferred — Cisco CCNP/CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Security, Juniper JNCIP/JNCIE, HPE Aruba ACSP/ACMX, or Fortinet NSE 6–8 / FCSS.
  • Additional relevant certifications a plus (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, VMware VCP, TOGAF).
  • ITIL or other service management framework certifications are a plus.
Experience:
  • 8–12+ years in IT solution design, network architecture, or technical presales roles, including ownership of complex, multi-workstream pursuits.
  • Previous experience with a managed services provider (MSP), VAR, or systems integrator (SI) is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior client stakeholders and mentoring less experienced architects.

jobs.description:
Patient Coordination, Insurance Verification & PA, Ledger & EOB Support

Part-Time | Pain Management | 30 Hours/Week | $5/Hour

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Virtual Medical Assistant to become an integral part of a growing U.S. healthcare practice specializing in musculoskeletal health, pain management, personal injury, and decompression therapy.

This is a highly patient-facing role designed for someone who can confidently manage a busy front desk remotely. You will be responsible for answering patient calls, scheduling appointments, coordinating intake requirements, assisting with insurance verification and prior authorizations, and helping ensure patients are prepared before they arrive for their appointments.

The practice typically manages approximately 100 patient visits per week at normal capacity, so we are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, handling multiple responsibilities, and taking ownership without needing constant supervision.

Many patients contact the practice while experiencing significant pain, including sciatica, radiculopathy, lower back pain, and other musculoskeletal conditions. Because of this, we need someone who communicates with genuine empathy, patience, compassion, and professionalism.

What You'll Be Doing

Patient Communication & Message Management

  • Answer a high volume of inbound patient calls professionally and compassionately.

  • Assist both new and established patients with appointment scheduling and rescheduling.

  • Identify the purpose of the patient's call and help determine the appropriate next step.

  • Help accommodate patients who may need to be seen quickly due to pain or urgent concerns.

  • Respond to incoming patient messages from the practice's communication platforms.

  • Triage messages and route clinical or administrative concerns to the appropriate team member.

  • Answer general non-clinical patient questions.

Patient Intake & Appointment Preparation

  • Send online patient intake forms and confirm they are completed before appointments.

  • Identify the patient's primary complaint or condition during the intake process.

  • Ensure the appropriate condition-specific or outcome assessment forms are sent before the patient is seen.

Insurance Verification & Prior Authorization

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Review relevant insurance information before scheduled appointments.

  • Assist patients with general questions regarding their insurance coverage.

  • Process and follow up on prior authorization requests.

Patient Balances & Payment Support

  • Review patient accounts before appointments to identify copays or outstanding balances.

  • Communicate patient financial responsibility clearly and professionally.

  • Collect patient balances and payments over the phone when appropriate.

  • Help maintain accurate and current patient account information.

Ledger & EOB Support

You will also work closely with the physician on selected back-end administrative responsibilities.

This may include:

  • Reviewing Explanation of Benefits (EOBs).

  • Assisting with patient ledger reconciliation and account balancing.

  • Verifying that payments and balances are reflected correctly in patient accounts.

  • Identifying discrepancies or accounts requiring additional review.

  • Helping prepare account information for the physician to review.

  • Keeping patient ledgers current so the practice knows the correct balance when a patient arrives.

This is not a full-cycle medical billing position. The physician will continue to manage areas such as claim creation, charge entry, claim submission, and other advanced billing functions. Your role will primarily involve helping organize, review, and maintain accurate patient account information while working closely with the physician.

Training will be provided for the practice's specific ledger workflow.

Lead Follow-Up & Patient Conversion

As the practice continues to expand its marketing efforts, you may also:

  • Contact prospective patients who inquire about services.

  • Follow up with leads generated through marketing campaigns.

  • Explain available services in a professional and patient-friendly manner.

  • Help convert qualified inquiries into scheduled appointments.

  • Follow up with prospective patients who have not yet scheduled.

  • Support outreach related to services such as decompression therapy and other musculoskeletal treatment programs.

We are looking for someone who understands that communicating with a prospective patient requires a different approach from assisting an established patient. Building trust and creating a positive first impression will be important.

Required Experience

Professional Experience

  • 1 to 2 years of experience as a Medical Receptionist, Medical Scheduler, or Virtual Medical Assistant supporting a U.S. healthcare practice.

  • Hands-on experience managing patient calls and appointment scheduling.

  • Experience performing insurance eligibility and benefits verification.

  • Experience processing or assisting with prior authorizations.

  • Experience communicating directly with patients by phone.

The Ideal Candidate

We are especially interested in someone who is industrious, curious, dependable, and internally motivated to do excellent work.

You may be a strong fit if you are the type of person who:

  • Takes pride in completing work accurately.

  • Looks for what needs to be done instead of waiting to be reminded.

  • Enjoys learning new systems and becoming highly proficient in them.

  • Takes notes and uses available training resources independently.

  • Can learn through video tutorials, documentation, and hands-on experience.

  • Enjoys working in a role where responsibilities may evolve as the practice grows.

  • Can comfortably switch between patient calls, scheduling, insurance work, messages, intake tasks, and administrative responsibilities throughout the day.

  • Wants to become a trusted long-term member of a medical practice rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

Nice to Have

The following experience is helpful but not required:

  • Chiropractic practice experience.

  • Musculoskeletal or pain management experience.

  • Physical therapy or rehabilitation practice experience.

  • Personal injury healthcare experience.

  • Basic medical billing experience.

  • EOB review.

  • Patient balance collection.

  • Patient ledger or account reconciliation.

  • Lead follow-up or appointment conversion experience.

  • Experience supporting healthcare marketing campaigns.

  • Familiarity with ChiroTouch.

  • Spanish-English bilingual communication skills.

Systems & Tools

The practice primarily uses ChiroTouch Cloud for scheduling, patient intake forms, account ledgers, patient engagement, and other practice management functions.

Previous or related systems used by the practice include:

  • Practice Fusion

  • PatientPop

  • CollaborateMD

  • Kareo

  • PatLive

Previous ChiroTouch experience is helpful but is not required. The platform includes training resources and video tutorials, and the successful candidate will be expected to actively use these materials to learn the system.

About us:

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts and processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Lead, Head Office Operations Control

Department: Internal Controls

Reports to: Head, Internal Controls

Location: Remote (Lagos preferred)

About this role:

The Lead, Head Office Operations Control is a systems thinker who is responsible for leading the assessment, monitoring, and reporting on the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls across all head office operational functions and shared services of the Bank. This includes oversight of daily Core Banking GL Movements, People Operations, Real Estate & Administration, Procurement, Customer Complaints Management, Physical Security, Policy & Procedure Governance, and other non-core support functions. The role ensures that entity-level controls, physical asset governance, purchase-to-pay processes, complaint management workflows, and HR operational processes are adequately designed and operating effectively to mitigate risk, safeguard assets, and promote compliance with the Bank's policies and regulatory requirements. The Lead will manage and develop a team of Shared Service Control Officers, drive the control testing programme for head office operations, and serve as the primary liaison between the Internal Control Department and all head office support functions. The position requires a strong understanding of internal control frameworks — particularly COSO, ISO 31000, and relevant regulatory standards — with a focus on operational risk management, entity-level controls, and governance assurance.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversight & Planning:
    • Develop and lead the annual internal control activity plan for all head office operational functions and shared services, ensuring alignment with the Bank's enterprise risk management framework, COSO principles, the Internal Control Charter and Framework.
    • Identify, assess, and prioritize risks across head office operations and design appropriate control programmes to address them.
    • Serve as the primary 2LoD advisor to head office support function leaders on internal control matters, risk mitigation, and process improvement.
  • Control Assessment & Testing:
    • Design and execute risk-based control assessments to evaluate the design and operational effectiveness of controls within daily GL Movements, People Operations, Real Estate & Administration, Procurement, Customer Complaints (L1, L2, L3), Physical Security, and other shared service functions.
    • Conduct control reviews and assessments of facility, premises, property, equipment, and other physical and revenue-generating assets including POS to validate physical existence, linking their values on records (asset register) to the consolidated position on the financial statements for completeness, accuracy of valuation, depreciation, and carrying value.
    • Conduct control reviews and assessments of the purchase-to-pay process, tools, stores and inventory handling; validate accounts payable (AP) metrics and report on over-aged positions in the AP GL.
    • Review and assess HR processes including joiner-mover-leaver controls, background screening, payroll processing, benefits administration, and other people operations activities to validate process design adequacy and operational effectiveness.
    • Assess the complaint management process and tools across L1, L2, and L3; report on the effectiveness of design and operational efficiency; create linkages that feed the IT General and Application Controls team on weaknesses noted in L3 and the E-Business and Product Control team on weaknesses noted in L2.
  • Entity-Level Controls & Policy Governance:
    • Monitor and manage entity-level controls by overseeing the central policy and procedure repository of the Bank to promote availability, controlled access, regular updates, and revision to policies, standards, frameworks, SOPs, and allied playbooks.
    • Conduct periodic attestation reviews to confirm that all policies and procedures are current, approved, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
    • Ensure that the Bank's governance documentation meets regulatory expectations and supports audit readiness.
  • Physical Security & Environmental Controls:
    • Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of physical and environmental security controls including access controls, CCTV, UPS, fire suppression, and facility management procedures.
    • Conduct periodic inspections and validate remediation of identified exceptions.
  • Monitoring, Reporting & Remediation:
    • Develop and manage Key Risk Indicator (KRI) dashboards for head office operations that generate and analyse outlier reports on breaches of internal limits and potential control failures.
    • Oversee the control deficiency remediation dashboard for follow-up and closure of open findings from control assessments, internal audits, and external examinations across all head office functions.
    • Prepare and present periodic reports on the control environment of head office operations to the Head, Internal Control for the attention of Business and Function Leaders, MANCO, and FARCo.
    • Conduct post-review follow-up assessments to evaluate whether all identified open findings have been sufficiently mitigated.
  • Team Leadership & Development:

jobs.description:
Job Title: QA Lead

Reports to: Engineering Manager, SRE & QA

Location: Ireland (remote)

Purpose

We are hiring a QA Lead who starts hands-on to run our QA team day to day. You will be embedded in one pod as a Quality Engineer, the same as the rest of the team, and you will also lead that team: three Quality Engineers report to you. You are the connection between the Engineering Manager and the QA team. The Engineering Manager sets quality strategy and direction. You turn it into day-to-day practice, feed the team's reality back up, and carry the operational load of goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and reviewing your team's work. You stay hands-on and technical throughout.

Most of your quality leverage is upstream. Our pods spec features in depth and hand them to coding agents that build the feature and its tests together. Inside your pod you are the advocate, not the executor: the voice asking the awkward questions, pushing the failure modes nobody thought of, and making sure the spec and our shared testing skills are good enough that the agent produces the right tests, at the right level, catching the right things. Expect to be hands-on early while that foundation is still thin. Expect that to reduce deliberately over time as the skills sharpen and the pod's own quality thinking matures.

Key Responsibilities

  • QA Team Leadership: Lead the three Quality Engineers who report to you. Set their goals, run their performance reviews, coach them day to day, and review their work. You are the senior voice they turn to on what good looks like and what to do next, and the first escalation point when they are stuck.
  • Spec-Time Advocacy: Be in the room while the pod specs a feature, before any code exists. Ask the awkward questions, push the edge cases and failure modes nobody has thought of, and hold the line that acceptance criteria are testable and traceable. A vague spec produces vague tests, so this is where most of your quality leverage lives.
  • Agentic Test Quality: Our coding agents write most of our tests. Curate what they are told: the shared testing skills, patterns, and guardrails that decide what gets tested, at what level, and how. Verify the output is load bearing using mutation testing, rather than assuming a green suite means a covered feature.
  • Coaching & Culture: Focus on coaching over absorbing workload. Review the tests that arrive with a pull request, whether a developer or an agent wrote them, asking probing questions to ensure they prove meaningful outcomes. You raise the developers' ceiling by mentoring them on test efficacy.
  • Fold Back and Compound: A lesson that only lands in one spec is a lesson we pay for twice. When something is missed, get the reasoning back into the shared skills, gates and patterns so the next feature starts better than the last. This is what makes the role shrink rather than grow: every fold-back reduces how much intervention the next feature needs from you.
  • Hands-on When It Counts: Coach rather than cover. You still open the editor for exploratory testing, a missing test, a gnarly end-to-end flow, or awkward test data, but that is the exception rather than how you spend your week. Expect this to be heavier in your first months and lighter as the skills mature. That reduction is the point.
  • Holistic Quality: Help the team integrate performance, security, and accessibility into our quality practices. You contribute to ensuring accessibility is asserted against our live shared config.

The Person

  • Technical Lead: You are comfortable in the code and review your team's work to ensure high standards. You lead by evidence, using traces, benchmarks, and reproduction scripts to help the team make decisions.
  • Systemic Thinker: You look beyond individual bugs to identify pipeline or architectural failures. You contribute to engineering systemic solutions that prevent recurrence.
  • Evidence-Based Guide: You help the team understand success through metrics like mutation scores, flake rates, and production escapes, using this data to guide improvements.
  • Collaborative Influencer: You thrive in cross-functional pods, partnering with product managers and engineers to embed quality into the development lifecycle.
  • Proactive Partner: You champion the user perspective by questioning assumptions and identifying potential failure modes before development begins.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software testing experience in a commercial environment with 3+ years acting as a technical lead in QA teams.
  • B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent lifetime experience.
  • Formal leadership experience, including performance management of a team.
  • Experience in architectural and pipeline design to prevent systemic failures.
  • Hands-on experience building with agentic tools and workflows, focusing on prompt engineering and LLM-based testing frameworks.
  • Proficiency in performance, security, and accessibility testing.
  • Experience working with modern CI/CD platforms and DevOps best practices.
  • Proficiency in JIRA or similar project management tools.
  • Expertise with automation tools like Cypress, Stryker, Allure, PactumJS, etc.

About the Remote Licensed Therapist (1099 Contractor) role at Headspace:

Headspace is currently seeking part-time, independently licensed contractor therapists to provide direct, virtual care as part of a multidisciplinary team on a 1099 contract basis.

To get started, we strongly encourage having 10+ hours available per week with full flexibility to adjust; more is always welcome depending on your schedule! Please note that due to care demand and member scheduling fluctuations, it could take a number of weeks to achieve a consistent schedule.

The pay range for the Contract Mental Health Therapist ranges from $69-$74 per teletherapy session. Exact reimbursement rates will be determined during the interview process and are based on a number of factors including but not limited to location, licensure type, experience, specializations, languages spoken, and populations treated.

Session length is 60 minutes for an intake and 45 minutes for a follow up appointment, with concurrent note-taking expected and included in the session rate. All Headspace therapists must be licensed and reside in the US. Due to the nature of healthcare services provided to our customers, partners and members, all work must be provided in the U.S. Data, specifically personal health information may not be accessed, disclosed or used outside of the U.S. Please note that the U.S. is limited to the 50 states of the United States -- it does not include U.S. territories like Puerto Rico.

Why Work on the Headspace Network:

  • Exceptional Care, backed by Clinical Expertise: Bring your deep expertise to a platform that delivers exceptional measurement-based care. Headspaces’ comprehensive training and clinical support teams will partner with you to ensure member success, while our robust quality assurance process ensures ongoing support–enhancing your practice and providing a framework for continuous improvement in clinical outcomes.
  • World Class Content Created by a Beloved Brand:Supplement your member support with thousands of expert-led exercises, mood-boosting meditations, and stress-relieving tools for all of life’s moments. Whether your members report feeling stressed or anxious, need support navigating their caregiver journey, or experiencing grief, our content supports individual goals with tools backed by research and delivered by trained mindfulness experts.
  • Seamless Support for You and Your Members: A dedicated team at Headspace handles the operational details, allowing you to concentrate on what you do best — delivering high quality care. With intentional communication, a suite of administrative and clinical tools, and resources, we ensure providers and members feel supported every step of the way.
  • Education That Empowers Excellence: Benefit from access to a best-in-class training institute that prioritizes pragmatic, evidence-based approaches to transdiagnostic care and culturally responsive practice. Our education program promotes continuous skill development, improving your clinical expertise while expanding your knowledge and capabilities.
  • A Community of Care: Join a network of peers and Headspace experts with opportunities to collaborate, connect, and grow together while delivering on our mission to provide every person access to lifelong mental health support.

What you will do:

  • Provide high quality, innovative, tele-therapy to Headspace patients over a HIPAA compliant video conferencing platform
  • Complete, sign and lock clinical case notes in EMR within 48 hours of session as part of the per-session reimbursement rate.
  • Maintain your personalized database to record proof of licensure, license updates, expiration dates, personal information, etc.
  • Keep your availability calendar up to date
  • Work with a collaborative care team including health coaches, other therapists, psychiatrists, and external care providers

What you will bring:

  • 3+ years experience providing clinical psychotherapy to individuals, couples or families

An independent clinical license to practice in good standing (without need for clinical supervision), at the Master or Doctoral levelBC-TMH credential, if required by your state of license

  • Ability to offer at least 10 sessions per week for bookings, with the ability to flex up or down as needed
    • Night and weekend flexibility a plus
  • Clinical competence in evidence-based practices (CBT, DBT, ACT, Mindfulness, etc.) and measurement-based care
  • Experience with risk management and higher acuity cases
  • Knowledge, ability, and commitment to providing culturally responsive care
  • Familiarity, comfort and confidence with care delivery technology - various applications, tech tools, google web-apps, video conferencing, EMR, etc.
  • A safe secure location with reliable internet connection to provide Zoom-based psychotherapy
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work within interdisciplinary teams

Preferred (if applicable)

  • Licensure in multiple states
  • Licensed psychologist with willingness to apply for (or is already enrolled) with PSYPACT
  • Ability to deliver care to a variety of populations
  • Multilingual
  • Familiarity with the Headspace app and content
  • Willingness to include evening availability in your schedule to support member care flexibility

Privacy Statement

All member records are protected according to our Privacy Policy. Further, while employees and contractors of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.

Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. Such steps would be taken to protect both the former member, as well as any relevant individuals from their care team, from impairment, risk of exploitation, or harm.

Qualities & Behaviours

jobs.description:
Title: Senior FOIA Analyst
Location: Remote / Virtual
Schedule: Full-time
Salary: $73,000-$88,000, commensurate with experience

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring a Senior FOIA Analyst to support the U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid (FSA).

In this role, you will process Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), FOIA Appeals, and Privacy Act requests; apply FOIA exemptions and redactions; prepare response correspondence; maintain cases in FOIA Xpress; and provide regulatory and analytical support to FSA.

This position is a strong fit for an experienced FOIA professional who can independently handle complex requests, make sound disclosure determinations, and work accurately in a deadline-driven environment with minimal oversight.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
FOIA & Privacy Act Request Processing
  • Review, analyze, and process incoming FOIA and Privacy Act requests
  • Participate in intake activities and assess requests for appropriate processing
  • Enter FOIA requests and related correspondence accurately into FOIA Xpress and FSA tracking systems
  • Coordinate with Department program offices to obtain responsive records and address request issues
  • Communicate with requesters regarding scope, cost, identity certification, and other processing matters
  • Track cases and complete required actions within statutory, regulatory, and Department timeframes
  • Support efforts to reduce the number of pending FOIA and Privacy Act requests
  • Maintain complete and accurate case documentation throughout the request lifecycle
Disclosure Review, Redactions & Responses
  • Review responsive records and determine the appropriate treatment under FOIA and Privacy Act requirements
  • Apply redactions using expert knowledge of the nine FOIA exemptions
  • Process complex FOIA requests requiring careful analysis and disclosure determinations
  • Prepare interim and final response letters and memoranda for signature, as appropriate
  • Apply controlling case law, Department policy, regulations, procedures, and guidance to disclosure decisions
  • Coordinate with appropriate Department personnel when legal, policy, or program input is needed
FOIA Appeals
  • Process FOIA Appeals in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and procedures
  • Review case records, prior determinations, responsive documents, and exemption applications
  • Provide accurate analytical support for appeal review and resolution
  • Maintain appeal documentation and related correspondence in applicable case-management systems
  • Support timely completion of appeal actions and required follow-up
  • Identify issues requiring additional review or coordination
FOIA Xpress & Case-Management Support
  • Use FOIA Xpress to process, track, document, and report FOIA and Privacy Act activity
  • Maintain accurate request data, case actions, correspondence, and status information
  • Use FSA's internal FOIA Integrity Management System (FIMS) and other workflow tools as required
  • Quickly learn and use internally developed systems supporting FOIA processing
  • Recommend modified or new operational approaches, including improvements involving FOIA Xpress
  • Support accurate management, tracking, and reporting of FOIA workload
Regulatory Guidance & Analytical Support
  • Provide technical guidance on FOIA and Privacy Act laws, regulations, policies, procedures, and guidance
  • Analyze factual information, evaluate significant factors, and solve complex processing problems
  • Review options and provide recommendations regarding procedures, strategies, resources, and ongoing activities
  • Aggregate and analyze data to support comparisons, reporting, and management decisions
  • Provide subject-matter expertise to FSA FOIA management and internal stakeholders
  • Support Department compliance with Federal information-management and privacy requirements
Communication & Quality
  • Communicate professionally with FSA personnel, Department offices, requesters, and other stakeholders
  • Keep the COR and FSA FOIA management informed of progress and issues affecting performance
  • Prepare complete, correct, timely, and easy-to-understand written work products
  • Use Department formats, terminology, and procedures when preparing deliverables
  • Incorporate feedback and correct identified errors promptly
  • Manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and required response timelines
Program Support
  • Support analytical reporting and other FOIA program activities assigned by FSA management
  • Prepare Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and related work products as required
  • Maintain documents in appropriate locations so they are accessible to authorized staff
  • Protect sensitive, privacy-related, and Government information handled during performance
  • Perform quality checks on case data, correspondence, redactions, and deliverables
  • Work independently at a high-performance level with minimal input from program leadership
  • Be prepared to begin performance immediately after award
  • Perform related FOIA and Privacy Act support duties within the scope of the position

REQUIRED BACKGROUND
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 3 years of Federal service or equivalent public/private-sector experience managing and/or responding to FOIA/Privacy Act requests
  • Demonstrated expertise using and applying the major FOIA exemptions
  • Experience processing complex FOIA requests
  • Expert knowledge and application of FOIA and Privacy Act laws, regulations, policies, procedures, and guidance
  • Expert-level experience using FOIA Xpress and related technologies
  • Experience processing FOIA Appeals
  • Experience reviewing responsive records and applying appropriate redactions
  • Ability to work independently at a high-performance level with minimal supervision
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

PREFERRED BACKGROUND
  • Federal agency FOIA and Privacy Act processing experience
  • Experience preparing interim and final FOIA response letters and memoranda
  • Experience coordinating responsive-record searches with multiple program offices or stakeholders
  • Experience applying FOIA case law and Department or agency policy to disclosure determinations
  • Experience with FOIA reporting, workload analysis, or case-management data
  • Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and related office tools
  • Experience learning or using internal FOIA workflow, tracking, or reporting systems

LOCATION
  • Work may be performed virtually or in accordance with Department of Education policies

TRAVEL
  • Travel is not required

BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION
  • Applicants will be subject to Department contractor security vetting and background investigation requirements
  • Employment is contingent on final Government approval and successful completion of applicable requirements

CLIENT
  • U.S. Department of Education

EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION
  • Employment Classification Eligibility — Exempt

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, age, marital or civil partnership status, mental disability, physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy, maternity status, political affiliation, military or veteran status, genetic information, traits historically associated with race, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, and/or local law.

Regularly required to sit for extended periods up to 100% of the time; frequently required to move about to access file cabinets and use office equipment such as PC, copier, fax, telephone, cell phone, etc. Occasionally required to reach overhead, bend, and lift objects of up to 10 lbs. jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Showbie, we’re building tools to help teachers transform their classrooms by delivering faster, more engaging, and more impactful feedback and assessment to their students.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Showbie, we’re building tools to help teachers transform their classrooms by delivering faster, more engaging, and more impactful feedback and assessment to their students. Our apps, Showbie and Socrative, are used by millions of teachers and students in classrooms worldwide.

We are proudly based in Edmonton, Canada, with a growing global team located across Canada and Europe, primarily in the United Kingdom and Norway.

We are made up of people who are passionate about empowering educators as they use technology to redefine and improve their classrooms. Our values of leading with care, being driven by purpose, and seeking perspectives help guide our attitudes and actions each day.

The Role

Showbie is looking for an experienced Senior Account Manager - EdTech SaaS Sales to drive customer retention, expansion, and recurring revenue growth across our existing customer base.

This is a remote role based in the United Kingdom, with occasional travel required for customer meetings, team days, or business needs.

This is a commercial sales role with responsibility for ARR, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, upsell, expansion, and accurate revenue forecasting. You will own a portfolio of customer accounts, build strong relationships with key stakeholders, identify growth opportunities, manage renewal risk, and ensure customers continue to see long-term value from Showbie.

You will work with a diverse range of customers, including Multi-Academy Trusts, districts, and schools of all sizes, from SMB to Enterprise, both in the UK and globally.

You will need to be confident engaging with senior and C-level stakeholders within the EdTech sector, including leading customer meetings independently. This role requires the ability to manage strategic conversations, ask strong discovery questions, uncover commercial risk, and move renewal and expansion opportunities forward without needing senior support in every customer meeting.

This role is ideal for someone with strong SaaS account management experience within EdTech, who enjoys combining customer partnership with commercial ownership. You will be expected to manage opportunities confidently, use data to make informed decisions, and maintain a clear and accurate forecast.

Depending on performance and alignment, there may be an opportunity for this role to evolve into an Account Management Team Lead. As a Senior Account Manager, you will be expected to mentor the wider team through coaching, sharing best practices, and helping to raise the standard of commercial account management across the team.

What You’ll Do

Revenue Retention & Growth

  • Manage a portfolio of existing customer accounts, driving renewals, expansion opportunities, seat growth, and product upsells.
  • Take ownership of ARR, NRR, renewal, upsell, and growth targets across your account base.
  • Build and execute account plans that identify risks, growth opportunities, stakeholder engagement strategies, and next steps.
  • Proactively identify churn risks and create clear mitigation plans.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting of renewals, upsell opportunities, and expansion pipeline.
  • Lead commercial conversations with confidence, including pricing, procurement, renewal timelines, and negotiation.

SaaS Account Management

  • Develop strong, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, senior decision-makers, and C-level contacts.
  • Lead customer meetings independently, including renewal conversations, commercial reviews, discovery meetings, and strategic account discussions.
  • Drive product adoption and customer value realisation to support long-term retention and expansion.
  • Use customer data, product usage, account health indicators, and commercial insight to prioritise activity and make informed decisions.
  • Run structured customer meetings, including discovery calls, renewal conversations, business reviews, and growth discussions.
  • Ensure customers clearly understand the value they are receiving from Showbie throughout the year, not just at renewal.

Opportunity Management & Forecasting

  • Manage opportunities through the full account management sales cycle, from discovery and qualification through to close.
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene, ensuring opportunities, next steps, close dates, stakeholders, risks, and forecast categories are accurate.
  • Use data and clear qualification methods to assess whether opportunities are likely to close.
  • Provide clear and reliable forecast updates to Sales Leadership.
  • Identify pipeline risk early and take action to improve deal progression.

Coaching & Team Contribution

  • Act as a senior member of the Account Management team, supporting colleagues through coaching, guidance, and sharing best practice.
  • Help Account Managers improve commercial acumen, customer engagement, opportunity management, and forecasting discipline.
  • Contribute to team discussions around renewals, upsell strategy, account planning, and customer risk.
  • Support the development of a high-performing, accountable, and customer-focused Account Management culture.
  • Demonstrate the behaviours and standards required for future progression into a Team Lead role.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in EdTech within a SaaS environment.
  • Strong experience in sales and account management, customer growth, renewals, upsell, or expansion roles.
  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Strong understanding of ARR, NRR, retention, churn, expansion revenue, and recurring revenue growth.
  • C-level stakeholder experience within the EdTech sector, with the ability to independently lead customer meetings, renewal conversations, commercial discussions, and strategic account reviews.
  • Experience using data to make informed decisions, identify account risk, prioritise opportunities, and support customer conversations.
  • Strong opportunity management skills, including qualification, stakeholder mapping, next-step management, and close planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to forecast accurately and maintain high standards of CRM hygiene.
  • Coaching experience as a Senior Account Manager, including supporting peers or wider team members with account strategy, opportunity management, or commercial conversations.
  • Self-motivated, commercially minded, and comfortable operating in a growing SaaS environment.

Benefits

  • £40,000 - £50,000 base salary, depending on experience.
  • Uncapped commission, paid monthly.
  • BUPA healthcare.
  • Remote-first working environment.
  • Company equipment to support your role.
  • Occasional travel for customer meetings, team days, or business needs.
  • Opportunity to grow into an Account Management Team Lead role for the right candidate.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • At Showbie, you can be yourself. We welcome and celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all team members and candidates.
  • We are a remote-first team. Whether you’re planning a move, traveling, or simply want flexibility in where you work, we aim to support your lifestyle.
  • Health and Dental Benefits for you and your family.
  • You’ll have the autonomy to make decisions and take ownership of your work. As part of a small, global team, your contributions will have a direct and meaningful impact.
  • We support you in setting up a productive and comfortable remote work environment, wherever you are based.
  • We value work-life balance. We work hard, but we also respect time away from work so you can recharge and come back energized.
  • We offer flexibility around holidays, including a holiday swapping program so you can take time off that aligns with your personal or cultural priorities.

Check out our Work at Showbie page to learn a little bit about our company culture and the benefits we offer to our team. We pride ourselves on a company culture that values the whole you. We like to have fun as much as we like to work.

The Interview Process

Here’s what you can expect if you move forward in our hiring process:

  1. Initial Phone Screen A short conversation to get to know you, your experience, and your interest in the role.
  2. Interview & Assessment A deeper discussion with members of the team, along with a practical exercise or take-home task to understand how you approach real-world scenarios.
  3. Values Conversation A discussion focused on how you work, collaborate, and align with Showbie’s values.
  4. Reference Check A final step before an offer, where we connect with your references.

For certain roles, we may also include a background check as part of the process.

Security & Candidate Safety

We take the security of our candidates seriously. To help protect against recruitment fraud:

  • All legitimate Showbie and Socrative job postings are listed on our official Careers Page.
  • If you have any concerns about external communication or fraud, please reach out to
  • We will never contact you from a personal phone number or ask for sensitive information outside of our official hiring process.

A Few Final Things To Know

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the United Kingdom to be considered. Verification of location and work eligibility will be required.
  • This is a sales role responsible for recurring revenue, account retention, account expansion, upsell, ARR, NRR, and accurate forecasting.
  • There is potential for this role to grow into an Account Management Team Lead position for the right candidate.
Salary: £40,000 - £50,000 + variable commission

jobs.description:
The Director, Marketing is a central operations role serving all MCG Centers of Excellence, accountable for building the enterprise strategic marketing function and translating MCG’s engineered products and lifecycle services into positioning, go-to-market programs, and sales enablement that win work.

This is a build role and a player-coach role. The person in this seat personally produces the early work, competitive analysis, positioning architecture, launch plans, and customer-facing materials, while standing up the processes, tools, and team that scale it across the enterprise. Success requires strategic judgment and a willingness to execute directly while the infrastructure is still being built.

Accountabilities:

  • Enterprise marketing strategy: Build and own the strategic marketing plan supporting commercial growth across all six Centers of Excellence, translating enterprise and business unit priorities into a prioritized roadmap and campaign calendar.
  • Positioning and messaging: Develop positioning, messaging architecture, value propositions, and competitive differentiation for MCG’s integrated power solutions and lifecycle services and hold the organization to consistent use of it.
  • Go-to-market: Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for new products, services, and solutions, from launch planning through sales readiness, launch execution, and post-launch performance review.
  • Technical translation: Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and operations leadership to convert technical capability into customer value in language that owners, engineering firms, contractors, and specifiers understand.
  • Integrated campaigns: Plan and execute integrated campaigns across digital, email, paid media, social, trade events, and industry publications; establish KPIs, measure performance, and reallocate effort and spend based on results.
  • Digital presence: Own SEO, SEM, and website strategy and optimization, and build the campaign analytics and reporting foundation the enterprise currently lacks.
  • Market intelligence: Monitor customer requirements, competitor activity, and market dynamics across data center, utility, healthcare, industrial, and commercial segments, and convert findings into recommendations leadership can act on.
  • Sales enablement: Partner with Sales to develop presentations, case studies, solution briefs, spec sheets, and proposal content; support strategic pursuits, customer meetings, trade shows, and product launches.
  • Content production: Direct video, photography, and visual content production, including storyboard development, managing internal resources and agency partners to a consistent brand standard.
  • Growth and integration marketing: Support MCG’s growth agenda, including positioning, brand integration, and capability messaging associated with acquisitions and newly added service lines.
  • Operating model: Establish how the Centers of Excellence request, prioritize, and receive marketing support, and report performance through a consistent enterprise reporting cadence.
  • Team build and leadership: Build and lead the strategic marketing team. Define roles, hire ahead of demand, develop capability, and manage day-to-day priorities and deliverables.
  • Budget and partners: Manage assigned budgets, agency relationships, and marketing vendors, holding partners accountable to scope, timeline, and measurable return.
  • Direct execution: Personally execute priority deliverables during the build phase rather than routing all work to a team or agency.

Attributes:

  • Have Humanity: You lead with respect for the customers, crews, and colleagues behind every project MCG supports. You market what the business can actually deliver, and you give credit to the people who deliver it.
  • Be Transparent: You report marketing performance honestly, including the programs that did not work. You share plans, priorities, and results openly so every Center of Excellence knows what is coming and why.
  • Drive Innovation: You challenge established messaging, channels, and habits rather than repeating what has always been done. You test new approaches, measure them, and retire what does not produce.
  • Be Resilient: You hold momentum through shifting priorities, competing business unit demands, and long capital sales cycles. You adjust the plan when conditions change without losing the strategy behind it.
  • Always Reliable: You deliver on committed dates and quality standards, so Sales and business unit leaders know exactly what they are getting from you. You are the partner they call first because you follow through.
  • Grit: You do the work personally when the team, the tools, and the budget are still being built. You stay with the unglamorous parts of the build until the function can stand on its own.

Required Knowledge / Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including strategic marketing, product marketing, and go-to-market leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience building or substantially rebuilding a marketing function, program, or discipline rather than inheriting a mature one.
  • Experience marketing engineered, technical, or capital equipment products through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units, divisions, or product lines from a central or shared-services position.
  • Strong digital marketing capability across SEO, SEM, website, email, and campaign analytics, with proficiency in marketing automation, CRM, and analytics platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to build sales enablement materials and partner effectively with commercial and technical teams.
  • People leadership experience, including hiring, developing, and directing marketing staff and agency partners.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration and the ability to influence without direct authority across business units and senior leadership.
  • Willingness to remain hands-on; this role produces work directly as well as directing it.
  • Experience in manufacturing preferred. Electrical infrastructure, power generation, energy, utilities, data centers, or related industries required.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Mission Critical Group (MCG) is a U.S.-based electrical systems and solutions provider that reduces time-to-power through its broad product portfolio, modular solutions, and more than one million square feet of U.S. manufacturing capacity.

We bring design, manufacturing, and advanced services together to deliver power reliability, scalability, and speed.
