GI Registered Nurse (RN)

Reports To: Associate Director of Clinical Operations
Locations Hiring From: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin.
Schedule: 9-5pm EST with rotating on-call schedule
Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule & On-Call Requirements

This role will be part of a four-RN team that provides both daytime clinical coverage and after-hours on-call support. The team operates on a rotating schedule designed to distribute evening, overnight, and weekend call responsibilities across all four RNs.

Standard Daytime Schedule

  • Monday–Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET
  • RNs work their standard daytime schedule during non-call weeks.

On-Call Rotation

  • Each RN rotates into the on-call schedule approximately every fourth week.
  • During the RN's assigned on-call week, their schedule will shift from the standard daytime schedule to after-hours/on-call coverage.
  • Monday–Thursday: On-call coverage from 5:00 PM–9:00 AM ET
  • Weekend Coverage: Begins Friday at 5:00 PM ET and continues through Monday at 9:00 AM ET
  • After-hours coverage is managed through PagerDuty

This rotation allows the four-RN team to share after-hours responsibilities while providing each RN with approximately three weeks of standard daytime scheduling between on-call rotations. Candidates should be comfortable working a flexible rotating schedule that includes evenings, overnight call, and weekend call approximately once every four weeks.

Role Overview

The GI Registered Nurse plays a pivotal role in supporting clinical excellence, provider productivity, patient safety, and seamless care coordination across all Oshi Health GI service lines. This role provides direct clinical support, triage, and inbox management for Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), Registered Dietitians (RDs), and Behavioral Health (BH) specialists. By managing complex clinical workflows, including urgent symptom escalations, high-volume lab routing, prescription refill protocols, and patient education, the GI RN ensures rapid, high-quality patient care while reducing administrative burden on the broader care team. This role bridges clinical practice with operational efficiency, ensuring standard operating procedures and clinical protocols are executed consistently across all regions.

What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities

Clinical Triage and Symptom Management

  • Execute timely asynchronous and synchronous clinical triage for patient-reported symptoms via secure chat, phone calls (TalkDesk), and EHR tasks.
  • Act as primary incident lead for Slack-based Urgent Symptom Escalation and 911 Critical Incident workflows.
  • Perform clinical risk assessments, apply C-SSRS screening protocols for patients in crisis, stabilize immediate safety concerns, and route appropriately to providers or emergency services.
  • Evaluate acute GI complaints (e.g., hematochezia, severe pain spikes, persistent vomiting, fever) and determine appropriate level of care, outpatient directives, or emergency room referrals.

Lab, Imaging, and Diagnostic Management

  • Manage, review, and clear high-volume lab and imaging results across general and state-specific clinical inboxes in AthenaOne.
  • Review normal lab panels (CBC, CMP, TSH, tTG IgA, CRP, calprotectin, H. pylori antigen) and communicate reassurance and After Visit Summary directives to patients using standardized macros.
  • Summarize and highlight abnormal laboratory or diagnostic findings for APP review.
  • Provide patient education and manage administrative logistics for specialized testing (e.g., SIBO breath test kits, lab re-orders, facility-specific order matching).

Medication Management and Pharmacy Coordination

  • Process medication refill requests and pharmacy inquiries according to established standing orders and refill protocols.
  • Manage pharmacy interactions, handle complex prescription submission issues, and resolve coverage/prior authorization barriers.
  • Evaluate refill appropriateness, identifying cases that require APP clinical re-evaluation versus those eligible for protocolized fulfillment.

APP Support and Out-of-Office (OOO) Coverage

  • Provide comprehensive inbox support for designated APPs during scheduled OOO periods, high-admin volume periods, or caseload surges.
  • Review, prioritize, and clear incoming patient cases, orders, and diagnostic results to maintain continuity of care and prevent backlog growth.
  • Maintain clear documentation and communication logs to ensure seamless handoffs upon provider return.

Cross-Functional Care Coordination

  • Partner closely with Care Coordinators to ensure appropriate routing of clinical versus administrative patient messages.
  • Collaborate with RDs and BH providers to support multidisciplinary GI care plans, respecting clinical scope boundaries while assisting with urgent clinical needs.
  • Represent nursing workflows in interdisciplinary alignment meetings and quality reviews.

Operations, Process Improvement, and SOP Adherence

  • Monitor daily inbox metrics to track handle times, backlog dynamics, and capacity bottlenecks.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies, double-documentation practices, or workflow gaps, and actively contribute to process improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in testing and adopting new technology, automated lab-routing mechanisms, macro templates, and EHR updates.

What We're Looking For: Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • Active, unencumbered RN license with willingness/ability to hold multi-state licensure as required by service line expansion.
  • Demonstrated experience in clinical triage, high-volume patient inbox management, or specialized GI nursing practice.
  • Demonstrated clinical expertise across specialized GI pathways, including IBD, IBS, H. pylori protocols, SIBO testing/education, elevated fecal calprotectin, and specialized lab monitoring.
  • Proven ability to act as a primary lead for urgent symptom escalations and critical incident workflows (e.g., 911 critical incidents, suicidal ideation/C-SSRS screening, acute crisis stabilization).
  • Demonstrates mastery in navigating EHR and communication technology, including AthenaOne, Salesforce, Slack workflows, PagerDuty, and TalkDesk.
  • Strong organizational skills to balance competing priorities during high-volume periods or provider OOO coverage surges.

Preferred

  • Experience in telehealth operations, asynchronous patient messaging, and multi-channel call management platforms.
  • Experience adapting to new software integrations (e.g., Okta SSO, automated lab routing) and updated standing orders.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: $80-100,000 with bonus eligibility
  • Health Benefits: Employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Time Off: 3 weeks of PTO, 1 week of sick pay + 11 paid company holidays
  • Retirement: Eligibility to contribute to 401(k)
  • Work Style: Remote-first — work from home within our approved states
  • Growth: Tailored professional development opportunities as we scale
  • Life Concierge: Access to Overalls, because we know life happens

About Backblaze

Backblaze is a public company that makes storing and using data astonishingly easy. When our founding team got together, they committed to helping people save their data. Our customers are happy, and so are our coworkers: in the most recent “Great Place to Work” survey, 97% of our team rated Backblaze as “a great place to work.” Check out what our employees are saying on Glassdoor!

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Corporate Counsel, Corporate & Securities to own Backblaze’s public-company legal stack: SEC reporting, corporate governance, board and stockholder support, equity and Section 16 compliance, entity management, and corporate transactions. This role removes key-person risk on the securities and governance function and gives the public-company calendar a dedicated, senior owner.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned corporate and securities lawyer who is equally comfortable drafting a Form 10-K, running an annual meeting, advising the Board, and supporting M&A and corporate finance. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thrives as the go-to expert on public-company matters in a lean, fast-moving legal team.

This role reports to the Head of Legal & Compliance and is fully remote (US-based).

What You’ll Do

Securities Reporting and Section 16 Compliance

  • Prepare and review the company’s public company securities filings, including annual and quarterly reports on Form 10-K and 10-Q, and current reports on Form 8-K.
  • Prepare and review the annual proxy statement and related proxy materials; manage annual stockholder meetings and related activities.
  • Help administer Section 16 compliance and compliance with corporate securities policies, including the Rule 10b5-1 plans program and the insider trading policy.

Corporate Governance and Board Support

Entity Management and International Governance

Risk Management

  • Support the company’s risk management program, including periodic risk assessments and related risk compliance programs.

Corporate Transactions

  • Oversee legal aspects of corporate transactional matters, including M&A, corporate finance, and other strategic transactions.

  • Apply AI tools to improve the efficiency and quality of drafting, filing preparation, disclosure review, and governance workflows, and help the function adopt emerging legal technology responsibly.
  • Partner effectively with outside counsel on various matters.
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional basis with other internal departments, including Finance and Accounting, Privacy, Compliance, Sales & Marketing, and leadership teams.
  • Other duties as required from time to time.

The Right Fit

  • Deep public-company securities and reporting experience, with the ability to independently own the 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and proxy cycle.
  • Strong corporate governance background and experience supporting a Board of Directors and its committees.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Section 16, Rule 10b5-1, insider trading compliance, and equity administration areas.
  • Experience with M&A, corporate finance, and other strategic transactions.
  • Comfortable operating as the primary owner of the public-company stack in a lean team, with a high sense of ownership and sound, pragmatic judgment.
  • Fluency with AI, or a strong interest and demonstrated ability to build it, and comfort using AI tools to work more efficiently in a securities and governance context.
  • Clear, concise communicator who can translate complex securities and governance requirements into practical, business-focused advice.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a strong track record of managing deadline-driven filing and governance calendars.

Qualifications

  • J.D. degree and active U.S. bar membership in good standing.
  • 10 or more years of relevant legal experience, including substantial public-company securities and corporate governance experience; a combination of law firm and in-house experience is preferred.
  • Deep working knowledge of federal securities laws and regulations (including Regulation FD) and applicable Nasdaq listing standards.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing SEC filings (Form 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K) and annual proxy statements, and managing annual stockholder meetings.
  • Experience advising on M&A, corporate finance, and entity management matters.
  • Familiarity with, or genuine willingness to develop fluency in, AI and its application to legal and governance work, and comfort using AI tools to work more efficiently.
  • In-house experience at a public technology or SaaS company is a plus.

The Listing Integrity team’s ultimate goal is to prevent experiences like this by proactively detecting and removing fraudulent listings (Homes, Experiences, and Services) so that guests can search and book on Airbnb with confidence. The team uses data driven heuristics, machine learning models, and customer service operations in order to accomplish this goal.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Software Engineer on the Listing Integrity team, you will be working with data scientists, designers, product managers, and customer service operations to innovate new ways we can stop bad actors in the ever evolving fraudulent listing creation and financial losses associated with it by collaborating across team boundaries.

On this team, you must have the curiosity to dig deep into various end to end systems in order to understand how and where the fraud occurs. Your curiosity will be rewarded with finding projects that have outsized impacts on decreasing fraud losses and protecting Airbnb users from bad experiences while on vacation.

  • Building out tooling and automation for operations to more effectively reduce fraud.
  • Building user challenges to prevent fraudulent listings while reducing good user impact.

The Product Engineer is the core builder role at Brushfire and the role the engineering team is built around. A Product Engineer owns features end-to-end at the application layer: they write the PRD for their own work, make the design and UX decisions, orchestrate AI agents to accelerate every phase of delivery, and ship the result — then own its quality in production. This role is "full stack" in the fullest sense: not just fluency across the technologies, but a working understanding of the entire Brushfire platform and the organizations it serves. Product Engineers do not silo into a specialty; they take an outcome and “drive it to done,” using whatever combination of their own hands and AI agents that achieves that goal.

The ideal candidate for this position is someone who is extremely comfortable with the latest technology, trends, and favors concrete execution over abstract ideation. We are proudly impartial when it comes to solutions – we like to try new things and the best idea is always the winning idea, regardless of the way we’ve done it previously.

This is a full-time work-from-home position.

The following characteristics are necessary for a qualified applicant to be considered:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping user-facing product
  • Strong React (TypeScript) frontend skills — clean, well-structured components and good visual instincts
  • Solid .NET (C#) backend development — you can design an API endpoint, write a service layer, and handle edge cases
  • MSSQL proficiency — query optimization, schema design for new features, and a working understanding of indexes and execution plans
  • Demonstrated, transformative use of AI agents in a real delivery workflow — you can walk through substantial features shipped through agent orchestration under your direction, and articulate how you decompose, direct, and verify that work
  • Strong product sensibility: you take underspecified problems, interrogate the user need, write PRDs engineers and stakeholders can act on, and make sound design decisions without a designer
  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment with a high degree of autonomy
  • Experience with Github (or other similar version control systems) and CI/CD pipeline tools like Azure Devops and Github actions
  • Ability to communicate fluently, pleasantly, and effectively—both orally and in writing, in the English language—with customers and co-workers.
  • Concrete examples and evidence of work product and what role the applicant played in it

The following characteristics are not necessary but are highly desired:

  • React Native familiarity (enough to review mobile PRs meaningfully)
  • Firebase/Firestore experience (pub/sub, realtime database)
  • Auth0 or similar identity platform experience
  • Experience with ASP.NET MVC / Razor Views / jQuery (legacy modernization experience a plus)
  • Experience authoring agentic workflows, MCP integrations, or AI tooling adopted by a team
  • Familiarity with Shortcut, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • MongoDB experience
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related technical field
  • Ability to contribute to strategic and planning sessions around architecture and implementation

What’s it like to work for Brushfire?

We’ve been 100% remote for the better part of two decades, and our team is a diverse group of caring, driven people from all backgrounds and technological comfort levels that strive to provide the best for our customers while also being the best they can be for their team. We place a high value on open, candid communication through group chats, video calls, and phone calls throughout each day to keep things moving forward. When possible, we encourage interested team members to collaborate in-person and we have in-person meetings for the entire company at least once a year.

Compensation/Benefits/Perks

Compensation for this role starts at $120,000 annually and scales commensurate with experience. We also offer competitive performance-based incentives.

We believe working remotely is merely the baseline necessary for a healthy work-life balance. We also provide comprehensive benefits including company-sponsored (and matched) retirement plans, full health insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision, and life) for employee, unlimited PTO, flexible hours, and much more.

Although we are a completely remote company, candidates closer to our teams in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas are preferred.

Application Process

We take great care to evaluate all employees and job applicants equally, based on merit, competence, and qualifications. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Brushfire, it’s our goal to be the go-to ticketing and registration platform our customers deserve. We’re an event management software-as-a-service platform that provides solutions for ticketing & registration, virtual events, and event apps. Last year we powered over 30,000 events, all around the world, ranging anywhere from a handful of people to more than 20,000 attendees.

Brushfire helps power successful events around the world by providing great software and service that never stops improving. We believe every organization deserves the most elegantly architected platform for event management, both at the technology and service layer.

jobs.description:
Accounting Manager (GAAP, Month-End Close, Payroll & Multi-Entity Accounting) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Accounting Manager to oversee financial reporting, month-end close, payroll, and core accounting operations across complex client accounts.

This is a hands-on accounting role, not a basic bookkeeping or data-entry position. We’re looking for someone with strong accrual accounting and GAAP expertise who can confidently manage multi-entity, multi-location, and multi-segment accounting environments.

You’ll take ownership of:

  • Month-end close
  • GAAP financial reporting
  • Payroll processing
  • Accounts payable and receivable
  • General ledger accuracy
  • U.S. sales tax compliance
  • Budgeting and forecasting support
  • Accounting process improvement

If you’re highly detail-oriented, technically strong in accounting, and comfortable owning complex financial workflows, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Execute accurate and timely month-end close processes
  • Prepare financial statements and reports aligned with client requirements
  • Maintain clean, organized, and audit-ready workpapers
  • Ensure reporting complies with applicable accounting standards
  • Review financial data for discrepancies and resolve issues proactively
  • Maintain consistent reporting timelines across multiple accounts and entities

Payroll & Employee Setup

  • Process payroll accurately using Gusto or similar payroll platforms
  • Set up and maintain employees within payroll systems
  • Ensure payroll information and documentation remain accurate
  • Support payroll-related compliance requirements
  • Identify and resolve payroll discrepancies before processing deadlines

Core Accounting Operations

  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Maintain accurate general ledger records
  • Manage accounting activity across multiple entities, locations, or business segments
  • Prepare and review journal entries and reconciliations
  • Ensure financial transactions are properly classified and recorded
  • Maintain organized and accurate accounting systems

Sales Tax & Compliance

  • Calculate and file U.S. state sales tax
  • Ensure filings are completed accurately and on time
  • Maintain supporting documentation for tax filings
  • Track compliance deadlines and reporting requirements
  • Help maintain clean, audit-ready financial records

Reporting, Analysis & Forecasting

  • Build and maintain customized financial reports
  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes
  • Analyze financial data to identify trends and discrepancies
  • Prepare financial insights for leadership decision-making
  • Use Excel and reporting tools to organize and visualize financial information

Process Improvement & Documentation

  • Review existing accounting processes and workflows
  • Document accounting procedures and controls
  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements
  • Standardize accounting processes across clients and systems
  • Improve reporting, reconciliation, and close workflows
  • Help build scalable accounting processes as the organization grows

Client & Internal Coordination

  • Communicate regularly with leadership regarding accounting priorities and deliverables
  • Support client-facing accounting communication when required
  • Maintain alignment on reporting timelines and expectations
  • Proactively communicate issues, discrepancies, and potential delays
  • Ensure accounting deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting or finance experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with accrual accounting and GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience managing multi-entity, multi-location, or multi-segment accounting
  • Strong proficiency with QuickBooks Online, with QuickBooks Desktop/Enterprise experience also relevant
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including:
    • XLOOKUP
    • INDEX/MATCH
    • Pivot Tables
    • Data Tables
  • Hands-on payroll processing experience using Gusto or a similar platform
  • Experience calculating and filing U.S. state sales tax
  • Strong understanding of:
    • General ledger accounting
    • Accounts payable
    • Accounts receivable
    • Reconciliations
    • Financial reporting
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience with NetSuite
  • Familiarity with Paylocity or ADP
  • Experience using Ramp or Bill.com
  • Exposure to time-tracking platforms such as Clockify
  • Background working within an outsourced accounting firm
  • Experience supporting multiple clients or complex accounting environments
  • Experience improving accounting workflows, controls, or reporting processes

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand accrual accounting beyond basic bookkeeping
  • You’re highly accurate and detail-oriented
  • You can confidently manage complex accounting structures
  • You’re comfortable owning month-end close from start to finish
  • You identify accounting discrepancies before they become larger problems
  • You can manage multiple entities, locations, and deadlines simultaneously
  • You communicate financial issues clearly and professionally
  • You take ownership without requiring constant supervision
  • You value clean documentation, structured processes, and reliable reporting

Operational Environment

This is an execution-focused and accuracy-driven role.

You’ll work within structured accounting systems and workflows, with direct communication from leadership and clear expectations around reporting deadlines and deliverables.

Your ownership will center on:

  • Accurate financial reporting
  • Clean and timely month-end closes
  • Reliable payroll processing
  • Tax and compliance execution
  • Organized accounting records
  • Managing complex accounting structures
  • Proactively identifying and resolving accounting issues

This environment rewards precision, accountability, consistency, and strong financial ownership.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may begin by reviewing reconciliations, financial statements, and outstanding month-end close items across multiple entities.

Throughout the day, you could process or review payroll, manage AP and AR activity, prepare journal entries, update financial reports, review sales tax obligations, and investigate accounting discrepancies.

You’ll also coordinate with leadership and clients regarding reporting requirements, support budgeting and forecasting, and improve accounting workflows where opportunities exist.

In short: you ensure complex accounting operations remain accurate, compliant, organized, and delivered on time.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and timeliness of month-end close
  • Error-free financial reporting and documentation
  • Clean and organized accounting records across entities
  • Timely and accurate payroll processing
  • Compliance with sales tax filings and reporting requirements
  • Accurate AP, AR, and general ledger management
  • Consistent reporting and reconciliation quality
  • Leadership confidence in financial accuracy and reliability

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across core accounting operations
  • Exposure to complex multi-entity and multi-location accounting
  • Direct collaboration with leadership
  • Opportunity to improve accounting processes and systems
  • Hands-on responsibility across reporting, payroll, compliance, and financial operations
  • Fully remote environment
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Accounting Manager
    • Controller
    • Finance Manager
    • Accounting Operations Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Recruiter Interview
  3. Final Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have strong experience with GAAP/accrual accounting, month-end close, QuickBooks, payroll, U.S. sales tax, and multi-entity accounting, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of complex accounting operations where accuracy, execution, and financial reliability matter.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This gives you an opportunity to introduce yourself, highlight your relevant accounting experience, and explain why you’re a strong fit for the role.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

Requirements

Transaction Coordinator – California Real Estate | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote | 1099 Independent Contractor
Compensation: $1,500–$2,000/month
Reports To: Managing Broker
California Real Estate License: Not Required

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients, TurboHome Brokerage, is hiring a detail-oriented Transaction Coordinator to manage the administrative and compliance side of California residential real estate transactions from executed contract through close of escrow.

TurboHome is a fast-growing, tech-enabled California brokerage. In this role, you’ll serve as the operational backbone behind its agents—keeping transaction files organized, contractual deadlines on track, required disclosures complete, and documentation audit-ready.

This is an excellent fit for someone who understands California real estate transactions, DocuSign Rooms, contracts, disclosures, and escrow timelines and can manage multiple active files without letting details slip.

What You’ll Own

Transaction Coordination

  • Open and manage transaction files in DocuSign Rooms
  • Coordinate transactions from executed purchase agreement through close of escrow
  • Maintain accurate transaction checklists, documentation, and status updates
  • Support multiple agents and concurrent transactions
  • Ensure every file progresses smoothly toward closing

Contract & Compliance Review

Review contracts, addenda, and disclosures for completeness and compliance with:

  • California DRE requirements
  • Brokerage policies and procedures
  • Transaction recordkeeping standards

Identify missing signatures, forms, dates, or documentation before they become compliance issues.

California Disclosures

Collect, track, and confirm execution of required California disclosures, including:

  • TDS
  • NHD
  • SPQ
  • AVID
  • Other applicable buyer and seller disclosures

Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready transaction files.

Deadline & Contingency Management

Track and calendar critical contractual deadlines, including:

  • Inspection periods
  • Loan contingencies
  • Appraisal contingencies
  • Other contingency periods
  • Close-of-escrow dates

Proactively communicate upcoming deadlines and flag anything at risk of being delayed or missed.

Document & Signature Coordination

  • Prepare and route transaction documents for signature
  • Manage e-signature workflows through DocuSign and similar platforms
  • Confirm documents are properly executed and returned
  • Maintain accurate versions of contracts, addenda, disclosures, and supporting documentation

Agent, Client & Vendor Communication

Serve as a coordination point between:

  • Real estate agents
  • Buyers and sellers
  • Escrow and title officers
  • Lenders
  • Vendors

Provide clear updates, follow up on outstanding items, and help keep everyone aligned throughout the transaction.

Closing & Transaction Support

Coordinate ancillary transaction requirements such as:

  • Home warranty orders
  • Repair documentation
  • Vendor scheduling
  • Outstanding closing documentation

Ensure transaction files remain complete and organized through close of escrow.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Know how California residential transactions move from contract to close
  • Are highly organized and deadline-driven
  • Catch missing documents and details before they become problems
  • Can confidently manage several active transactions at once
  • Communicate professionally with agents, clients, lenders, and escrow teams
  • Follow up proactively rather than waiting to be reminded
  • Maintain clean and compliance-ready transaction files

Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–3+ years of experience as a:
    • Transaction Coordinator
    • Escrow Assistant
    • Real Estate Transaction Support Specialist
    • Similar real estate operations professional
  • Working knowledge of California residential purchase contracts
  • Understanding of California transaction timelines and disclosure requirements
  • Familiarity with DocuSign Rooms or similar transaction management systems
  • Experience with electronic signature platforms
  • Strong organizational and deadline-management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to support multiple agents and active transactions simultaneously
  • High attention to detail and accuracy

A California real estate license is not required for this position.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting multiple real estate agents simultaneously
  • Experience in a California brokerage environment
  • Familiarity with Dotloop Sign or similar platforms
  • Strong knowledge of California disclosure workflows
  • Bilingual English/Spanish

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review newly executed purchase agreements
  • Open and organize files in DocuSign Rooms
  • Review contracts and disclosures for missing information
  • Track inspection, appraisal, loan, and contingency deadlines
  • Route documents for signatures
  • Follow up with agents, escrow officers, lenders, and clients
  • Collect outstanding disclosures and supporting documentation
  • Coordinate warranties, repairs, or vendors
  • Prepare transaction files for closing and compliance review

In short: You keep every transaction organized, compliant, and moving from executed contract through close of escrow.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Zero missed contractual deadlines
  • Complete and compliant transaction files
  • Accurate tracking of contingencies and closing dates
  • Fast resolution of missing documents and signatures
  • Consistent communication and follow-up
  • Audit-ready brokerage records
  • Smooth, on-time closings
  • Strong agent and broker confidence in transaction operations

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity
  • Direct involvement in California residential real estate transactions
  • Work with a fast-growing, tech-enabled brokerage
  • High ownership over transaction operations
  • Exposure to multiple agents and concurrent deals
  • Opportunity to deepen expertise in:
    • California real estate compliance
    • Transaction coordination
    • Escrow workflows
    • Brokerage operations
    • DocuSign Rooms

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Recruiter Interview
  3. Client Interview
  4. Final Decision & Offer

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have hands-on California transaction coordination experience
  • Understand residential contracts, disclosures, and escrow timelines
  • Can confidently manage multiple active files
  • Are meticulous about documentation and compliance
  • Know how to keep transactions moving without missed deadlines

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help keep California real estate transactions organized, compliant, and on track from contract to close.

You will be the ASIC & FPGA Design Engineer for the ASIC/FPGA department at Lockheed  Martin  Missiles  and  Fire  Control. Our team delivers full custom analog and mixed signal ICs that power advanced defense systems, ranging from 130 nm down to 12 nm and including high voltage BCD processes.

• Perform or support EMIR analysis to detect and remediate IR drop and electromigration concerns.

Remote: Yes

Role Mission

Path of Hope Rescue does not have a kennel or a building where people can visit our dogs. Our adopters must online shop for a dog and then decide to submit an adoption application. A well written, or creative ad can often be the difference between a dog being adopted immediately or waiting months for a family.

This person will be responsible for creating high quality copy used throughout the Rescue in dog advertisements, social media, email and fundraising campaigns.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Copy and Content

  • Understand and interpret creative requests to deliver messaging that

aligns with brand voice and objectives.

  • Craft compelling and engaging copy for various materials, including

advertisements, websites, social media posts, emails, and internal

documentation.

  • Prioritizes and works within folder structure and organization

Key Results Area #2 - Team Collaboration

  • Collaborates with the Creative Team to create quality content (photographers, copywriters, graphic designers and other videographers)

  • Collaborate with Creative Team to understand project objectives, requirements, and

brand guidelines.

  • Incorporate feedback and make revisions based on team and leader input.

Key Results Area #3 - Commitment and Work Integrity

  • Follows through on commitment, honoring requested timeline

  • Flexible when urgent projects come up such as medical fundraisers

Needed Skills

  • Creative writing

  • Marketing lens

  • Remote team communication and collaboration

  • Google Drive, Docs, Workplace knowledge

  • Must love dogs!

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

jobs.description:
En Espiral MS, empresa tecnológica certificada por Great Place to Work®, buscamos incorporar a una persona para el puesto Customer Success Manager, y unirse al equipo comercial de Proactivanet®, herramienta líder en ITSM (Gestión de Servicios de TI) e ITAM (Gestión de Activos de TI) en España y Latinoamérica.

Sobre nosotros

Somos una compañía con presencia en 5 países, más de 500 grandes organizaciones clientes en todo el mundo y un equipo de más de 100 profesionales apasionados por la tecnología y el servicio.
Vivimos una etapa de crecimiento y expansión internacional, y nuestra cultura se basa en tres pilares fundamentales:

  • Compromiso con las personas.

  • Compromiso con el éxito de nuestra clientela.

  • Compromiso con la excelencia en todo lo que hacemos.

En Grupo Espiral creemos en el trabajo en equipo, el aprendizaje continuo y en disfrutar del camino mientras alcanzamos grandes resultados. Estamos además certificados por Great Place to Work®, que nos reconoce como un excelente lugar para trabajar.

Tu misión

Buscamos un/a Customer Success Manager con base técnica sólida capaz de asegurar adopción, valor y expansión en cuentas estratégicas, orquestando personas, procesos e integración de la herramienta.

Como Customer Success Manager, serás clave para garantizar el éxito de nuestros clientes a lo largo de toda su experiencia con Proactivanet. Tu objetivo: construir relaciones estratégicas, de confianza y duraderas, ayudando a que cada cliente alcance sus metas gracias a un uso óptimo de nuestra solución.

¿Qué harás? (responsabilidades clave)

  • Plan de éxito por cuenta: definir y facilitar hojas de ruta técnicas, KPIs y gobernanza, asesorando estratégicamente a los clientes para alinear sus objetivos de negocio con Proactivanet.

  • Onboarding técnico/funcional: orientado al proceso, en coordinación con Preventa/Soporte para promover la adopción efectiva de la herramienta.

  • Adopción y cambio: impulsar comunicaciones, formación y adopción según cada perfil de cliente, coordinando con Consultoría/Soporte acciones técnicas cuando aplique.

  • Voz del cliente y valor: recoger feedback estructurado, documentar casos de uso/ROI, preparar reportes ejecutivos y generar referencias.

  • Gestión de cartera: priorizar acciones de impacto, mitigar riesgos de churn, identificar expansión (up/cross).

  • Métricas: GRR >95%, NPS > +45, Churn <3%, TTFV ≤30 días, TTV ≤90 días, utilización de licencias >85%.

Qué no es este puesto

  • No es soporte, implementación, ni “solo cuentas”: es un rol de éxito técnico y de negocio.

  • No es preventa pura: aunque colaborarás estrechamente, el foco es adopción, valor y renovaciones.

Requirements

Lo que buscamos

  • 3+ años en Customer Success / TAM / Consultoría en entornos tecnológicos (idealmente SaaS).

  • Conocimiento de ITIL (ideal ITIL 4 Foundation o superior).

  • Alfabetización tecnológica conversacional: comprender a nivel conceptual API/SSO/Directorio/CMDB/Discovery para liderar la conversación y traducir necesidades a requerimientos para los equipos técnicos.

  • Español nativo/C2 y inglés mínimo C1 (reuniones y documentación).

  • Enfoque consultivo, orientación a resultados y excelentes habilidades comunicativas.

  • Gestión de stakeholders: trabajo con sponsors, áreas TI y negocio; capacidad de priorizar un backlog de valor y coordinar con Consultoría/Soporte/Producto.

Deseables

  • Certificaciones ITIL intermedias, ISO 20000/27001 u otras afines.

  • Experiencia con clientes enterprise en España y con áreas de Seguridad/Compliance.

  • Experiencia en plataformas ITSM/ITAM (p. ej., Proactivanet, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC, Ivanti, ManageEngine, Freshservice).

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Somos conscientes de que el talento es nuestro mayor activo y nos esforzamos en cuidarlo ofreciéndote un entorno equitativo, diverso e inclusivo:

  • Formar parte de un proyecto líder y en expansión internacional.

  • Integrarte en un equipo donde el talento y las personas son lo más importante.

  • Aprender, crecer y aportar en un entorno innovador, colaborativo y dinámico.

  • Trabajo remoto desde España, con disponibilidad para viajar ocasionalmente a nuestras oficinas en Gijón y a visitar clientes en distintas regiones de España.

  • Horario flexible para facilitar la conciliación trabajo-vida personal. No se trabaja los viernes por la tarde, fines de semana ni festivos. Horario de verano intensivo para disfrutar de tardes libres.

  • Formación intensiva a cargo de la empresa. Te formaremos en aspectos técnicos y marcos de gestión que te permitirán mejorar tus capacidades e impulsar tu carrera profesional en un entorno altamente innovador.

  • Estabilidad profesional, continuidad y crecimiento profesional en un proyecto en expansión. Salario en función de la valía y experiencia de la persona candidata.

  • Dietas adicionales en caso de desplazamiento.

  • Programa de beneficios corporativo.

Si te apasiona construir relaciones sólidas, te motiva el éxito de tus clientes y te encanta trabajar en equipo dentro de un entorno tecnológico en plena expansión…

¡Nos encantará conocerte!

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations

The Role

The Program Manager III is a client facing role responsible for managing the client relationship and on time delivery of program objectives. In this role, you would oversee the coordination and management of a program by monitoring program/project status, ensuring adherence to timelines and budgets, and aligning goals of projects to meet needs of the program.

You would act as the primary liaison between the client, business development, and the project team to facilitate the flow of information between all parties.   • Manages contract process in tandem with Business Development, owns individual client project contract renewals, ensures appropriate review from relevant stakeholders; drives new opportunities from existing clients

  • Provides training and support to Program Manager I and Program Manger II, driving consistency with program management processes

  • Responsible for client relationship. Responds to client inquiries, leads client communications

  • Responsible for managing client expectations and execution of program deliverables in collaboration with Laboratory Operations management.

  • Acts as primary liaison between client management team and Laboratory Operations

Key Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 7+ years) or equivalent combination of education, training, & experience.

Years of experience refers to typical years of related experience needed to gain the required knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the essential functions of the job. Years of experience are not to be used as the only determining factor in establishing the job class or making employment selection decisions.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Strong verbal, written and presentation skills

  • Proven analytical skills

  • Demonstrated compliance with procedures and policies

  • Strong client relationship management skills

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced undefined environment

Work Environment

Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:

  • Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.

Who Are We?

Looking for a job that makes a real difference in our world today and one that you’ll be proud of when you look back in 20, 30 or 40 years? This is it. We’re a growing company that counts 10 of the top 10 Fortune 500 utilities and many of the largest renewable energy companies in the U.S. as our customers. We’re focused on expanding our market reach and impact with new software technologies that help solve the energy industry’s hardest problems.

At Clean Power Research, every employee has a seat at the table and an important role.

Why Work Here?

  • Go from building solutions to being part of the solution
  • Join a growing team of software and energy veterans from companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Oracle, General Electric and Pacific Gas & Electric
  • Bring your passion and ideas to the table
  • Use your creativity to solve hard problems and make tough decisions
  • Work in a start-up like environment coupled with the stability and customer base of an established, profitable company

Clean Power Research offers competitive compensation and benefits to full-time employees including medical/dental/vision, paid vacation, paid holidays, a bonus plan and 401(k) plan with matching.

What You'll Be Doing as a Technical Program Manager

Clean Power Research® seeks a Technical Program Manager to help define, coordinate, and deliver innovative capabilities for PowerClerk®, our industry-leading workflow software platform used by utilities and energy organizations across North America. PowerClerk is a business process automation solution that enables the no-code development and deployment of workflows, allowing utilities and energy agencies to efficiently design, build, rollout and evolve energy and utility programs online. The platform is used by some of the largest utilities in the United States and continues to expand into new markets and capabilities.

As a Technical Program Manager, you'll play a key role in bringing new product ideas to life. You will work closely with the Product Managers, Designers and Engineering teams to understand customer needs, identify opportunities for new features, translate ideas into clear specifications, and guide initiatives from concept through delivery.

You'll enjoy a highly collaborative environment where you'll help solve complex challenges, keep projects moving forward, and work closely with software engineers on feature development. You will be driving feature ideation, specifications and helping Engineering teams with project management and customer commitments. While the role is primarily focused on partnering with internal teams, you'll occasionally support customer-related discussions around product features, integrations, and delivery coordination.

An important aspect of this role is supporting CPR's compliance initiatives. You will lead and coordinate activities that support SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and other compliance requirements across the organization. In addition, you will help prepare technical responses to customer and prospect security questionnaires for PowerClerk, which play a critical role in supporting sales efforts and closing new business opportunities.

Duties & Responsabilities

  • Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to understand customer needs, business goals and product requirements

  • Manage project schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and customer commitments
  • Serve as a liaison between Engineering, Product, Design, Customer Success, and other stakeholders
  • Communicate project status, timelines, risks, and decisions to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Help define project goals, success metrics, and delivery expectations
  • Support Product Managers in customer-facing discussions related to integrations, technical requirements, and delivery planning
  • Help improve feature specification practices, development processes, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Support and coordinate compliance initiatives across the organization and with external auditors
  • Prepare and coordinate responses to customer and prospect security questionnaires, including the development and tuning of more efficient, AI-based approaches

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience delivering cloud-based software projects through the full product development lifecycle
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into clear and detailed technical specificationsStrong project management, planning, prioritization, and organizational skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives and adapt to changing priorities

  • Curious, eager to learn, and interested in developing deep knowledge of our products, customers, and technical environment

Our client is a well-established concierge, cash-pay physical therapy practice focused on pelvic health and women’s health. The practice provides high-touch patient care and supports patients dealing with sensitive concerns related to postpartum recovery, childbirth, miscarriage, pelvic health, and sexual wellness.

They are looking for a polished, emotionally intelligent, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Medical VA & Marketing Support to support patient communication, scheduling, intake, paperwork management, data entry, marketing support, and virtual receptionist duties.

This role is ideal for someone with strong English communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and experience supporting a concierge or cash-pay healthcare practice. The right candidate should be comfortable speaking with patients about sensitive women’s health concerns, confident with appointment setting and sales support, and able to help build and manage marketing workflows.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Patient Communication, Intake & Scheduling

  • Handle patient communication, care coordination, patient intake, and scheduling.
  • Manage virtual receptionist duties and support incoming phone calls through the Weave VOIP phone system.

Data Entry, Patient Paperwork & Administrative Support

  • Complete data entry with extremely high attention to detail.

  • Support appointment setting, customer service, and sales-related tasks.
  • Assist with Google reviews and patient follow-up related to reviews.
  • Support email marketing, text message marketing, social media, and basic SEO-related tasks.

  • Help build and start marketing workflows, since the client is looking to expand marketing efforts.

Tools You’ll Use

  • WebPT — primary EHR
  • Weave VOIP phone system
  • Google Suite
  • Outlook email
  • Email marketing and text message marketing tools
  • Social media platforms
  • Cloud-based and non-cloud systems as needed

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • Healthcare Administrative Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience in healthcare administration, patient coordination, medical office support, virtual receptionist work, or a similar healthcare support role.
  • Data Entry Experience: Required. Candidates must have strong data entry experience with extremely high attention to detail.
  • Patient Communication & Scheduling Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable handling patient communication, care coordination, patient intake, scheduling, and virtual receptionist duties.
  • Administrative & Patient Paperwork Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience supporting patient paperwork, forms, documentation, and administrative support tasks.
  • Email Marketing Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience with email marketing and be comfortable supporting marketing-related workflows.
  • Sales / Appointment Setting Experience: Required. Candidates must be confident with appointment setting, customer service, and sales support.
  • EMR / EHR Experience: Required. Candidates should have experience with multiple EMRs/EHRs. Experience with WebPT is preferred.
  • Concierge or Cash-Pay Medical Practice Experience: Preferred. Experience supporting concierge, cash-pay, physical therapy, women’s health, or pelvic health practices is highly valuable.
  • Marketing Support Experience: Required. Experience with social media, email and text message marketing, SEO support, Google reviews, and outreach messaging is a plus.
  • US-Based or International Company Experience: Required. Candidates with experience supporting U.S.-based or international companies are encouraged to apply.

Communication & Core Qualifications

  • Fluent English with minimal accent, as this is critical for a concierge practice.
  • Professional presentation and strong communication skills.
  • High emotional intelligence and comfort discussing sensitive women’s health topics.
  • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning multiple systems.
  • Self-starter, proactive, and able to think independently.
  • Comfortable with sales conversations, appointment booking, and patient follow-up.
  • Able to maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and empathy at all times.
  • Experience with parenting, motherhood, children, or childbirth is preferred.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

B2B Graphic Designer (Performance Ads – LinkedIn, Meta & Google) – Remote | EST

Position Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a B2B Graphic Designer to create high-performing static advertising creatives for cold B2B audiences across LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Display.

This is not a brand-design-only role. Your work will be directly connected to campaign performance, clicks, engagement, and conversions.

You’ll take campaign messaging, Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) insights, offers, and growth strategies and translate them into clear, compelling creatives designed to capture attention and drive action.

We’re looking for a designer who understands that successful performance creative combines strong visual design, messaging hierarchy, buyer psychology, and continuous testing.

If you design with performance in mind and enjoy using campaign data to make your next creative better than the last, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Performance Ad Creative Design

Create conversion-focused static advertising creatives for:

  • LinkedIn Ads
  • Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
  • Google Display Network

You’ll:

  • Translate campaign messaging into clear, scroll-stopping visuals.
  • Design creatives specifically for cold B2B audiences.
  • Develop multiple creative concepts and variations for testing.
  • Experiment with different headlines, layouts, imagery, and CTAs.
  • Adapt designs across platform-specific dimensions and placements.
  • Maintain visual clarity across desktop and mobile environments.
  • Ensure every creative communicates the core message quickly and effectively.

B2B Creative Strategy

Turn campaign strategy and ICP insights into effective visual concepts.

You’ll consider:

  • Target audience
  • Buyer pain points
  • Value propositions
  • Funnel stage
  • Campaign objective
  • Offer positioning
  • Messaging hierarchy
  • CTA placement

Rather than simply receiving a brief and producing a graphic, you’ll contribute ideas about how the message should be presented visually to maximize performance.

Creative Testing & Iteration

Support a structured creative testing process.

You’ll:

  • Develop multiple variations of winning concepts.
  • Create alternative headlines, layouts, CTAs, and visual approaches.
  • Support A/B and multivariate creative testing.
  • Review performance feedback from marketing teams.
  • Identify patterns across winning and underperforming creatives.
  • Iterate based on actual campaign results.
  • Help establish repeatable creative frameworks based on what works.

The goal is not simply to produce more designs — it is to continuously improve creative performance.

LinkedIn, Meta & Google Creative Optimization

Understand how creative requirements differ across advertising platforms.

Create platform-ready assets for:

LinkedIn

  • Sponsored content
  • Single-image ads
  • B2B lead generation campaigns
  • Thought-leadership and demand generation campaigns

Meta

  • Facebook and Instagram feed ads
  • Lead generation creatives
  • Retargeting campaigns
  • Prospecting campaigns

Google

  • Responsive Display campaigns
  • Display banners
  • Retargeting creatives
  • Multiple required dimensions and formats

Ensure creative remains visually consistent while being optimized for each platform and placement.

Collaboration with Marketing & Growth Teams

Work closely with:

  • Performance marketers
  • Demand generation teams
  • Growth marketers
  • Copywriters
  • Marketing leadership

You’ll:

  • Review campaign briefs and messaging frameworks.
  • Understand campaign goals before beginning design.
  • Translate copy and positioning into effective visuals.
  • Contribute creative concepts during campaign planning.
  • Incorporate performance feedback into future designs.
  • Maintain alignment between messaging, design, and funnel objectives.

Scalable Creative Production

Build systems that allow the team to produce and test creatives efficiently.

You’ll:

  • Create reusable design templates.
  • Build scalable creative systems.
  • Maintain organized asset libraries.
  • Develop repeatable campaign frameworks.
  • Maintain consistent file naming and version control.
  • Prepare final assets accurately for launch.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Maintain brand consistency without sacrificing testing velocity.

AI-Enhanced Creative Workflows

Use AI tools to accelerate creative ideation and production.

Tools may include:

  • Midjourney
  • Adobe Firefly
  • ChatGPT
  • Other emerging AI design and creative tools

Use AI to support:

  • Concept development
  • Visual ideation
  • Image generation
  • Creative exploration
  • Rapid iteration
  • Production efficiency

AI should improve your workflow and creative output — not replace strong design judgment.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 3+ years of professional graphic design experience, with strong exposure to B2B advertising or performance marketing creatives.
  • Portfolio demonstrating relevant work across:
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • Display advertising
    • B2B marketing campaigns
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Adobe Photoshop
    • Adobe Illustrator
    • Adobe InDesign
    • and/or Canva
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Conversion-focused design
    • Visual hierarchy
    • CTA placement
    • Typography
    • Layout
    • Advertising creative principles
  • Experience designing multiple creative variations for testing.
  • Understanding of designing for cold audiences.
  • Experience using AI tools within creative workflows.
  • Ability to work from marketing briefs, messaging, and campaign strategy.
  • Strong attention to detail and brand consistency.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Strong written English communication.
  • Availability during EST business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working directly with performance marketing or demand generation teams.
  • B2B SaaS, technology, agency, or professional services experience.
  • Understanding of performance metrics such as:
    • CTR
    • CPC
    • Conversion Rate
    • CPA
  • Experience interpreting creative performance data.
  • Motion graphics or basic animation capabilities.
  • Experience with additional AI creative tools.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as:
    • ClickUp
    • Asana
    • Notion
  • Experience building reusable creative templates and design systems.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Design for performance, not just aesthetics.
  • Understand how quickly an ad needs to communicate its message.
  • Know how visual hierarchy influences attention and action.
  • Understand B2B audiences and cold-traffic behavior.
  • Think about the relationship between copy and design.
  • Can translate ICP insights into visual concepts.
  • Enjoy creating multiple variations and testing ideas.
  • Don’t become overly attached to a creative when the performance data says otherwise.
  • Use feedback and campaign results to improve future work.
  • Can balance creativity with speed and production volume.
  • Use AI tools intelligently to accelerate your workflow.
  • Stay organized while managing multiple campaigns simultaneously.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing campaign briefs, ICP insights, and messaging.
  • Developing concepts for upcoming B2B campaigns.
  • Designing LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Display ads.
  • Creating multiple variations of headlines, layouts, and CTAs.
  • Collaborating with marketing teams on creative direction.
  • Reviewing performance feedback from existing campaigns.
  • Iterating on winning creative concepts.
  • Reworking underperforming creative approaches.
  • Using AI tools to accelerate ideation and experimentation.
  • Resizing and adapting creatives across advertising platforms.

  • Organizing templates, source files, and asset libraries.

In short: you turn B2B messaging and campaign strategy into performance-focused creative designed to generate attention, clicks, and conversions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Creative-driven improvement in CTR.
  • Conversion performance of advertising creatives.
  • Performance of A/B-tested creative variations.
  • Speed and volume of creative production.
  • Quality and consistency of campaign assets.
  • Ability to identify and iterate on winning creative concepts.
  • On-time delivery of campaign assets.
  • Alignment between creative execution and campaign objectives.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on paid marketing performance and revenue.
  • Creative ownership across LinkedIn, Meta, and Google campaigns.
  • Work closely with growth and demand generation teams.
  • Opportunity to see how your designs perform using real campaign data.
  • Continuous creative testing and experimentation.
  • AI-integrated design environment.
  • High ownership with room to influence creative strategy.
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Senior Performance Designer
    • Creative Strategist
    • Performance Creative Lead
    • Associate Creative Director

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Portfolio & Creative Review with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience designing B2B performance ads for LinkedIn, Meta, or Google and understand how to combine visual design, buyer psychology, messaging, and performance data, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is ideal for a designer who wants their work to do more than look good — it should capture attention, communicate value, and drive measurable action.

jobs.description:
Immunovant, Inc. is a clinical-stage immunology company dedicated to enabling normal lives for people with autoimmune diseases. As trailblazer in anti-FcRn technology, the Company is developing innovative, targeted therapies to meet the complex and variable needs of people with autoimmune diseases.

Organizational Overview:

Immunovant, Inc. is a clinical-stage immunology company dedicated to enabling normal lives for people with autoimmune diseases. As trailblazer in anti-FcRn technology, the Company is developing innovative, targeted therapies to meet the complex and variable needs of people with autoimmune diseases.

The Role:

Reporting to the Vice President, Data Management, this position is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership over the clinical data technology ecosystem, including eCOA/ePRO platforms, eDiary solutions, Medidata Rave (EDC), and Elluminate. This role is not directly responsible for hands-on clinical data management activities (e.g., data cleaning, query resolution, database lock); rather, it requires a strong clinical data management background to inform sound systems strategy, oversee system governance, and lead a team responsible for platform architecture, configuration, integration, and lifecycle management. The ideal candidate understands data management processes deeply enough to translate them into scalable, well-governed technology solutions, and brings proven experience leading systems teams. Serves as a key member of the Data Management Leadership Team, supporting cross-functional team needs and oversees the management of system related enhancements to support study deliverables. Interfaces with CROs and is responsible for managing internal Data Management team members.

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of clinical trial solutions personnel
  • Set systems strategy, roadmap, and performance metrics; conduct performance reviews and support career development.
  • Manage systems related budget, resourcing, vendor contracts, and staffing plans across concurrent systems and study portfolios.
  • Serve as a key member of the clinical data management leadership team, representing clinical systems in cross-functional governance forums.
  • Partner with (but do not directly own) the data management operations team and vendors, ensuring systems strategy aligns with DM process needs.

Clinical Systems Strategy & Governance

  • Own the enterprise strategy, roadmap, and governance model for core clinical data systems, including:
    • eCOA / ePRO platforms (patient/clinician-reported outcomes)
    • eDiary systems
    • Medidata Rave EDC
    • Elluminate (data review, aggregation, and analytics platform)
  • Define and maintain system governance frameworks: access management, role-based permissions, change control, and version control across platforms.
  • Establish standards for system configuration, study build templates, and reusable libraries to drive consistency and efficiency across studies.
  • Lead vendor management and contract oversight for all clinical systems vendors, including SLA definition, performance monitoring, and renewal/negotiation strategy.
  • Own system-related budget planning, licensing decisions, and total cost of ownership analysis.

System Implementation & Lifecycle Management

  • Lead selection, evaluation, and implementation of new clinical systems and platform upgrades, including RFP processes and vendor due diligence.
  • Oversee computer system validation (CSV/CSA) activities, ensuring systems meet 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, and data integrity requirements.
  • Direct system configuration, build, and testing activities for EDC, eCOA, eDiary, and Elluminate environments.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of clinical systems: onboarding, ongoing maintenance, periodic review, upgrades, and decommissioning/retirement/data archival.
  • Establish and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, and system uptime/performance standards in partnership with IT.

Integration & Interoperability

  • Lead architecture and oversight of system integrations (e.g., EDC-to-eCOA, EDC-to-Elluminate, EDC-to-IRT/RTSM/safety databases) to ensure seamless, accurate, and timely data flow.
  • Partner with IT/technical teams to define data integration specifications, API/interface requirements, and data mapping standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve systemic/integration-level issues, distinguishing systems-level root causes from data management process issues.
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI-enabled tools, and dashboarding/analytics capabilities to improve data flow visibility and reduce manual effort.

Compliance, Quality & Risk

  • Ensure clinical systems remain inspection-ready at all times; serve as the systems SME during regulatory inspections and audits.
  • Maintain SOPs, validation documentation, and system-level quality standards in partnership with Quality Assurance.
  • Monitor emerging regulatory guidance (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH E6(R3)) related to clinical technology and data integrity, and proactively adapt systems strategy accordingly.
  • Own risk assessments related to system changes, upgrades, and vendor transitions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary systems liaison to Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Quality, and IT.
  • Provide systems and technology input into protocol development, study design feasibility, and technology selection at the program level.
  • Educate and train clinical data management and cross functional staff on system capabilities, updates, and best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, health information, computer science, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in clinical data management and/or clinical data systems within pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO environments.
  • Strong foundational background in clinical data management (data cleaning, query management, database lock, DM planning) — this role oversees systems, not day-to-day data management operations, but requires fluency in DM processes to inform systems decisions.
  • 5+ years of people management experience, including managing managers or system-focused teams.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or administering:
    • eCOA/ePRO systems
    • eDiary platforms
    • Medidata Rave EDC
    • Elluminate
  • Strong knowledge of system validation (CSV/CSA), 21 CFR Part 11, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements governing clinical data systems.
  • Proven track record leading system implementations, upgrades, integrations, and vendor management.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections and audits related to clinical systems and data integrity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and trial phases (I–IV).
  • Familiarity with additional clinical technologies (e.g., IRT/RTSM, CTMS, safety databases, eTMF).
  • Experience with system integration architecture, APIs, and data pipeline/interface design.
  • Certification in clinical data management (e.g., CCDM), IT/systems (e.g., ITIL), or project management (e.g., PMP).
  • Experience with computer system validation methodologies and audit trail/data integrity frameworks.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic, technology-forward thinking paired with strong operational execution.
  • Deep understanding of clinical data management principles, applied through a systems and governance lens.
  • Excellent people leadership, coaching, and team-building skills.
  • Strong vendor management, negotiation, and contract oversight capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business/process needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.

Work Environment:

  • Remote-based
  • Dynamic, interactive, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial environment
  • Domestic or international travel are required (10-20%)
Salary range for posting
$260,000—$290,000 USD

Compensation is based on a number of factors, including market location, and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, dental, vision, 401k, and other benefits, including unlimited paid time off and parental leave.
