Work is what you do, not where you do it. We’re on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. We believe people should be able to work and learn together, whether they’re communicating across a table or across the world.

jobs.excerpt: About Wider CircleWider Circle is a mission-driven healthcare organization working to improve health outcomes for older adults and complex populations by addressing the social, clinical, and community barriers that keep people from getting the care they need.
jobs.description:
About Wider Circle

Wider Circle is a mission-driven healthcare organization working to improve health outcomes for older adults and complex populations by addressing the social, clinical, and community barriers that keep people from getting the care they need. We partner with health plans and local organizations to build trusted relationships with members, help them stay engaged in care, and support healthier lives in communities across the country.

About the Role

Wider Circle is entering a period of significant growth, and we are looking for a Director of Talent Acquisition to lead our recruiting function as we scale while maintaining quality, culture, and the candidate experience.

This is our first Director-level Talent Acquisition leadership role. You will own recruiting execution across business lines and support functions, lead and develop a growing team of Talent Acquisition Specialists, and strengthen the sourcing strategies, operating rhythms, dashboards, and standards needed to support rapid headcount growth.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will be expected to set direction, improve systems, coach recruiters, partner closely with leaders, and raise the bar on how Wider Circle attracts, evaluates, and hires talent.

You will also serve as a steward of our culture. Our “Love, Learn, Grow” ethos is central to who we are, and you will help translate that into compelling candidate stories, sourcing strategies, job postings, and hiring experiences that make people want to join Wider Circle and stay.

What You’ll Own

  • Recruiting Operations and Quality: Lead day-to-day recruiting execution across all hiring tracks, ensuring a consistent, high-quality process for candidates and hiring managers. You will establish clear expectations, run daily team huddles and weekly pipeline reviews, audit interview quality, drive scorecard completion, and coach the team toward consistent monthly hiring output.
  • Pipeline Performance and Metrics: Own recruiting performance reporting, including time-to-fill, funnel health, conversion rates, source effectiveness, recruiter productivity, and candidate experience. You will establish credible role-specific benchmarks, identify risks early, and ensure the team meets hiring goals without lowering the talent bar.
  • Strategic Sourcing and Community Partnerships: Build sustainable pipelines for high-priority roles, especially Community Health Workers and other frontline healthcare or community-based positions. You will map competitive markets, test sourcing channels, build partnerships, and develop strategies that make Wider Circle a more visible and compelling employer of choice.
  • Talent Standards and Hiring Manager Partnership: Partner with executives, directors, and hiring managers to clarify role requirements, keep job descriptions current, develop compelling candidate pitches, and ensure hiring decisions reflect both business needs and Wider Circle’s standards.
  • Team Leadership and Scaling: Manage, develop, and hold accountable a team of Talent Acquisition Specialists, with the ability to flex capacity through contract or 1099 recruiters as needed. You will foster a team culture grounded in urgency, ownership, accountability, and care for the candidate experience.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Create clear handoffs among Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, IT, Finance, HR, and business leaders so new hires move smoothly from offer acceptance to onboarding readiness.

Requirements

What You Bring

You have 7–10 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including at least 3 years in healthcare, human services, community health, or a related environment.

You have also:

  • Led a high-volume recruiting team, ideally supporting 50-100+ hires per month over a sustained period.
  • Recruited Community Health Workers, frontline healthcare workers, allied health professionals, or similar community-based roles.
  • Managed recruiters, including contract or 1099 recruiting resources.
  • Improved or scaled recruiting infrastructure, playbooks, dashboards, and operating rhythms in a high-growth or high-volume environment.
  • Used data to manage pipeline health, recruiter performance, time-to-fill, and sourcing effectiveness.
  • Communicated clearly and directly with senior leaders, including when the message involves risk, tradeoffs, or missed targets.
  • Written, tested, and optimized job postings for competitive hourly and professional roles, especially on Indeed or similar platforms.

How You Work

You are:

  • A systems-minded operator. You know how to strengthen what is working, add structure where needed, and help a recruiting function perform at a higher level.
  • A talent bar-raiser. You understand the pressure to fill roles quickly, but you do not confuse speed with lowering standards.
  • A data-driven leader. You track leading indicators, spot risks early, and use metrics to improve both recruiter performance and hiring outcomes.
  • A strong people manager. You know how to drive accountability, coach performance, and create urgency without micromanaging.
  • A practical problem-solver. You can zoom out to strategy and zoom in to unblock a requisition, improve a job post, or coach a recruiter through a difficult search.
  • Mission-driven. Wider Circle’s work at the intersection of community, health equity, and social care should genuinely energize you.

Nice to Have

  • Recruiting experience across all 50 states.
  • Familiarity with Community Health Worker certification frameworks or the community health workforce landscape.
  • Experience with Workable or similar applicant tracking systems.
  • Experience scaling a recruiting function in a startup or high-growth environment.
  • Background managing CHW, clinical, physician, or healthcare recruiter networks.

Benefits

What Wider Circle Offers

  • Base pay range of $115,000-$130,000
  • Annual incentive bonus
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) plan
  • Generous paid time off, including your birthday off and 9 company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with periodic travel to our growth markets
  • The chance to build something that matters — and to see the direct impact of your work on communities across the country

That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell — and our customers are the ones who tell it best. We are looking for a Regional Customer Marketing Manager to be the dedicated North American point of contact and in-region engine of our Customer Marketing function, turning NA customer voice into expansion opportunities, retention, and proof.

As the primary touchpoint for all North American customer marketing activity, you'll partner daily with NA Field Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, while working hand-in-glove with the central Customer Marketing team to land global programs — North American user groups, customer stories, speaker placements, and regional Customer Advisory Boards — tailored to the unique dynamics of the NA market with measurable commercial impact.

The through-line for FY27 is our AI narrative: every story, every regional event, and every executive touchpoint should reinforce why Smartsheet is the right partner for our North American customers' AI journeys. Your job is to make that narrative tangible through regional customer voice and proof points. You'll report into the central Customer Marketing team and can be based remotely anywhere in North America or from one of our NA offices.

You Will:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for all regional customer marketing activity, partnering daily with Field Marketing, Sales leadership, and Customer Success Managers to surface opportunities and prioritize programs.
  • Localize and deliver central Customer Marketing program in-region, including in-person User Groups, the customer stories program, speaker requests, and Regional Advisory Boards.
  • Build and maintain a regional pipeline of reference-able customers and advocates in partnership with Sales and CS — feeding the central reference program and ensuring Sales and ABM can pull stories and references in real time.
  • Identify, recruit, and prepare regional customer speakers for ENGAGE, regional summits, and third-party events.
  • Plug into Customer Lifecycle & Retention program (onboarding journeys, feature adoption, renewal touch points, reactivation) to ensure scaled lifecycle plays land in-region alongside the high-touch work of CS.
  • Tie every regional event and program to commercial outcomes — expansion pipeline, exec champion activation, reference creation — rather than satisfaction scores alone. Report regularly on pipeline influenced, references created, and advocate participation.
  • Collaborate with Community, ABM, and Customer Advocacy peers to ensure regional activity reinforces a single, consistent customer narrative.

You Have:

  • A proven track record running customer programs in-region — user groups, advisory boards, customer story production, or executive engagement — with measurable commercial impact.
  • A self-starter who can drive projects from concept through completion with minimal guidance, balancing multiple programs in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong cross-functional operator who builds trust quickly with Sales leaders, CSMs, and senior stakeholders, and is comfortable in a matrix global team.
  • Excellent storytelling instincts — you can spot a strong customer narrative, coach a customer through telling it, and shape it for the right audience (sales deck, keynote, analyst, press).
  • Data-literate and curious: comfortable defining KPIs, working in Salesforce and marketing automation tools, and reporting on pipeline influence, reference utilization, and program ROI.
  • Experience working alongside ABM, Community, or Lifecycle Marketing functions is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel in-region for customer events, summits, and RABs (typically 20–30%).

Why this role matters

Customer Marketing is the engine of social proof at Smartsheet — and the regional role is where central strategy meets the customers, sellers, and CSMs who turn it into pipeline and retention. If you want to own a region, build deep customer relationships, and shape how Smartsheet's AI story is told through our customers' voices, this is the seat. We're revolutionaries — changing the way the world works is all in a day's work. Join us.

  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans

$135,000—$160,000 USD

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. Do you get the same charge from concepting a full campaign as you do from turning around a killer Amazon listing before the end of day?

Can you jump from a paid social ad, to an email build, to a landing page, and make all of them feel unmistakably on-brand?

Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining grooming for the modern consumer. We’ve built one of the strongest paid acquisition engines in DTC, and our brand now needs to show up just as strongly in our customers’ inbox, their feed, their search results, and their doorstep. The next phase of growth means showing up with sharper, more consistent creative across every single one of those touchpoints.

We’re looking for a Visual Designer who can move fluidly across our full creative surface: Email, Paid Ads, Amazon, Web Assets, and Landing Pages. This isn’t a role where you specialize in one lane and stay there. One day you’re concepting a campaign end-to-end; the next you’re turning around a fast set of on-brand assets or building out an email send. If you love variety and want real ownership over the work you touch, this role is built for you.

You’ll work inside our design system every day in Figma, translating brand and platform guidelines into polished, production-ready creative that holds up whether it’s landing in an inbox, a feed, or an Amazon listing.

What You’ll Own

Expandir os negócios e lucratividade da Eurofins; promover as vendas intercompany no Brasil e no exterior; buscar a satisfação geral dos clientes regionais; expandir a marca Eurofins através de ações de marketing.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Desenvolver as vendas e atividades de marketing da Unidade de negócios para alcançar os objetivos de vendas e crescimento do EBIT na região;
  • Aperfeiçoar constantemente a eficiência das vendas intercompany, escolhendo os melhores parceiros dentre os laboratórios Eurofins e buscando novas oportunidades;
  • Acompanhar as tendências de mercado e atividades da concorrência para entender seus movimentos, preços e estratégias e introduzir mudanças quando necessário;
  • Participar do desenvolvimento do Planejamento Estratégico da empresa, bem como da elaboração do orçamento da área, garantindo o cumprimento dos objetivos de vendas determinados nos mesmos, observando a política de comercialização da empresa;
  • Prospectar e visitar clientes regionais para garantir a manutenção da carteira da empresa;
  • Visitar clientes expressivos para alavancar novos negócios, dando suporte ao time na fase final da venda, orientando seu processamento;
  • Acompanhar os projetos da carteira, visando identificar oportunidades de negócios;
  • Zelar pela imagem institucional da empresa (público interno e externo);
  • Monitorar metas e indicadores de desempenho de vendas;
  • Preparar relatórios de resultados, identificando necessidades de ajustes de politicas e estratégias para atingimento das metas da empresa;
  • Desenvolver estratégia para apoiar o crescimento da empresa;
  • Manter atualizado o networking, contatando antigos clientes e parceiros, desenvolvendo novos contatos, buscando divulgar o nome e produtos da empresa e realizar o fechamento de novos negócios;
  • Avaliar a viabilidade financeira de novos produtos, definindo preço, margem e pay back;
  • Promover as vendas regionais e estratégias de logística para superar os desafios relacionados à distância;
  • Realizar workshops, conferências, feiras e encontros com clientes internos para promover a marca Eurofins;
  • Participar ativamente em reuniões e eventos de clientes para desenvolver um conhecimento profundo das suas necessidades;
  • Avaliar se as análises devem ser internalizadas ou se devem ser realizadas vendas intercompany no grupo Eurofins;
  • Promover interação comercial entre as Unidades de negócio;
  • Contratar, motivar, desenvolver e reter colaboradores excelentes, que atendam o perfil buscado pela Eurofins;
  • Responsável pelo gerenciamento da equipe gerencial de uma determinada região;
  • Definir, comunicar e acordar metas com o time. Estabelecer KPIs com foco no cliente para monitorar o progresso. Acompanhar de forma apropriada e envolver-se diretamente na atividade, se necessário para o alcance dos objetivos;
  • Aperfeiçoar aspectos técnicos do time Comercial, assegurando o desenvolvimento apropriado do time, treinamentos e aplicação de novos processos;
  • Garantir que toda a equipe gerenciada conhece e executa os procedimentos internos e os fluxogramas de processo;
  • Revisar contratos de clientes;
  • Participar de feiras e eventos do setor visando manter-se atualizado acerca de novos mercados e tecnologias.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade, ou a critério de seu superior.

Competências comportamentais:

Formação requerida: Especialização/MBA completo ou Mestrado completo Meio Ambiente, Química, Ciências dos Alimentos, Agronomia, Farmácia, Biologia, Veterinária, Zootecnia, Engenharia Química, Nutrição, Marketing, Administração ou Gestão de Negócios.

Idiomas e nível esperado: Inglês fluente + Espanhol avançado.

Conhecimento técnico:

Microsoft Office;

CRM;

Sólidos conhecimentos do mercado de análises químicas e/ou ambientais;

Habilidades para a Gestão de Pessoas;

Técnicas de Negociação;

Técnicas de Vendas;

Conhecimentos de Marketing e divulgação de produtos;

Conhecimentos da rotina de análises químicas ambientais

Conhecimento da legislação ambiental vigente.

Benefícios que cuidam de você:

  • Health Care completo: plano de saúde e odontológico com operadoras reconhecidas no mercado.
  • Wellhub (GymPass): acesso a academias, aulas online, terapias, nutricionistas e outros serviços de bem-estar.
  • PsyMeet: plataforma de terapia online para apoio à saúde emocional.
  • Programas de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: acesso as plataformas de treinamentos e-learning, Academia Eurofins e outros modelos de capacitação profissional.
  • Convênio Educacional: parcerias com instituições renomadas de graduação, pós-graduação e escolas de idiomas com condições especiais para colaboradores.
  • Kit de Boas-Vindas: recepção especial no primeiro dia, com itens pensados para tornar sua chegada mais acolhedora.
  • Entre outros.

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis ​​e sustentáveis. Desde os alimentos que você come, até a água que você bebe, e os medicamentos nos quais você confia, a Eurofins trabalha com as maiores empresas do mundo para garantir que os produtos fornecidos sejam seguros, seus ingredientes autênticos e a rotulagem exata. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos.
Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 50.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado.

Em 2020, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 5,4 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client’s marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers’ Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers’ Associates to ensure that your assigned clients’ marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

  • Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well
  • Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing
  • Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you’ll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)
  • Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met
  • Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients
  • Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly
  • Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients
  • Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients
  • Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers’ demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly
  • Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue
  • Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director
  • Troubleshooting and assisting with any issues related to clients’ satisfaction and the performance of marketing campaigns as developed and executed by our team
  • Being able to effectively and productively work with any type of client with minimal supervision
  • Working on various tasks as part of the team of Account Managers
  • Participating in the Account Managers’ group calls
  • Participating in the training and skill-building sessions for Account Managers within the Service Department to improve their skills, performance, and overall expertise
  • Acting as a liaison between clients and cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of new services and products offered by Hustler Marketing
  • Continuously working to identify new opportunities to expand services offered to clients through regular communication and relationship building
  • Using data analysis techniques to create targeted campaigns for upselling our services to our client segments, and to present these service offers to clients in a compelling manner
  • Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Account Managers’ Lead, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director
  • Being available to assist with all internal service-related needs from other departments
  • Directly reporting to the Account Managers’ Leads, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be someone with extensive working experience in managing client accounts effectively, as well as experience in email marketing. Such experience should include managing a team consisting of marketing professionals (such as Account Managers’ Associates, Designers, Copywriters, and other team members) to deliver marketing campaigns that are focused on driving sales.

The Account Manager must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests from clients and must be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability.

The right person will be professional and also have considerable leadership and managerial experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with clients and internal teams. Having been an Account Manager before, or having any agency experience is a great advantage.

Familiarity with various tools such as Slack, Hubstaff, Asana, Klaviyo, and Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. The candidate should also feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Account Manager should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key Requirements:

  • At least 12 months of experience working in a digital marketing role, together with at least 6 months of working experience in an email marketing field (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have any account management or agency experience)
  • A proven track record of achieving success in a leadership role is a must, especially leading a team of creatives to deliver quality work that meets the needs of clients
  • Must have the ability to work independently without compromising on work standards
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically, as these skills are essential for meeting the needs of our clients and resolving any issues or queries
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department
  • Must possess great problem-solving skills as it is essential for working with clients and resolving any queries, complaints, or issues
  • Must have the ability to learn and adapt quickly, and possess excellent time management skills and high levels of focus, productivity, and efficiency
  • Any knowledge or experience with email marketing, e-commerce, or Klaviyo is a huge plus
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (i.e, 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team

It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.

At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.


Salary Range:

$97,000.00 - $145,000.00 per year.

Pay Transparency Statement:

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position across our US locations. The "pay scale" provided is a good faith estimate of the range the employer reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of hire. Actual salary will be determined based on various factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and specific geographic location.


Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; and paid time off including vacation, sick leave, and holidays.


Application Window:

This position is expected to remain open until . We recommend that interested candidates apply within 7 days of the posting date to ensure consideration.

Job Description:

So, what does a TaskUs Program Manager (PGM) really do? Think of yourself as the Architect for this strategic account. You are not just building training; you are building the roadmap, the processes, and the team that supports one of the most disruptive technologies in the world.

As the Program Manager, you will lead a high-performing team of Sr. Leads and Instructional Designers responsible for developing world-class training content. You are the bridge between the client’s complex technical requirements and the creative output of your team. You do not deliver the training; you ensure the content created is accurate, data-driven, scalable, and delivered on time. Your role was designed to map requirements, plan solutions, and successfully execute strategies. Your achievements are gauged not on hours worked, but on the success or failure of projects and launches. You balance the needs of multiple client stakeholders against operational targets while ensuring your team is engaged and performing at a world-class level. Your success is gauged by project success, client satisfaction, and the operational health of your program.

You love partnering with people to understand their needs and requirements and come up with creative approaches to make them successful. You care deeply about the overall business and look for ways to add value. You like being part of a team that delivers excellence. You’re entrepreneurial and resourceful. You’re passionate about making the world a better place. You like being held accountable for your own results. You are also able to balance the needs of your customers against operational targets while at the same time providing world-class service and satisfaction.

  • Assist with onboarding and upskilling new hires

  • Manage the project intake pipeline by reviewing incoming requests, identifying gaps, and ensuring all activate projects are assigned to appropriate team members.

  • Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of projects from initiation to completion, maintaining a high-level understanding of active work and resolving blockers or escalations.

  • Assign and monitor the completion of RN and SN, ensuring all data entered into tracking tables is complete and accurate.

  • Analyze team metrics regarding utilization (Target >85%), idle time (Target <6%), and non-project hours to ensure operational efficiency and data accuracy.

  • Conduct deep-dive reviews into Service Level Agreements (SLAs), over-effort hours, and L1/L2 KPI results to identify and address performance trends.

  • Lead daily standups, calibration sessions, and weekly leadership meetings to drive team alignment and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Execute Quality Assurance (QA/QC) oversight by spot-checking scorecards for Maintenance and New Builds to ensure quality standards are met prior to final delivery.

  • Compile and report team statistics and quality data for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and complete Weekly Status (WTS) updates by end-of-week deadlines.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client communications, responding to inquiries and managing client-requested tasks.

  • Support the onboarding of new team members and conduct regular one-on-ones to foster professional development and team stability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of large-scale project/program management experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in Learning & Development (L&D), Instructional Design, or Content Strategy.

  • 3+ years of people management experience (specifically managing other leads or creative teams).

Education
Bachelor’s degree in marketing or communications

How we behave

  • Stay Humble: We are team players who consider others’ interests as much as our own and know that only when the team wins, do we truly win.
  • Be Curious: We think deeply and creatively about the things we encounter with an insatiable desire to improve and a disdain for the status quo.
  • Invest In Others: We seek to be authentic and genuine with our teammates and our partners, because we care for them. We operate with integrity by saying what we do and doing what we say.
  • Sweat The Details: In our work and with our words, we are conscientious because the details make the difference.
Other things you should know
We're first and foremost a team; but that doesn’t mean this is a place to blend in. We are looking for creative, intelligent, opinionated, hard-working teammates who want their efforts and input to matter.

jobs.description:
COMPANY

RYZE Superfoods is looking for an Organic Social Editor to bring our truck tour to life across social. This role is all about turning raw, on-the-road footage into scroll-stopping, visually entertaining edits that capture the energy of our tour stops and make people stop scrolling. You'll work remotely, receiving iPhone and occasional DSLR footage from our events, and cutting it into content that performs across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
The truck tour is your primary focus, but this role is flexible — you'll also support other organic content needs as they come up, including evergreen posts and other short-form edits outside the tour cycle.
You'll report directly to our Sr. Social Media Editor and work closely with the broader content and brand team to keep our organic social presence sharp, fast-moving, and unmistakably RYZE.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsibilities will include:

  • Edit raw iPhone and DSLR footage from RYZE's truck tour into short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

  • Turn around high volumes of scroll-stopping edits on tight, tour-driven timelines

  • Cut footage with strong pacing, sound design, captions, and visual hooks that keep viewers watching

  • Collaborate with the Sr. Social Media Editor on creative direction, trends, and content strategy

  • Organize and manage incoming footage (ingest, backup, file naming/organization)

  • Stay on top of platform-native trends, sounds, and formats, and adapt tour footage to them quickly

  • Maintain consistent brand voice and visual identity across all edits

  • Jump in on other organic social editing needs as they arise — evergreen content, product/lifestyle posts, and other short-form edits outside the tour cycle


WHAT WE OFFER

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2–4 years editing short-form social content-TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts specifically. Not general video production; platform-native short-form is a distinct skill set.

  • Proven experience editing both DSLR and iPhone-shot footage — this is a must

  • A strong reel or portfolio of scroll-stopping, entertaining short-form social edits

  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut

  • A sharp eye for pacing, timing, and what makes content actually perform on social

  • Comfort working with high volumes of raw footage and fast turnaround times

  • Strong organizational skills for managing footage, assets, and version control remotely

  • Self-starter energy — you can take direction from the Sr. Social Media Editor and also bring your own creative ideas

  • A genuine interest in social trends, wellness/functional beverage space, or brand content is a plus

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

  • High-volume output mentality — not precious about content. Understands that tour-driven timelines don't wait. Can move from raw footage to polished edit fast, repeatedly, without quality slipping.

  • Pacing instinct — knows intuitively where to cut, when to hold, and what makes a viewer stay for the next second. This isn't a teachable skill so much as a trained eye that either exists or doesn't.

  • Hook-first thinking — starts every edit by identifying the moment that earns the first three seconds. Doesn't build toward the hook; leads with it.

  • Platform fluency — keeps a genuine, current pulse on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts formats, trending sounds, and native editing conventions. Applies them to tour footage without being asked.

  • Raw footage discipline — organized and systematic about ingest, file naming, backup, and version control. Knows that disorganized footage is a production risk, not just an inconvenience.

  • Adaptable creative — can take a creative brief from the Sr. Social Media Editor and execute it faithfully, and can also identify and pitch the moment in footage that nobody briefed for.

  • Trend velocity — identifies trending sounds and formats early enough to act on them, not after they've peaked. Moves fast enough to actually capitalize.

  • Remote-ready operator — functions independently without a physical team around. Manages their own deadlines, flags blockers early, and communicates progress clearly.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As an Account Executive you will be responsible for managing deal cycles from generation through to close. You will be the primary contact with the prospect and have the responsibilities of qualification, demoing, providing technical assistance, and negotiating contracts. We look for people who are curious, confident, and have a high technical aptitude. As an AE you are accountable for the plan to hit your goal and will enjoy the full assistance of the company to make you successful. You will be surrounded by a great team of people from whom you can learn from, that said, we also want to learn from you. Most importantly, we want entrepreneurs.

What you get to do every day

  • Work full cycle deals from demo complete to close.
  • Research and target companies using prospecting tools.
  • Build and manage a pipeline.
  • Learn and demonstrate our platform to new prospective customers.
  • Negotiate contracts
  • Record and document all sales activities in Salesforce.com.
  • Successfully utilize all sales tech tools.

What you bring to the role

  • You have at least 2 years of work experience in a sales role, preferably at a startup
  • Fluent in Spanish
  • You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding your quota
  • You love closing deals and helping businesses by delivering a product that has concrete value
  • You're solutions oriented- you recognize objections and help your customers see value in our product regardless of their knowledge of our industry
  • Extraordinary communication and interpersonal skills — people trust you and get the sense that you are advocating for something in which you believe
  • You have experience working with high-velocity sales cycles or selling to small businesses
  • You're resilient—you bounce back from setbacks quickly, are resourceful, and find creative ways to get things done
  • You're comfortable with a wide range of sales tools, including Salesforce or other CRMs
  • You have a passion for solving big problems and having an immediate and positive impact
  • Ability to embrace feedback and hold yourself accountable.
  • The ability to learn technology basics and apply them to business situations.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The total On Target Earnings (OTE) for the role described in this job posting is $150,000 - $155,000 which includes a base salary of $77,500 and a variable target compensation of $77,500. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

jobs.description:
deine aufgaben

Du möchtest täglich etwas bewegen? Als Sachbearbeiter:in Logistik (m/w/d) sorgst du dafür, dass unsere operativen Logistikprozesse im E-Commerce reibungslos ablaufen. Von der Bearbeitung von Bestellungen über die Belieferung unserer Marktplätze bis hin zur Abwicklung von Retail-Großaufträgen: Du unterstützt das Team bei allen zentralen Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft. Mit deinem Blick für Details und deiner Affinität zu strukturierten Prozessen stellst du sicher, dass unsere B2B-Partner und Kunden zuverlässig beliefert werden und die Abläufe effizient funktionieren.



Deine Aufgaben


  • Order Management: Du bearbeitest Bestellungen eigenständig und übernimmst die Lösung von Klärfällen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle Aufträge korrekt und termingerecht weiterverarbeitet werden.

  • Marktplatz- & Retail-Belieferung: Du koordinierst die Belieferung unserer Marktplatzpartner (z. B. Amazon, Otto, Zalando) sowie die Abwicklung von Großaufträgen für unsere Retail-Partner – von der Planung bis zur termingerechten Auslieferung.

  • Avisierung: Du übernimmst die Avisierung von Lieferungen an unsere B2B-Partner und stellst dabei sicher, dass alle relevanten Informationen korrekt übermittelt werden.

  • Schnittstellen-Kommunikation: Du fungierst als Ansprechpartner:in zwischen internen Teams (z. B. Supply Chain, Customer Service) und externen Partnern, um einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss und die termingerechte Abwicklung der operativen Prozesse zu gewährleisten.

  • Retourenmanagement: Du unterstützt bei der Abwicklung von Retouren und stehst dafür im engen Austausch mit unserem Logistikdienstleister, der unser Lager steuert.

dein profil

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im E-Commerce mit, idealerweise ergänzt durch Kenntnisse in der Marktplatz-Belieferung oder der Abwicklung von Retail-Großaufträgen.

  • Fachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis logistischer Abläufe, insbesondere rund um Retourenmanagement, Order Management und Avisierung. Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Logistikdienstleistern ist ein Plus.

  • Technische Kompetenz: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Sheets bzw. Excel und gehst strukturiert mit Daten um. Erfahrung im Umgang mit Shopify ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.

  • Tech-Affinität: Du bist offen für den Einsatz von KI-Tools und Automatisierungen und hast Lust, wiederkehrende Prozesse dadurch effizienter zu gestalten.

  • Kommunikation & Zusammenarbeit: Du bist kommunikativ, trittst gegenüber Logistikpartnern souverän auf und findest klare Worte, wenn es darum geht, Abläufe zu koordinieren oder Klärfälle zu lösen. Deine Schnittstellen-Kommunikation ist präzise und lösungsorientiert – intern wie extern.

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest verantwortungsbewusst, hands-on und strukturiert, behältst auch bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben den Überblick und triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen, um Prozesse effizient zu gestalten.



45.000 - 49.000 € / Jahr

Faktoren, die das Gehalt einer/eines Mitarbeitenden innerhalb dieser Spanne beeinflussen können sind unter anderem bisherige Erfahrung, Skills und Qualifikationen, die mit eingebracht werden und während des Bewerbungsprozesses bewertet werden.
On top profitierst du natürlich von unseren Benefits: Hier kannst du dich unter anderem auf ein eigenes Weiterbildungs- & Reisebudget sowie einen monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug freuen.

Diese Spanne spiegelt wider, was wir zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt für diese Stelle als faire Bezahlung einschätzen, kann sich durch unsere stetige Weiterentwicklung aber auch anpassen.

warum wir?

Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

  • Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.
  • Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt: Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget.
  • Echte Flexibilität: Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.
  • Onboarding: Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.
  • Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.
  • Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun: Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.
  • Alle zusammen: Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.
  • Office-Leben: Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!
  • Wir kleiden dich ein: Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

API Integration Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: API Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced MuleSoft Integration Engineer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration solutions on the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. In this role you will own the integration lifecycle, including API design, flow development, deployment, observability, and ongoing optimization. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on MuleSoft experience with strong API-led connectivity practices, and will partner with enterprise architects, application teams, and integration partners to deliver reliable, secure, and reusable integration assets. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integration flows in MuleSoft Anypoint Studio, including DataWeave transformations, error handling, and reusable connectors.
  • Apply API-led connectivity (System, Process, Experience APIs) to deliver reusable, composable integration assets.
  • Design and publish well-documented APIs using API Designer and the Anypoint Exchange.
  • Configure and manage runtimes (CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, Hybrid) appropriate to workload requirements.
  • Implement strong API security using OAuth2, mTLS, JWT, and Anypoint API Manager policies.
  • Build event-driven integrations using Anypoint MQ, Salesforce Platform Events, or Kafka.
  • Optimize integration performance, including pooling, caching, parallel processing, and message size management.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines for MuleSoft applications using Maven, Anypoint CLI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
  • Migrate legacy integrations from other middleware (Oracle SOA, BizTalk) to MuleSoft.
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting using Anypoint Monitoring and external observability tools.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to internal integration patterns and standards. Collaborate closely with security, enterprise architecture, and application development teams, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of integration experience with strong focus on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Anypoint Studio, DataWeave, and Mule runtime.
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity and RAML/OAS API design.
  • Hands-on experience with CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, or Hybrid deployment.
  • Experience with API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, JWT) and Anypoint API Manager.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD for MuleSoft.
  • Familiarity with event-driven integration using Anypoint MQ or Kafka.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience integrating with major SaaS platforms (Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow).
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Developer or Architect credentials.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud deployment of Mule runtimes.
  • Familiarity with FinOps and integration cost management.
  • Experience implementing zero-trust API security models.
  • Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs on Anypoint Platform.

Full-Time Telemedicine Provider (NP or PA) – Ohio (Remote)

SynergenX is seeking a full-time Telemedicine Provider to care for patients throughout Ohio via telehealth. Candidates must hold an active Ohio license and current DEA registration appropriate for practicing in Ohio. This is a fully remote, full-time W-2 position.

SynergenX is a leader in evidence-based hormone optimization and wellness care, providing comprehensive treatment for both men and women. This position will maintain a balanced patient population, with an approximately 50/50 focus on men's hormone replacement therapy (MHRT) and women's hormone replacement therapy (WHRT). Providers will evaluate, treat, and manage patients through individualized hormone optimization, medical weight management, and preventive healthcare designed to improve overall health, wellness, and quality of life.

This is an exciting opportunity for a compassionate, patient-focused Physician Assistant (PA) or Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) who is passionate about helping patients improve their quality of life through personalized hormone optimization and preventive healthcare. As SynergenX continues to grow, there are significant opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

We welcome applications from both experienced providers and newer graduates who have already obtained their required DEA registration and are ready to begin practicing. Candidates must possess an active DEA registration at the time of application, as the company does not reimburse or sponsor DEA registration costs.

We are seeking a provider who is available to begin employment with minimal delay and does not require an extended transition period. Candidates who can complete the hiring and credentialing process promptly are strongly preferred. This includes an active NPI without specialty focus, current board certification with documentation, a fully active and unencumbered Ohio advanced provider license, and active DEA registration in Ohio or able to transfer from current state.

Requirements

  • Strong clinical assessment and medical decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional patient communication and relationship-building abilities.
  • Active Ohio Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) license with appropriate APRN authorization to practice in Ohio, Family specialty only, or an active Ohio Physician Assistant license under your primary taxonomy NPI.
  • Current DEA registration appropriate for practice in Ohio, required at the time of application. No company reimbursement is provided.
  • Current National Provider Identifier (NPI) number without specialty.
  • Current national board certification applicable to your profession.
  • NPI number and board certification information must be disclosed during the application process to be considered for this opportunity.
  • All required Ohio licensure and prescribing credentials must be active and in good standing.
  • No current or pending malpractice lawsuits.
  • Experience or strong interest in men's and women's hormone replacement therapy, preventive medicine, or medical weight management is preferred.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is highly preferred.

Schedule

  • Full-time, Monday through Friday.
  • Patients are scheduled between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM in the eastern time zone.
  • Fully remote while providing telemedicine services to patients located throughout Ohio.

Training

  • Seven days of paid remote training covering the clinical protocols, systems, and processes needed to confidently and effectively begin seeing patients.

Compensation

  • $120,000 annually.
  • Full-time, exempt W-2 position.

Benefits

  • Fully remote position.
  • Company-provided IT equipment.
  • Company polos provided.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance eligibility after 60 days.
  • PTO begins accruing on your first day of employment, with increased accrual based on yearly tenure.
  • CME reimbursement and dedicated CME PTO.
  • Malpractice insurance provided.
  • Supervising/collaborating physician support provided as applicable.
  • Employee discounts.
  • 401(k) with company matching.
If you are passionate about helping patients achieve optimal health through evidence-based hormone replacement therapy and are looking to join an innovative, patient-focused organization, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to add a provider who is committed to delivering exceptional care and is prepared to join our growing team in the near term.

Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

Censys is looking for a Business Systems Analyst to own and optimize our internal systems ecosystem—ensuring our tools are integrated, adopted, and driving real business value.

About the role:

The Mobilization Operations Associate supports the systems, data, and logistics behind Indivisible's distributed grassroots mobilization work, across both Indivisible-led and coalition campaigns. That covers event operations, data infrastructure, and the sustained mobilization tools that keep grassroots members engaged between big moments. Reporting to the Associate Director of Mobilization Operations, this role works closely with the broader Mobilization team and coalition partners to keep host support, event logistics, tooling, and reporting running smoothly.

This role may require limited travel to support organizational priorities.

This is a full-time, short-term assignment anticipated to end on or before January 15, 2027. The salary for this position is $80,500 annually, and the role is expected to require 40 hours of work per week.

Indivisible offers a comprehensive employer-sponsored benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; a company-sponsored Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA); FSA with limited matching, and a 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 5% employer match. Employees are fully vested upon becoming eligible.

What you'll do:

Event & Host Operations (25%)
  • Maintain event listings and shift signups in Mobilize. Troubleshoot host and volunteer issues as they come in and maintain communication platforms to facilitate this.
  • Support host onboarding through distribution of toolkits, training materials, and providing day-of logistics guidance.
  • Staff and assist with coordinating coalition staff/volunteers in supporting host support channels/calls during high-volume mobilization moments and national days of action.
  • Track event performance (capacity, fill rates, turnout) and surface what's working, or what’s not, to the operations team.
Tools & Platform Support (35%)
  • Help maintain the sustained mobilization tools (EveryAction, NGP VAN, Mobilize, Freshdesk, etc.) that keep grassroots members engaged between major events. Document and escalate bugs and gaps to appropriate tool owners.
  • Stand up infrastructure quickly during rapid-response moments: new event pages, updated toolkits, revised host materials.
  • Support security monitoring and triage for distributed mobilization moments, following team protocols.
  • Supporting with mobilization related websites and their upkeep.
Data & Reporting (20%)
  • Provide support to coalition partners and event hosts on how to utilize their data from Mobilize, or other related systems.
  • Share updates on the current breadth and depth of mobilization campaigns.
  • Support the mobilization department in its implementation and maintenance of CRM systems.
  • Report and track state of incoming communications to coalition or campaign inbox systems.
  • Support applicants and grantees throughout grant cycles, including the reporting process
Coalition & Rapid Response Support (20%)
  • Provide day-to-day operational support to coalition partners running joint mobilization campaigns.
  • Triage incoming requests from field/state staff and route to the right person or resource.
  • Keep shared event, toolkit, and reporting systems current so partners can move fast.
  • Resolve support tickets in an efficient, effective, professional, and courteous manner for mobilization hosts, participants, and the public.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in organizing, campaigns, or mobilization work, including electoral, advocacy, or large-scale volunteer programs.
  • Working knowledge of EveryAction and Mobilize. Comfortable learning new tools quickly.
  • Strong attention to detail. This role is data- and logistics-heavy.
  • Able to stay organized and calm across multiple concurrent requests, especially during rapid-response periods when priorities shift fast.
  • Clear written communication. Comfortable producing host-facing materials and internal reporting.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting coalition or multi-organization campaigns.
  • Familiarity with Airtable, Formstack, or similar workflow/form tools.
  • Prior experience in a distributed/remote organizing environment.

About Indivisible Project

We’re building something new. We’re a progressive grassroots organization that began in the aftermath of Trump’s election. We’re working to build a democracy that reflects a broad, multiracial “we the people,” one that works for all of us and is sustained by all of us. To support this movement, we’ve built an incredible team at the national level. We dream big, we support each other, and we have fun doing it. For more information about Indivisible’s vision, mission, and theory of change, click here.

We’re changing what’s politically possible. Indivisible is part of the powerful progressive movement reaction to Trump, fighting the racist, misogynistic, plutocratic, and authoritarian agenda trumpeted by Trump and the GOP congress. Don’t take our word for it; Indivisible has been featured on the Rachel Maddow Show multiple times, as well as in the New York Times and in pretty much every other major news outlet in the country.

We’re building together. We’re building a new organization every day - a rare opportunity to model what we want to see in the world. We’re deeply committed to equity and building a diverse and inclusive organization.

We’re looking for you. If you want to fight for the soul of American democracy, there’s no better place to be than Indivisible. We’re looking for more team members who are passionate about building an inclusive democracy and committed to getting results. It’s an exciting, fulfilling place if you’re someone who wants to fight fiercely for the progressive world we want to have.

Every one of us on the national team is here because we believe this movement is the best way to retake and build progressive power in this country. Does that ring true for you? If so, great - throw your hat in the ring to join our team. Let’s start #winning together. For more information about Indivisible’s organizational principles, click here.

Indivisible Project is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage and seek applications from women, people of color, including bilingual and bicultural individuals, as well as members of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender communities.     • Prior experience working with Life Sciences companies

About Armaments Research Company

Armaments Research Company (ARC) is a technology company dedicated to bringing real-time situational awareness and battlefield logistics capabilities to the warfighter. You will be an integral part of the ARC team managing program execution in support of our innovative and powerful IoT devices to enhance national security.

Our core offering is the ARC AI-Enabled Weapons Sensor (AEWS), which collects and transmits real-time tactical data to the cloud. This information enables battlefield/tactical awareness and aggregated insights into big data sets that do not exist today. ARC technologies were initially developed in partnership with DARPA and the National Science Foundation and leverage internet-of-things (IoT) technology and machine learning to derive actionable insights and transform operational responses. This novel technology will be deployed at scale to enhance safety, decision-making, and sustainment for the warfighter at the tactical edge.

What You'll Do

ARC delivers artificial intelligence to the individual weapon, turning weapon systems into networked sensors that enhance warfighter situational awareness, survivability, and sustainment in contested environments. Our full-stack product spans an embedded IoT sensing device hosted in or on the weapon, intelligent mobile applications, and cloud-based analytics that aggregate device data into insights on weapon performance and mission-critical, situation-dependent data streams for our customers across national defense, law enforcement, and security.
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to work across the engineering organization (firmware, hardware, mobile, backend, and data science) as the connective tissue that keeps a complex, multi-domain product coherent. You will own the systems-engineering discipline: requirements, interfaces, architecture documentation, and the development processes that let a fast-moving startup ship reliable hardware-plus-software systems. This is not a paper-only role. We want an engineer who can dig into the technical substance across the stack, from a firmware timing issue or a sensor-integration constraint to a networking ICD or a cloud data pipeline, and weigh in credibly, then capture the decision so the whole team moves faster.

Role Responsibilities - How You Will Make an Impact

  • Serve as the systems engineer across the engineering team, bridging hardware, firmware, and cloud, and owning end-to-end system architecture and the interfaces where domains meet

  • Capture, decompose, and maintain current and future system requirements spanning the embedded device, mobile applications, and cloud analytics, and trace them from customer need through verification

  • Own the interface control documents (ICDs) and data contracts between firmware, mobile, backend, and data, driving toward machine-readable, version-controlled schemas that keep the BLE, WebSocket, and API contracts aligned as the device firmware and platform evolve

  • Dig into the technical detail as needed, across firmware behavior, sensor and hardware integration, power and timing constraints, networking protocols, and cloud data flow, and provide credible technical judgment to the responsible teams

  • Champion strong development processes (requirements management, design reviews, configuration and change control, and verification/validation) scaled appropriately for a startup

  • Own the creation of clear technical documentation: architecture descriptions, requirements, test plans, and decision records that keep cross-functional teams aligned

  • Drive system-level verification and validation, including component simulators, digital twins, and integration testing for functional verification and regression

  • Collaborate closely with mobile developers, firmware engineers, hardware engineers, and data scientists to design forward-thinking approaches to hard, multi-domain problems

  • This position requires travel less than 10% of the time in support of in-person events including system testing

Relevant Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in systems, electrical, or computer engineering, computer science, or a related field

  • 7+ years of engineering experience, with a track record spanning both hardware/firmware and software systems

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a systems engineer across disciplines, owning requirements, interfaces, and architecture on products that combine embedded hardware with cloud software

  • Hands-on depth in IoT and embedded systems: sensor integration, firmware/hardware interaction, wireless links such as BLE, constrained-network operation, and device-to-cloud data paths. Familiarity with embedded C, an RTOS such as Zephyr, and low-power wireless SoCs (e.g., Nordic nRF) is a strong plus

  • Strong grasp of networking protocols and interface control documents (ICDs)

  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic architectures and modern back-end/orchestration technologies

  • Working knowledge of decentralized identity management, including zero-trust frameworks

  • Excellent technical writing and documentation skills, with a bias toward making process lightweight and useful rather than bureaucratic

  • Experience in a start-up environment

Please note that any offer for employment will be conditioned on any required authorization to receive access to such restricted information and facilities necessary to perform the responsibilities of the position.

Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of U.S. Citizenship to meet federal government security screening requirements required for this role. The successful candidate must be a U.S. Citizen and otherwise eligible to obtain access to classified information and facilities necessary to perform the responsibilities of the position.

Strategic Planning & Execution
