jobs.description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

Remote positions open to candidates located in the United States.

The Director, Customer Success - Process Automation is a strategic individual contributor responsible for bridging the Customer Success and Support organizations with the internal technology and project management teams that power them. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy and systems delivery, this role serves as the primary liaison between the Chief Customer Officer's organization and both the Business Applications (BizApps) and Enterprise Project Management Office (ePMO) teams. The Director translates complex business processes, operational needs, and customer-facing workflows into clear system requirements, actionable Jira projects, and a prioritized capabilities roadmap — with a strong emphasis on workflow automation, AI-enabled customer experiences, and self-service innovation. This role requires equal parts business acumen, technical fluency, and cross-functional influence. May evolve to include direct team leadership as the function grows.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact between the Customer Success & Support organization and BizApps and ePMO, ensuring business needs are accurately captured, prioritized, and effectively communicated
  • Decompose business processes and operational requirements into well-defined system requirements, Jira epics, stories, and tasks that BizApps and ePMO teams can act on with clarity and confidence
  • Own and maintain the Customer Success, Subscription Renewals & Support capabilities roadmap, working hand-in-hand with BizApps and ePMO to align priorities, resources, and timelines
  • Identify, scope, and champion opportunities for workflow automation, conversational AI, and AI agent adoption that drive efficiency across Customer Success and Support
  • Partner with CS and Support leadership to identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for system-enabled improvement — including customer self-service, partner engagement, and operational workflows
  • Drive roadmap prioritization discussions, balancing business impact, technical feasibility, and strategic alignment with the CCO's objectives
  • Facilitate regular cadences with BizApps and ePMO to review backlog health, sprint progress, and upcoming milestones; establish delivery practices that bring clarity and consistency to cross-functional execution
  • Translate ambiguous or high-level business requests into structured requirements documentation suitable for technical teams
  • Monitor delivery of roadmap initiatives and communicate status, risks, and outcomes to CS and Support leadership
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships across Customer Success, Customer Support, BizApps, ePMO, and other cross-functional stakeholders including Sales and Finance
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the tools, systems, and platforms supporting the Customer organization — including CRM, automation workflows, and AI-enabled solutions
  • Provide input and recommendations on tooling decisions, platform configurations, and process changes that affect the customer-facing organization
  • Develop OKRs and success metrics to measure the effectiveness of delivered capabilities against business outcomes

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience and education preferred
  • 5+ years of leadership experience in cross-functional delivery, business operations, or a related role spanning Customer Success, Support, or Customer Experience within a SaaS company
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams (BizApps, IT, engineering, or ePMO), with a track record of translating business strategy into executable system requirements
  • Experience leading or contributing to initiatives involving workflow automation, conversational AI, LLMs, or AI agent technologies — particularly in support, self-service, or customer experience contexts
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce (SalesCloud, ServiceCloud, Experience Cloud, eCommerce) adjacent platforms such as Customer Success tooling (e.g., Gainsight, ChurnZero), Zendesk and subscription billing/revenue systems a plus
  • Experience engaging with a Project Management Office (PMO or ePMO) or working within formal project delivery frameworks
  • Experience managing or mentoring others in this domain is a plus; the role will likely lead to include managerial responsibilities
  • Proficiency with Jira or similar project/roadmap management tools; ability to create and manage epics, stories, and backlog items
  • Ability to establish and evolve delivery governance practices
  • Strong ability to decompose complex business processes into structured requirements and actionable work items
  • Exceptional ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders and business context to technical teams
  • Consultative approach with a proven ability to influence cross-functional priorities without direct authority
  • Strong analytical and process-oriented mindset with an eye for operational improvement and measurable outcomes
  • Self-motivated with the ability to operate with minimal supervision and drive clarity in ambiguous situations
  • Ability to build trust and rapport across leadership levels and functional teams

jobs.excerpt: Seu bem-estar, nossa missão.  Junte-se a uma empresa que torna o mundo mais saudável.
jobs.description:
Seu bem-estar, nossa missão. Junte-se a uma empresa que torna o mundo mais saudável.

CONHEÇA A GENTE

Estamos revolucionando o bem-estar corporativo. Nossa plataforma conecta colaboradores do mundo todo aos melhores parceiros em exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono – tudo em uma só subscrição. Com base em Nova York e equipe na Europa, América do Norte e América do Sul, nossa missão é fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

A gente acredita que o trabalho deve ser gratificante, inspirador e equilibrado. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma equipe que valoriza bem-estar, colaboração e perspectivas diversas, em um lugar onde paixão e criatividade rompem limites para criar impacto de verdade. Suas contribuições vão ajudar a construir um mundo mais saudável, para você e milhões de pessoas globalmente.

A OPORTUNIDADE

Estamos contratando uma pessoa Analista de CX em uma posição 100% afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência para se juntar ao nosso time de Business Transformation no Brasil!

Nesta função, você será o ponto de contato direto com os nossos usuários finais, garantindo uma experiência acolhedora, eficiente e de alta qualidade em todos os nossos canais de atendimento. Se você busca um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e focado em causar um impacto positivo na vida das pessoas, essa oportunidade é para você!

SEU IMPACTO

  • Garanta a satisfação e o encantamento dos nossos usuários finais por meio do atendimento em múltiplos canais (e-mail, chat e telefone).
  • Forneça soluções precisas e completas para dúvidas e solicitações, utilizando metodologias e ferramentas estruturadas.
  • Construa relações de confiança com os clientes por meio de uma comunicação empática, clara e transparente.
  • Mantenha os registros no sistema CRM atualizados, categorizando tickets de forma ágil e realizando o acompanhamento até a resolução final.
  • Siga os processos e políticas internas, identificando tendências de problemas e escalando pontos críticos para a liderança quando necessário.
  • Atinja metas individuais e de equipe em produtividade e qualidade, colaborando diretamente com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Atue no processamento de aprovações e reembolsos, garantindo a melhor experiência do usuário.
  • Viva a missão: inspire e empodere outras pessoas ao priorizar seu próprio bem-estar e de seus colegas. Crie um ambiente de apoio onde todas as pessoas se sintam à vontade para cuidar de si mesmas e encontrar um equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal.

QUEM É VOCÊ

  • Ensino Médio completo (ensino superior será considerado um diferencial).
  • Vaga afirmativa e exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência.
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente, suporte multicanal e comunicação escrita.
  • Conhecimento ou facilidade de aprendizado com ferramentas de CRM (diferencial para Zendesk).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita, fluência em português e facilidade com ferramentas digitais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no turno da tarde/noite.

Mesmo que você não corresponda a 100% dos requisitos da vaga, se candidate! Teremos o maior prazer em receber a sua inscrição e analisar a sua adequação à nossa equipe. Lembre-se apenas de observar que a experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente, suporte multicanal e comunicação escrita são obrigatórias para esta função específica.

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

Criamos um ambiente de trabalho para você prosperar em todas as dimensões da sua vida. A gente faz isso por meio de benefícios bem pensados, recursos para o bem-estar emocional e uma cultura que empodera cada pessoa a realmente se conectar com seu papel aqui e ser dona dele, balanceando isso com o próprio bem-estar.

Nosso programa de benefícios flexíveis ajuda você a customizá-los de acordo com as suas necessidades!

Nossos benefícios incluem:

WELLHUB: Plano Gold+ gratuito, com acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios, programas fitness digitais e recursos online para meditação, nutrição, suporte de saúde mental, rotina de sono e mais. Você também pode adicionar até 3 familiares ao seu plano, garantindo que quem mais importa para você tenha acesso a bem-estar.

WELLZ: Um recurso único e completo para o bem-estar mental. O Wellz oferece jornadas personalizadas que combinam sessões semanais de terapia cognitivo-comportamental (52 por ano) e conteúdo à demanda.

SAÚDE E CUIDADO: Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida.

TRABALHO FLEXÍVEL: Com o regime de trabalho que prioriza flexibilidade, a gente oferece vagas híbridas e remotas, para que tenha a liberdade de trabalhar do jeito que funciona melhor para você. O modelo de trabalho desta vaga específica pode ser discutido com a pessoa recrutadora e com a liderança. Quando você entrar no Wellhub, também pode usar o nosso reembolso de home office para montar o seu escritório em casa!

DESCANSO REMUNERADO: Se desconectar e recarregar as energias é muito importante. Por isso, oferecemos férias após 6 meses de trabalho + 3 dias de folga por ano + 1 dia de folga a cada ano na empresa (somando até 5 dias) + 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário!

LICENÇA PARENTAL REMUNERADA: Receber um novo membro na família é um dos momentos mais especiais da vida. Queremos que cada pessoa colaboradora possa estar presente de verdade e aproveite esse tempo em família. Por isso, oferecemos licença parental 100% remunerada a todos os novos pais. Quem dá à luz também tem direito à licença estendida (Empresa Cidadã) e a um período de adaptação (ramp-back), em que pode trabalhar meio-período até se ajustar à nova rotina.

DESENVOLVIMENTO PROFISSIONAL: Tenha acesso a plataformas globais de aprendizado, participe de sessões interativas, construa seu mapa de desenvolvimento personalizado e explore nossas oportunidades internas. Aqui, a gente foca em aprendizado e feedback contínuos para apoiar sua jornada em direção ao sucesso – tanto pessoal quanto profissional.

CULTURA: Você vai se juntar a uma equipe de pessoas dedicadas, que se unem para romper limites, apoiar umas às outras e criar impacto duradouro no bem-estar corporativo. Nós vencemos em conjunto, cultivando relações de confiança por meio de comunicação transparente e de uma cultura em que cada perspectiva importa. Entenda mais sobre nossos valores e cultura.

Quer ver como é realmente trabalhar aqui? Siga a gente no Instagram @lifeatwellhub e assista ao vídeo do nosso time no YouTube!

Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento @ Wellhub

Buscamos criar um ambiente colaborativo, acolhedor e inclusivo, onde todo mundo sinta que faz parte.

O Wellhub é um empregador comprometido com a promoção de oportunidades equitativas. Todas pessoas qualificadas que se candidatarem serão igualmente consideradas, sem discriminação por raça, religião, cor, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência física ou mental não desqualificante, nacionalidade, condição de veterano ou qualquer outra base coberta pela lei apropriada.

Nosso compromisso com a inclusão também se estende à forma como reconhecemos e remuneramos nossas pessoas colaboradoras. Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa Syndio Fair Pay Certified, um certificado que reflete a nossa dedicação contínua a práticas de remuneração justas e equitativas em toda a nossa equipe global. Leia mais aqui.

Dúvidas sobre como tratamos seus dados pessoais? Consulte nosso Aviso de Privacidade do Candidato a Emprego.

o Invoice creation

C. Systems, Feedback & Continuous Improvement
These responsibilities apply across both team and open training.

Hast du schon einmal erlebt, wie eine einzige gut formulierte Antwort aus einem frustrierten Kunden wieder einen zufriedenen macht?

Hast du schon einmal erlebt, wie eine schnelle, faire Lösung eine schlechte Bewertung verhindert, bevor sie überhaupt entsteht?

Hast du schon einmal erlebt, wie dein eigenes Handeln in wenigen Minuten darüber entscheidet, wie ein ganzes Unternehmen wahrgenommen wird?

Ja?

Jeden Tag entscheidet sich bei ArtiTree in genau solchen Momenten, ob aus einem Kunden ein wiederkehrender Kunde wird. Wir akzeptieren nicht, dass in der stärksten Zeit des Jahres Anfragen liegen bleiben oder sich Kunden allein gelassen fühlen. Unser Antrieb ist es, jedem einzelnen Anliegen innerhalb von 48 Stunden eine echte Lösung zu geben , ob schriftlich oder persönlich in jedem Fall aber fair.

Jeder Mensch in unserem Kundenservice-Team verändert mit seiner Arbeit, wie tausende Kunden ArtiTree in der wichtigsten Zeit des Jahres erleben.

Ja, du wirst von Tag eins an strukturiert eingearbeitet und arbeitest mit klaren Prozessen in Zendesk. Das ist für uns selbstverständlich. Wir sind ein wachsendes E-Commerce-Unternehmen für künstliche Weihnachtsbäume und haben eine klare Haltung: Kundenservice ist für uns kein Kostenpunkt, sondern der Ort, an dem wir uns das Vertrauen unserer Kunden verdienen.

Bist du an Board?

Wir sind ArtiTree und suchen für unsere stärkste Saison des Jahres, Oktober bis Dezember/Januar, Verstärkung für unseren schriftlichen Kundenservice über Zendesk.

dein verantwortungsbereich

  • Ticket-Bearbeitung: Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen schriftlich über unser Ticketsystem Zendesk (per E-Mail und Chat).

  • Amazon-SLA: Du stellst sicher, dass Amazon-Anfragen innerhalb von 24 Stunden beantwortet werden (auch am Wochenende).

  • Erstattungen & Retouren: Du bearbeitest Erstattungen und Retouren korrekt und inklusive Mehrwertsteuer-Berechnung.

  • 48h-Lösungsziel: Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Ticket innerhalb von 48 Stunden final gelöst wird.

  • Reputationsschutz: Du schützt aktiv unsere Reputation auf Amazon, unserem wichtigsten Vertriebskanal, denn Bewertungen dort können weder beantwortet noch gelöscht werden.

dein profil

Must-have

  • Kundenservice-Erfahrung: Erfahrung mit Zendesk, JTL (oder anderen komplexen Warenwirtschaftssystemen) im schriftlichen Kundenkontakt, z. B. per E-Mail oder Chat.

  • Zahlenverständnis: Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen, z. B. bei der Berechnung von Erstattungen inklusive Mehrwertsteuer.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute, verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2) für eine kompetente und schriftlich wie mündlich professionelle Kundenbetreuung.

  • E-Commerce: Erfahrung im E-Commerce oder mit Amazon Seller Central.

Nice-to-have

  • Saisonerfahrung: Erste Erfahrung mit saisonalen Belastungsspitzen, z. B. im Weihnachtsgeschäft.

warum artitree?

jobs.description:
Business Unit: Rick Hansen Foundation School Program

Reports to: Manager, Rick Hansen Foundation School Program

Start Date: October, 2026

Status: Full-time, Ongoing

Salary Range: $50,000.00 to $60,000.00 per year

Location: Remote

Founded on the legacy of Rick Hansen’s Man In Motion World Tour, the Rick Hansen Foundation (RHF) is a Canadian registered charity with the vision of creating a fully inclusive and accessible world where people with disabilities are living to their full potential. Through our programs and partnerships, we break down barriers for people with disabilities by changing attitudes, creating accessible spaces, and inspiring an inclusive society.

RHF is a dynamic and rewarding place to work and our success begins with our people. We are committed to building a diverse workforce representative of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates including Indigenous peoples, individuals of all genders and sexual orientation, race, ethnic origin, all abilities, age, and religions and anyone living at the intersection of these identities.

Preference will be given to applicants who are persons with disabilities, and we highly encourage qualified persons with disabilities to apply. We invite you to disclose your disability in your cover letter, if you feel comfortable.

If you’re interested in being a part of our innovative team, we hope that you will consider this opportunity with us. If you do not meet the required education, experience and skills but have a combination of lived and professional experience, we encourage you to apply.

JOB SUMMARY

As part of the Rick Hansen Foundation School Program (RHFSP) team, the Youth Engagement Coordinator is responsible for direct engagement with youth with and without disabilities via the RHFSP Youth Leadership Committee, the RHFSP Difference Maker of the Year Awards, and the global Youth Leadership Network.

This position is responsible for the RHFSP Difference Maker of the Year Awards including nominations, delivery of the awards, and recognition of award recipients. In addition, the Youth Engagement Coordinator, RHFSP acts as the point of contact for Youth Leadership Committee members, ensuring mentorship activities include advocacy, networking and skills training, to encourage members to become inclusion and accessibility leaders. The role will help to grow the School Program moving forward via the establishment of a global Youth Leadership Network and expanding the Difference Maker of the Year Award internationally.

WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Reporting to the Manager, RHFSP, the Youth Engagement Coordinator works closely with the RHFSP team, the Marketing Communications team, external and international partners, and youth committee and network members, and award recipients.

ALL STAFF: KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

As an integral member of the RHF team and as expected of all staff, this position actively participates with:

  • Strategy
  • Organizational Culture
    • Contributes to regular sessions, develops goals, supports and implements action plans.
  • Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility (IDEA)
  • Values
  1. We Collaborate Authentically
  2. We Engage Respectfully
  3. We Keep Our Promises

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Difference Maker of the Year Awards:

  • Responsible for the seamless planning and execution of the RHFSP Difference Maker of the Year Awards from start to post awards;
  • Works closely with the Manager, RHFSP on the nomination process including the equitable review of nominations and works closely with the Marketing and Communications team to promote and encourage nominations;
  • Acts as the main point of contact for the awards including past and present nominators, nominees and recipients;
  • Responds to general inquiries received related to the awards;
  • Works closely with the Manager, RHFSP on the development of a plan to expand the awards in a phased approach globally and leads in the execution, including the development of international partnerships to extend reach; and
  • Responsible for coordinating various project, including monitoring timelines and deliverables and following up with various parties to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

Youth Leadership Committee & Network:

  • Acts as the main point of contact for the RHFSP Youth Leadership Committee (YLC) members;
  • Facilitates the smooth onboarding and offboarding of Youth Leadership Committee members per their Terms of Reference, and ensuring compliance with safeguarding requirements including completed Vulnerable Sector Checks;
  • Research and coordinates mentorship opportunities for the YLC for building advocacy and networking skills, and selects guest speakers as appropriate for monthly committee meetings;
  • Provides leadership to YLC members, ensuring they set appropriate annual project(s) and successfully complete their project(s); and
  • Contributes to the development of a new global Youth Leadership Network and leads in the execution of those plans, ensuring input from youth audiences.

General:

  • Ensures ongoing and accurate program data and reporting is captured in Salesforce;
  • Contributes to annual year-end survey, reports and funder stewardship reports;
  • Prepares Purchase Orders, invoices, Request for Proposals, contracts, Contract Approval Forms, and expense claims, as needed, related to youth engagement activities;
  • Actively contributes to ongoing team meetings, brainstorms and discussions on program expansion and optimization;
  • Contributes to research and other special projects as required;
  • Maintains and applies current knowledge of relevant standards and practices related to key accountabilities; and
  • Performs other related duties in keeping with the purpose and accountabilities of the position.

QUALIFICATIONS

An equivalent combination of education, experience and skills/behaviours will be considered.

Education: University degree in relevant discipline or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Lived experience with a disability or demonstrated connection to youth‑serving communities may be considered an asset in lieu of formal education.

Certification/Designations: None.

Experience/Knowledge:

  • Minimum 3 years of related experience in program coordination, youth engagement and facilitation, or equity focused practice;
  • Demonstrated experience supporting youth‑focused programs and/or event planning, outreach initiatives, or relationship management;
  • Demonstrated experience working with youth and effectively engaging youth audiences;
  • Computer skills required include:
    • Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook;
    • Experience with virtual meeting/webinar technology (i.e., Zoom, MS Teams);
    • Experience using AI-enabled tools responsibly, such as Copilot, preferred;
    • Experience with databases, Salesforce and/or other CRM databases are assets.
  • Knowledge of program management and development of policies and procedures;
  • Non-profit experience is an asset; and
  • Knowledge of accessibility, disability inclusion, and the experiences of people with disabilities is preferred.

Skills/Behaviours:

  • Effective oral and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and inclusively with youth, partners, and internal teams;
  • Ability to build trusting, respectful relationships with youth from a variety of backgrounds and experiences;
  • Effective interpersonal, relationship and team-building skills;
  • Effective coordination, organizational, time management and problem-solving skills;
  • Ability to be flexible, creative, and professional when responding to changing needs;
  • Ability to handle sensitive information and maintain confidentiality;
  • Proven ability to pay close attention to detail;
  • Commitment to inclusive, accessible, and trauma‑informed engagement practices;
  • Experience with data collection, evaluation and survey administration is an asset;
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality; and
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as a team player in a fast-paced environment.

Vulnerable Sector Check

The successful candidate will be required to complete a Vulnerable Sector Check which confirms that you have not been convicted of any criminal offence which would exclude you from holding this position, and that you continue to maintain a clean criminal record during employment.

How To Apply

If you are interested in being a part of our innovative team and are passionate about making a difference, we hope that you will consider a career with us.

The Rick Hansen Foundation is committed to providing accommodations to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Please let us know if you require a specific accommodation (i.e. virtual interview, closed captioning) so that arrangements can be made.

Interested and qualified candidates can apply by quoting #2026-11 by September 4, 2026. While we thank all applications for their interest, only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

PulseSafety is a public safety technology startup building CommandCORE, an operations management platform for law enforcement agencies. We were founded from inside a law enforcement agency, so the product is grounded in real-world experience. But no single perspective covers everything. We're looking for a current or former law enforcement professional to serve as an advisor and bring perspective we don't have: different agency sizes, different roles, different regions, different ways of doing the job. This is a low-time-commitment advisory role, not an operational or sales position.

Tasks

  • Review features and workflows in development and give candid feedback on what would work in the field and what would not.
  • Serve as a sounding board on law enforcement practices, terminology, and agency operations outside the founder's direct experience.
  • Share perspective on how different roles (patrol, supervisors, records staff, command, animal control, victm services, IT, etc.) would interact with the platform.
  • Flag practical, policy, or cultural considerations that software builders commonly miss.
  • Occasionally review marketing or product materials for accuracy and credibility with an agency audience.
  • Meet with the founder on a recurring basis, typically three to four hours per month, with occasional async feedback in between.

Requirements

  • Current or former sworn law enforcement experience (officer, deputy, supervisor, command staff, or comparable role).
  • Current or former civilian law enforcement experience ( animal control, records officer/clerk, reception, compliance, victim services, fleet, etc.)
  • Retired professionals are very welcome.
  • Hands-on familiarity with day-to-day agency operations: shift work, scheduling, fleet, briefings, records, or administrative workflows.

  • Defining the security standard for our product-team deployments and applications.

  • Driving developer engagement with security through initiatives like Security Champions programmes, workshops, lunch-and-learns, and the security health score initiative.
  • Collaborating with product teams on threat modelling and translating compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2) into clear technical specs.
  • Hardening CI/CD pipelines and ensuring actionable, relevant security checks.
  • Working with Security Operations Engineers to automate security incident triage, removing noise to prioritise high-signal alerting.

What You Must Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related Software Engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in Software Engineering or DevOps, with at least 3 of those years specifically focused on application security.
  • Strong communication skills to translate technical vulnerabilities into business and engineering impact.
  • Experience with cloud security (AWS) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
  • Proficient in architecting and developing secure applications (preferably in Java).
  • Proficient in scripting (Python, Bash, Go) for automation of security tasks.
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD systems and embedding security checks without slowing delivery.
  • Proven ability to independently define security standards, drive adoption across engineering teams, and manage a Security Champions programme.
  • Advantageous: AppSec fundamentals (OWASP Top 10, dependency management, OAuth2/OIDC), experience with SonarQube and CrowdStrike.

For us to achieve our ambitious vision together as a team, it is important for our Martians to lead at all levels, be self-starters who take ownership of their work, and continuously push the boundaries of what is possible.   • Seeking continuous feedback and actively taking steps to continuously grow personally and professionally.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

About Us

Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day.

As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support. We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to protecting data and managing risk.

The Role

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering owns the operations and component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate - the infrastructure that underpins software processing critical market and metering data at national scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build and run cloud-native platforms combining AWS-native services with open-source components, and carry end-to-end accountability for how that estate performs, costs, and stands up to scrutiny.

Beyond architecture and operations, you will own FinOps and security for the cloud estate, and act as the accountable owner for its overall fitness for purpose - resilience, performance and scalability - as Flui's platforms scale to support a growing and increasingly complex utility market. You will work closely with the engineering leadership to ensure architecture decisions serve both the product roadmap and the operational realities of running critical infrastructure.

The role suits someone who wants to remain genuinely hands-on with design and build, while holding single-point accountability for how well the cloud estate is run, secured and paid for.

Job Responsibilities

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for:

  • Owning the component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate, spanning AWS-native services and open-source/self-managed components (e.g. container orchestration, messaging, data stores, observability tooling).

  • Operating and continuously improving the platforms underpinning MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, with direct accountability for their resilience, performance and scalability at national-scale transaction volumes.

  • Designing and maintaining disaster recovery, high-availability and capacity plans appropriate to platforms supporting critical utility market infrastructure.

  • Owning FinOps for the cloud estate: cost visibility, forecasting, tagging and allocation, and driving measurable, ongoing cost optimisation without compromising reliability.

  • Owning cloud security posture: identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, and ensuring the estate operates in line with Flui's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and wider compliance obligations.

  • Defining and maintaining the non-functional standards ('fitness for purpose') that platforms must meet - resilience, performance, scalability and observability - and holding engineering teams to them through architecture review and guardrails.

  • Remaining hands-on: designing, building and, where appropriate, personally implementing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and platform tooling alongside the wider engineering team.

  • Owning operational rigor for the estate - incident management, on-call practice, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of SRE practices.

  • Making and owning build-vs-buy and AWS-native-vs-open-source decisions, balancing cost, control, operability and vendor lock-in.

  • Managing key vendor and technical relationships, including AWS itself and providers of critical open-source or commercial platform tooling.

  • Partnering with the product/engineering leadership to ensure cloud architecture decisions support the product roadmap and time-to-market, and recruiting/developing a small, high-calibre platform engineering team as the estate grows.

  • Championing knowledge sharing and technical education across engineering - documenting architecture decisions and standards, running internal sessions on cloud and platform practice, and mentoring engineers and technical colleagues to raise the wider team's capability.

Essential Competencies and Experience

Business Acumen

  • Demonstrable experience owning cloud platforms supporting a regulated, high-availability or critical-infrastructure business.

  • Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and operational reality - cost, risk, and delivery pace.

  • Understanding of the utility/energy sector's data and resilience expectations is an advantage.

Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

  • Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, storage, networking, data and security services, ideally evidenced by current AWS certification(s).

  • Proven experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms that combine AWS-native services with open-source components (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent messaging, Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent observability).

  • Track record of owning a FinOps practice and delivering demonstrable, sustained cloud cost savings.

  • Strong cloud security background - IAM, encryption, vulnerability management - and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001.

  • Experience defining and meeting non-functional requirements: high availability, disaster recovery, performance/load testing and scalability at production scale.

General

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and mature CI/CD practice.

  • Comfortable operating hands-on day to day while also owning strategy, standards and team development.

  • A track record of sharing knowledge and raising technical capability across a team or wider engineering community - through documentation, mentoring, or internal training.

  • Willingness to participate in on-call/incident response as needed for platforms supporting critical services.

Job Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is a bonus, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Current AWS certification(s) - e.g. Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty - highly desirable.

Your Personal Characteristics Will Include

  • A pragmatic engineer-leader: hands-on by instinct, comfortable balancing strategic ownership with keyboard time.

  • Security and cost-conscious by default, without losing sight of reliability and delivery speed.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with a methodical approach to incident response.

  • Curious and current - actively tracks the evolving cloud and open-source ecosystem.

  • Advocates simplicity and resists unnecessary complexity or over-engineering.

  • A clear communicator, able to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for the leadership team.

  • A natural teacher and mentor, who enjoys raising the technical capability of colleagues and peers, not just delivering the work themselves.

Job Title: Local Operations Manager (Sponsor Dedicated, Oncology)

Overview

  • Services rendered will adhere to applicable Sponsor SOPs, WIs, policies, codes of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), local regulatory requirements, etc., while serving as a subject matter expert and resource for quality and compliance standards across assigned studies.

  • Complies with relevant training requirements and maintains advanced therapeutic, operational, and regulatory knowledge applicable to assigned programs.

  • Leads and contributes to quality Site Selection through participation in site feasibility ensuring consistent conduct of site qualification visits and appropriate follow-up of site qualification visit reports and country feasibility reports. Collaborates with central study teams and local stakeholders as applicable for final selection of sites to participate in trials and provides strategic recommendations for site selection and performance optimization.

  • Ensures local/country team is meeting recruitment targets with high quality data on time and within study budget by providing strategic input to study-level documents and independently leading/coordinating local team activities in compliance with SOPs, other procedural documents, and applicable regulations. This may require development of local trial-specific procedures and tools, recruitment planning, contingency and risk management, budget forecasting, and mitigation strategies for complex studies.

  • Acts as primary Sponsor contact for assigned trial at the country level and serves as the local operational lead for complex studies. May attend/participate in Investigator Meetings as needed and may schedule and conduct local/country investigator meetings.

  • Drives study compliance by maintaining and updating trial management systems, using study tools and management reports available to analyze trial progress. Independently identifies risks, trends, and issues and proactively initiates corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) when studies deviate from plans. Communicates study progress, risks, mitigation strategies, and key operational insights to study management teams and Quality & Compliance teams.

  • Leads development and execution of country-level recruitment strategies and contingency planning in partnership with other functional areas to achieve clinical research targets and improve site performance.

  • Delivers advanced vendor management at the country level to support the study and may submit requests for vendor services and support vendor selection. This includes oversight of vendor performance, issue resolution, budget management, review and approval of site and local vendor invoices as required. As required, manages local study supplies.

  • Ensures high standards for study monitoring by leading quality local trial team meetings and facilitating Site Manager training when needed (i.e., implementation of study amendments and changes in study-related processes).

  • Contributes to patient understanding of protocol and patient safety by preparing country-specific informed consent documents in accordance with procedural document/templates. This includes reviewing and managing site-specific informed consent forms in accordance with SOPs, other procedural documents, and applicable regulations.

  • Ensures trial subject safety in that all AEs/SAEs/PQCs are reported within required reporting timelines and documented appropriately. Proactively identifies and escalates potential patient safety concerns.

  • Ensures Inspection Readiness by maintaining complete, accurate, and timely data and essential documents in systems utilized for trial management (e.g., CTMS and eTMF/IF) according to expectations (metrics) and archiving retention requirements. Proactively identifies quality trends, compliance risks, and documentation gaps across projects and drives resolution activities. Escalates significant issues to the TDM/TDL and Sponsor in a timely manner.

  • Accountable for ensuring quality data (accurate, valid, and complete) is provided by the site and that queries are resolved within expected timelines. Provides oversight and guidance to improve site data quality and operational performance.

  • Keeps oneself inspection ready and knowledgeable for current work by complying with relevant training requirements and maintaining advanced therapeutic area, protocol, operational, and regulatory knowledge.

  • With focus on quality and compliance, works closely with Site Managers to ensure CAPAs are implemented for audits/inspections or any quality-related visits. May conduct accompanied site visits with Site Managers, if delegated by the Sponsor, and may provide coaching on quality-related findings and trends.

  • Ensures accurate finance reporting and trial delivery within budget by adhering to finance reporting deliverables and timelines. This includes advanced forecasting and proactive management of country/local trial budgets, identification of financial risks, and implementation of mitigation plans. If applicable, may support negotiation of trial site contracts and budgets.

  • Keeps the trial in compliance with local regulatory requirements by organizing and ensuring IEC/HA approvals in cooperation with the local Start-Up team, as applicable. Provides guidance on complex regulatory considerations and country-specific requirements.

  • Serves as a trainer, mentor, and subject matter expert for systems/processes and local trial management practices. Provides coaching and support to less experienced team members and contributes to onboarding and capability development activities.

  • Leads and contributes to functional area initiatives, process improvement activities, inspection readiness activities, operational excellence projects, and implementation of new systems and processes.

  • Full utilization by timely and accurate time reporting.

  • Demonstrates experience in management and startup of complex Early Phase trials and projects involving matrix clinical teams, external partners, and investigational sites, as applicable.

  • Leads country-level operational planning and execution for complex, high-priority, or high-risk studies requiring advanced trial management expertise and independent decision-making.

  • If applicable, region-specific deliverables will be specified.

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree.

  • Degree in a health or science-related field.

  • 3 to 5+ years of trial management experience, including experience independently managing complex clinical trials and leading country-level trial execution activities.

  • Oncology experience

  • Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, Sponsor SOPs, local laws and regulations, assigned protocols, and associated protocol-specific procedures.

  • Strong IT skills in appropriate software and Sponsor systems.

  • Willingness to travel with occasional overnight stay away from home according to business needs.

  • Proficient in speaking and writing the country language and English. Good written and oral communication skills as appropriate.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Implementations is responsible for leading successful execution, governance, and continuous improvement of client implementation activities across PSG's implementation portfolio. This role serves as the senior operational leader for implementation delivery, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with client expectations, contractual commitments, and organizational objectives.

The Senior Director translates organizational strategy into scalable implementation processes, delivery methodologies, resource plans, performance metrics, and client engagement models. This individual partners closely with Sales, Product, Consulting, Operations, Analytics, and external partners to ensure successful implementation outcomes while driving operational excellence, client satisfaction, and team performance.

The ideal candidate combines strong implementation leadership, project governance expertise, operational discipline, and people leadership skills with a proven ability to lead complex client initiatives in a fast-paced consulting and healthcare environment.

Essential Responsibilities

Implementation Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of all client implementation engagements.
  • Establish implementation governance frameworks, including status reporting, risk management, issue resolution, decision tracking, and escalation processes.
  • Ensure implementation activities are completed on time, within scope, and consistent with client requirements and organizational standards.
  • Provide leadership oversight and performance monitoring for implementation managers, project managers, business analysts, and implementation consultants.
  • Monitor implementation health across the portfolio and proactively address risks, resource constraints, and delivery challenges.
  • Ensure all implementation deliverables meet quality standards and contractual obligations.

Client Implementation Management

  • Serve as the primary operational leader for client implementations.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with client stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Ensure client requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and decisions are documented, managed, and communicated effectively.
  • Lead implementation steering committees, status reviews, and operational governance meetings.
  • Provide consultative guidance to clients regarding implementation readiness, operational impacts, testing strategies, and deployment planning.
  • Escalate significant risks, issues, or client concerns to executive leadership as appropriate.

Implementation Operations & Process Excellence

  • Develop and continuously improve implementation methodologies, playbooks, tools, templates, and best practices.
  • Standardize implementation processes to create consistency, scalability, and measurable performance across all engagements.
  • Establish implementation metrics and dashboards that measure quality, efficiency, client satisfaction, resource utilization, and project performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance delivery effectiveness and reduce operational risk.
  • Support organizational quality initiatives and implementation-related process transformation efforts.

Resource Planning & Capacity Management

  • Lead resource forecasting, staffing assignments, workload balancing, and capacity planning across implementation teams.
  • Identify resource gaps, skill needs, and capacity constraints and develop mitigation plans.
  • Partner with leadership to align staffing strategies with client demand and organizational growth objectives.
  • Coordinate utilization of internal and external implementation resources to maintain delivery excellence.
  • Manage implementation workforce planning activities to ensure optimal team performance and scalability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Consulting, Product, Operations, Clinical, and Technology teams to ensure seamless implementation execution.
  • Support proposal development by providing implementation timelines, staffing assumptions, operational requirements, and delivery considerations.
  • Facilitate coordination among internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful implementation outcomes.
  • Align implementation activities with operational readiness, product development, and client objectives.
  • Promote collaboration and shared accountability across business functions.

Reporting & Performance Management

  • Develop and maintain implementation dashboards, project scorecards, milestone tracking tools, SLA reporting, and executive summaries.
  • Monitor implementation portfolio performance and provide insights regarding trends, risks, opportunities, and improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure accurate and timely client-facing reporting throughout implementation engagements.
  • Provide leadership with actionable performance analysis and recommendations.
  • Track and report implementation KPIs, including quality, timelines, client satisfaction, resource utilization, and financial performance indicators.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing implementation organization.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability standards.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and professional development of implementation team members.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, client focus, and operational excellence.
  • Conduct performance reviews, coaching discussions, and career development planning for direct reports.
  • Build organizational capabilities to support future growth and evolving client needs.

Partner & Vendor Management

  • Coordinate implementation activities with PBMs, technology vendors, implementation partners, and other third-party organizations.
  • Establish operational relationships that support successful client delivery.
  • Monitor external partner performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure external dependencies are effectively managed throughout implementation engagements.
  • Support issue resolution and escalation management involving external stakeholders.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Healthcare Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, or related field required.
  • Master's degree preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of implementation, operations, consulting, or project leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing implementation, project management, consulting, or operational teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale client implementations in healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, managed care, consulting, or related industries.
  • Experience managing complex cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong background in operational process improvement, governance, and service delivery management.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Deep understanding of PBM implementation methodologies, project governance, and operational delivery models.
  • Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
  • Excellent executive communication and client relationship management skills.
  • Experience with resource planning, capacity management, and workforce forecasting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience building and improving operational processes and performance management frameworks.
  • Knowledge of healthcare, pharmacy benefits, managed care, or consulting operations preferred.

Success Measures

The Senior Director, Implementations will be evaluated on:

  • On-time and successful implementation delivery
  • Client satisfaction and retention
  • Resource utilization and capacity management effectiveness
  • Implementation quality and operational performance
  • Team engagement, retention, and development
  • Achievement of implementation KPIs and SLAs
  • Continuous improvement and operational efficiency gains
  • Effective management of implementation risks and escalations

COMPENSATION:

The base salary range for this position is $190,000 – $210,000. This range represents the employer’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this role at the time of posting.

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications, education, internal equity, and market data. This role may also be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

EPIC has over 60 offices and 4,000 employees nationwide – and we’re growing! It’s a great time to join the team and be a part of this growth. We offer:

Business Development Manager – Outbound Sales - Remote

Industry: Office Supplies
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Arrangement: Remote / Work from Home
Working Hours: Australian business hours

About the Role - 5 yr AU Experience Essential

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Business Development Manager to generate new business for an Australian office supplies company.

This is a hands-on outbound sales role focused on cold calling, prospecting, appointment setting, preparing quotations and converting new business accounts. The successful candidate must be a confident sales hunter who is comfortable working to daily activity targets and monthly revenue goals.

A minimum of five years' B2B sales experience within the Australian market is essential. Applicants without this experience will not be considered.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Business Development

  • Conduct high-volume outbound calls to prospective Australian businesses.
  • Identify and approach decision-makers responsible for purchasing office supplies.
  • Generate qualified leads through cold calling, email, LinkedIn and database prospecting.
  • Introduce the company's products, pricing, delivery capabilities and account benefits.
  • Identify customer requirements, purchasing volumes, current suppliers and buying cycles.
  • Secure appointments, quotation opportunities, product trials and new customer accounts.
  • Follow up prospects consistently until a clear outcome is achieved.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified sales opportunities.
  • Re-engage inactive customers and develop new revenue from dormant accounts.

Target Markets

Prospect and develop accounts across:

  • Corporate offices and professional services firms
  • Accountants and law firms
  • Construction and trade businesses
  • Warehouses and logistics companies
  • Medical centres, pharmacies and healthcare providers
  • Childcare centres, schools and training organisations
  • Retailers, resellers, wholesalers and distributors
  • Real estate and property management businesses
  • Hospitality and accommodation businesses
  • Government and community organisations

Product Sales

Promote and sell products including:

  • A4 and A3 copy paper
  • Printer ink, toner and drum cartridges
  • Thermal rolls and shipping labels
  • Envelopes, stationery and general office products
  • Packaging, mailing and warehouse consumables
  • Cleaning and workplace supplies
  • Other wholesale and commercial office supply products

Sales Process and Account Development

  • Qualify prospects based on product demand, order volume and commercial potential.
  • Prepare professional quotations and pricing proposals.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms within approved margins.
  • Request current invoices or product lists to identify savings and supply opportunities.
  • Arrange product samples or trial orders where appropriate.
  • Convert quotations into initial orders and recurring supply accounts.
  • Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across the product range.
  • Maintain regular contact with new customers to encourage repeat orders.
  • Work with customer service and operations teams to ensure smooth onboarding and delivery.

CRM and Reporting

  • Record all calls, emails, meetings, quotations and follow-up activities in the CRM.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information, decision-maker details and sales notes.
  • Manage follow-up dates and keep the sales pipeline current.
  • Provide daily and weekly reports covering activity, opportunities and results.
  • Forecast expected sales and highlight risks affecting monthly targets.
  • Provide market feedback regarding competitor pricing, customer demand and product opportunities.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Minimum five years' B2B outbound sales experience within the Australian market—essential.
  • Proven experience generating new business through cold calling and outbound prospecting.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet sales activity, conversion and revenue targets.
  • Strong understanding of Australian business communication and buying behaviour.
  • Experience speaking directly with business owners, procurement managers and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong negotiation, objection-handling and closing skills.
  • Ability to prepare quotations and communicate commercial value clearly.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Experience using CRM systems and maintaining an organised sales pipeline.
  • Ability to work independently and remain accountable for results.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience selling office supplies, paper, toner, stationery, thermal rolls, labels, packaging or workplace consumables.
  • Experience selling to resellers, wholesalers, distributors or high-volume commercial customers.
  • Existing knowledge of the Australian office supplies market.
  • Experience managing tenders, contract pricing or recurring supply arrangements.
  • An existing network of Australian business customers or procurement contacts would be highly regarded.

Personal Attributes

  • Confident, persistent and commercially focused.
  • A genuine sales hunter who enjoys winning new accounts.
  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
  • Resilient when handling rejection and objections.
  • Highly organised with disciplined follow-up habits.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working without constant supervision.
  • Accountable for activity, pipeline and revenue results.
  • Professional when representing the business to Australian customers.
  • Focused on building profitable, long-term customer relationships.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against:

  • Daily outbound calls and prospecting activity
  • Decision-maker conversations
  • Qualified leads generated
  • Meetings and quotation opportunities secured
  • Quotations issued
  • New customer accounts opened
  • Initial and repeat orders generated
  • Monthly gross sales and gross-profit targets
  • Lead-to-customer conversion rate
  • Pipeline value and forecast accuracy
  • CRM accuracy and timely follow-up
  • Customer retention and account growth

Required Technology

The successful candidate must have:

  • A reliable computer or laptop
  • Stable high-speed internet
  • A professional and quiet home-working environment
  • A quality headset suitable for outbound sales calls
  • Reliable backup arrangements for internet or power interruptions

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé together with a short cover letter outlining:

  • Your B2B outbound sales experience in Australia

  • Your cold-calling and new-business development experience
  • Examples of sales targets and results achieved
  • Your experience using CRM systems
  • Any experience within office supplies, wholesale or distribution

Only candidates with at least five years of relevant Australian B2B sales experience will be considered.

Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention. Our programs guide members through every stage of the substance use spectrum, from unhealthy habits to active use disorders, delivering personalized treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals.

With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.

Overview of the Role:

Pelago is seeking a mission-driven, board-certified Addiction Medicine Physician with deep expertise in Substance Use Disorder (SUD) treatment to join our clinical team. In this role, you'll provide direct member care via telehealth, delivering evidence-based SUD treatment to help individuals overcome addiction and achieve lasting recovery.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact in digital SUD care delivery, working with cutting-edge telemedicine technology to reach members who need specialized psychiatric support. You'll be part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team dedicated to transforming addiction treatment through innovative, accessible care.

In this role you will…

  • Provide comprehensive SUD care to Pelago members via virtual visits, including thorough assessments, diagnosis, and medication management for SUD and co-occurring conditions.
  • Prescribe and monitor Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT), including naltrexone, Suboxone, and other evidence-based pharmacotherapies, in close collaboration with our member operations team.
  • Address concurrent mental health issues, such as mild to moderate anxiety, depression, sleep disorders, and other conditions frequently found with SUD, in collaboration with the clinical team.
  • Work within Atlas, Pelago's AI-native EHR, which automates session documentation, surfaces real-time evidence-based guidance during calls, and prepares clinical context before each session — so your time stays focused on member care, not administrative lift.
  • Collaborate with counselors, coaches, and member operations to deliver optimized, coordinated care that enhances the member experience and supports recovery.
  • Contribute to clinical excellence through participation in case reviews, journal clubs, grand rounds, and peer reviews to maintain high-quality, evidence-based care.
  • Develop personalized treatment plans and offer referrals based on clinical assessments and individual member needs.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date clinical documentation, supporting quality assurance and compliance efforts to ensure the best patient outcomes.
  • Educate patients in a way that is tailored to their unique needs, abilities, and recovery goals.
  • Collaborate on cross-functional projects with counselor, growth, and product teams to improve care delivery and member outcomes.
  • Help refine and implement clinical protocols, treatment standards, and policies to enhance overall care quality.
  • Commit to 10 hours per week supporting our patients.

  • Active licensure in at least one U.S. state; multi-state licensure strongly preferred. Must be willing to obtain additional state licensure as needed (Pelago will sponsor this).
    • OK or PA preferred to support current patient demand
  • DEA registration (or in process) and current state-controlled substance license (or in process).

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About PraxentPraxent builds software for financial services companies — banks, credit unions, lenders, insurers, and wealth platforms.
jobs.description:
About Praxent

Praxent builds software for financial services companies — banks, credit unions, lenders, insurers, and wealth platforms. We have been doing it for over twenty years, from Austin, with a delivery team spread across the US and Latin America.

We are an Anthropic partner, and building agentic AI systems inside our clients' environments is now a core part of the work rather than an experiment on the side. This role exists because that work needs a different kind of engineer than a traditional project team supplies — someone who sits with the client, decides what should get built, and builds it.

This is the first Forward Deployed Engineer hire at Praxent. You would be defining the role, not inheriting it.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live in the following locations: Texas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Massachusetts, Maryland, Minnesota, North Carolina, Nebraska, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, South Carolina, Washington.

Applicants for this position must be currently and legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, J-1, F-1, CPT, OPT, etc.).

Praxent will not offer immigration sponsorship or assume sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.

International relocation or remote work arrangements outside of the U.S. will not be considered.

About the role

A Forward Deployed Engineer at Praxent embeds with a client, figures out what they actually need, and builds it. Not a spec handed down from a product manager — you are in the discovery conversation, you decide what gets built, and you ship it to production and stay until it works.

You will spend more than half your time in front of the people whose problem you are solving, and the rest of it writing the code that solves it. You are not shielded from the client. You are not handed a ticket queue. When a client asks for the wrong thing, talking them into the right thing is your job, not someone else's.

The shorthand we use internally is founder-level autonomy with staff-engineer-level rigor. You make the technical call in the room and defend it, rather than routing it back for sign-off. That is a real grant of authority, and it comes with real accountability for the outcome.

Financial services makes this harder and more interesting than it would be elsewhere. The systems are old, the data is regulated, the stakeholders are risk-averse for good reasons, and the gap between a working demo and something a bank will actually run in production is where most AI projects die. Closing that gap is the whole job.

What you'll do

  • Own technical delivery end to end on your accounts — discovery, architecture, build, production, and the messy weeks after launch.
  • Embed with client engineering and business teams. Translate a VP's business problem into an architecture, and that architecture back into language the VP can defend to their board.
  • Build production applications and agentic systems inside client environments: LLM-backed workflows, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and integrations against core banking, lending, policy administration, and financial data systems.
  • Design the integration surface. Most of this work is API design and systems integration against platforms that were not built to be integrated with.
  • Harden prototypes into systems a regulated institution will actually run — security review, audit trail, PII handling, performance under real load. The distance between a working demo and a production deployment at a bank is most of the job.
  • Scope down. Identify when a client is asking for the wrong thing and talk them into the right thing. This is the part of the job we care most about.
  • Guide the client's own engineers. Part of leaving well is that their team can extend what you built without calling us.
  • Own the hardest production problems on your accounts — the ones that surface at 4pm on a Friday in someone else's infrastructure.
  • Own the implementation plan and direct the work. You decide the sequence, and as an engagement scales you delegate to the engineers around you — including the internal AI engineers who will work for you. This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management one.
  • Make the case for growth by building things worth expanding. You carry no revenue target and you do not run the commercial conversation — our Client Partners do that. Your argument is the solution itself.
  • Flag risk before it becomes a problem.
  • Leave behind documented, runnable, maintainable software that still works after you rotate off.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years shipping production software, full-stack. Python is what most of this work is written in; .NET or Node are fine substitutes. React or Next.js on the front end.
  • Experience leading the technical side of a delivery. You have owned an implementation plan, sequenced the work, and directed other engineers without being their manager.
  • API design and systems integration. You have integrated against something old, poorly documented, and load-bearing, and made it hold.
  • Real client-facing delivery experience. You have run a discovery session, handled a difficult stakeholder, and delivered an account without someone above you managing the relationship.
  • Production experience with LLMs and agents. Prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, deployment at scale. Application engineering, not ML research.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You deliver value before all the requirements are defined, because they never are.
  • Range in the room. You are precise with engineers and clear with executives, and you can switch between those two rooms inside an hour.
  • A story about scoping down. A time you told a client not to build something, and why you were right.
  • Willingness to travel to client sites 20–30% of the time.

What You’ll Love About Us:

  • Stability. We've been in business for over 25 years.
  • Work stays at work. We promote a healthy work/life balance to help ensure you have the time that you need. We encourage no more than a 40 hour work week.
  • Great company culture. We’ve been recognized by Texas Monthly, Clutch, Comparably, and more for the quality of our workplace. Feel free to check out our rating on Glassdoor.
  • We’re here to empower you. It’s your work and your career. Our management team is here to help you become who you want to be. Not to micromanage you.
  • Stay healthy. We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as wellness days. We also provide disability insurance and we even have a wellness program.
  • Plan for the future. We don’t want you to work here forever. Save for retirement with an IRA and we’ll match up to 3% every year.
  • We value your ideas. At Praxent, our doors are always open. Need help? Come on in. Have a vision for the future of the company? We’d love to hear it.
  • Rest and relaxation. Employees enjoy 15 days of PTO, 9 US holidays, 5 sick days, and a closed office the last week of the year. Employees earn more PTO each year.
  • You’re more than an employee, you’re a person. Every co-worker you’ll meet is committed to treating you with respect and kindness. You won’t hear stuff like, “It’s just business.”
  • Family values. Praxent provides paid parental leave.

Nice, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Denn bei uns verfolgen wir GENAU ein Ziel:

Wir wollen eine neue Ära einläuten und alteingesessene Industriebetriebe in die digitale Welt begleiten - dafür geben wir jeden Tag 110%.

Falls du ebenfalls auf High-Performance stehst und so schnell wachsen willst, dass nicht mal deine engsten Freunde dich wiedererkennen, dann hast du in unserem A-Player Team deine neue Peergroup gefunden. Solange du Ergebnisse lieferst, hast du volle Freiheit und Vertrauen deinen Alltag so zu gestalten, wie es dir passt.

Aber lass mal Klartext sprechen. Wen suchen wir und welche Aufgaben erwarten dich?

Aufgaben

  • Du baust und steuerst Outbound- und E-Mail-Kampagnen im Backend für unsere Kunden – du bist der Motor hinter performanten Sequenzen, die Leads in Gespräche verwandeln.

Benefits

Passt du zu uns als Marketing Manager?

Wenn du ein bisschen nervös bist und du beim Lesen dieser Seite ein Kribbeln in der Bauchregion fühlst, weil du ein echter High-Performer bist, dann ist diese Stelle genau richtig für dich. Wachstum beginnt außerhalb der Komfortzone.
