MLOps Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: MLOps Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a MLOps Engineer Engineer to design, build, and operate high-performance, highly reliable inference platforms for serving large machine learning models in production. The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads. The ideal candidate brings strong distributed systems and performance engineering expertise, has shipped serving systems at scale, and understands the trade-offs between latency, throughput, cost, and quality in ML serving.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate model serving platforms supporting diverse workloads including LLMs, vision models, and recommendation systems.
  • Optimize inference performance using continuous batching, paged attention, speculative decoding, and request multiplexing.
  • Implement multi-tenant routing, rate limiting, and quality-of-service policies across model endpoints.
  • Build autoscaling and capacity management systems that balance latency, throughput, and cost.
  • Tune GPU utilization, memory management, and KV cache strategies for LLM serving workloads.
  • Integrate model serving with API gateways, identity systems, and observability platforms.
  • Implement caching, prompt deduplication, and response reuse strategies where appropriate.
  • Drive end-to-end observability including latency histograms, queue dynamics, GPU utilization, and error tracking.
  • Develop deployment workflows including canary releases, shadow testing, and automated rollback.
  • Operate incident response for high-availability AI services and drive durable reliability improvements.
  • Collaborate with ML and product teams to support new model releases and capability rollouts.
  • Implement security controls including request signing, content filtering, and abuse detection at the serving layer.
  • Document operational procedures, performance characteristics, and tuning guidance for internal teams.
  • Stay current with AI serving research and translate advances into production capabilities.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in distributed systems, infrastructure, or ML platform engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a systems language such as Go, Rust, or C++.
  • Deep experience operating high-throughput, low-latency services in production.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM or large model inference frameworks such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM.
  • Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and accelerator utilization.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, autoscaling, and modern cloud platforms.
  • Experience with observability stacks including metrics, tracing, and structured logging.
  • Solid grounding in performance engineering and capacity planning.
  • Strong communication and incident response skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Open-source contributions to model serving infrastructure.
  • Experience with multi-region or globally distributed AI serving.
  • Familiarity with model quantization, distillation, and compression techniques.
  • Exposure to FinOps for AI workloads and cost-efficient serving design.
  • Experience supporting external-facing AI APIs at scale.

This position utilizes a team responsible for forecasting, analytics, reporting, and portfolio support activities and is accountable for ensuring consistent, accurate, and actionable information is delivered to leadership.

Responsibilities:

Portfolio Integration & Investment Decision Support

  • Integrate financial, operational, and portfolio information across RES functions to support informed decision-making and execution of USBN.
  • Translate strategic direction and portfolio objectives into actionable planning, forecasting, reporting, and governance activities.
  • Develop insights, recommendations, and executive-ready materials that support investment planning, prioritization, funding decisions, portfolio execution, and evaluation of current and future investment opportunities.
  • Identify portfolio risks, opportunities, dependencies, and funding impacts and communicate findings to leadership.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Portfolio Management

  • Lead forecasting, planning, and budget management activities supporting RES programs and USBN real estate investments.
  • Support annual planning processes, multi-year investment outlooks, and ongoing financial reviews.
  • Partner with Finance and Controllers to support forecasting assumptions, financial governance, expense management, and reporting activities.
  • Support optimization of portfolio funding through proactive forecasting, investment pipeline monitoring, and identification of opportunities to improve utilization of approved funding.
  • Drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy, funding utilization, and financial transparency.

Governance, Reporting & Analytics

  • Execute governance processes and portfolio review routines established by RES leadership and the FPU.
  • Execute portfolio governance routines that provide visibility into investment pipelines, project readiness, portfolio risks, funding utilization, and key business decisions.
  • Oversee production of executive reporting, dashboards, portfolio analytics, scenario analyses, and investment performance updates.
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency across reporting, forecasting, and portfolio management activities.
  • Monitor portfolio performance, project readiness, funding availability, and key approvals to support effective investment execution and redeployment of available funding where appropriate.
  • Promote accountability across stakeholder groups through structured reporting, governance, and portfolio oversight.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Execution

  • Partner with stakeholders across Asset Management, Design & Construction, Facilities Management, Transactions, Finance, and USBN leadership to support portfolio planning and investment execution.
  • Coordinate activities that improve alignment, visibility, collaboration, and execution across multiple workstreams and business partners.
  • Support process improvements that enhance governance effectiveness, operational efficiency, investment readiness, and “speed-to-market”.

Risk Management & Controls

  • Promote strong financial, operational, and governance controls across supported activities.
  • Assess and escalate risks impacting investments, forecasts, portfolio performance, or business objectives.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

Leadership Principles & Influence:

  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability for portfolio outcomes and business objectives.
  • Build strong partnerships across functions and levels of the organization to drive alignment and execution.
  • Influence stakeholders through data-driven recommendations, sound judgment, and effective communication.
  • Drive clarity and focus in a complex, highly matrixed environment.

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex investment portfolios, governance processes, forecasting activities, and cross-functional business initiatives.
  • Strong financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, and decision-support capabilities.

jobs.title: Director of Paid Advertising
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As the Director of Paid Advertising, you are the leader of your pod, a hybrid of senior individual contributor, people manager, and product leader for your channel of expertise (Creative, Paid Media, Organic Search, or Social) within the division. Reporting to the Managing Director, you own two things above all else: the people on your pod, and the quality of the work that pod produces.

This is a player-coach role, not a purely operational one. You are arguably the best generalist on your pod, not necessarily the single best specialist at any one skill, but the person who has demonstrated enough judgment, craft, and consistency that the team's trust in you is real and earned, not assumed by title. You lead from the front, capable of sitting in a client meeting and explaining the strategy directly, and capable of getting your hands dirty on coverage and doing the work at an exemplary standard. You ask nothing of your team that you wouldn't do yourself, and couldn't do at least as well.

You protect your pod from unreasonable client pressure while holding the team to a high, non-negotiable bar of excellence. You are on the roadmap to Managing Director, using this role to build the people leadership, product judgment, and cross-functional fluency that role demands, while staying closer to the craft than an MD typically can.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a pod of Strategists within [Channel], including direct ownership of hiring, onboarding, and day-to-day people leadership.
  • Build and maintain individual development plans, coaching cadences, and mentorship for every member of the pod.
  • Own team retention through positive team sentiment, psychological safety, and clear paths for growth.
  • Drive performance management using the ARC framework; deliver timely, direct feedback and clear raise and promotion recommendations.
  • Oversee capacity planning and staffing alignment across the pod as client books shift.
  • Facilitate ongoing training and channel knowledge-sharing (platform updates, new tactics, competitive shifts).
  • Provide executive-level oversight for client accounts within the pod, including direct, hands-on support for the pod's most complex or highest-priority accounts.
  • Act as Account Director on a select number of the pod's single channel clients.
  • Act as the primary point of escalation for client concerns within the channel, offering strategic guidance and resolving one-off issues directly.
  • Support high-level strategy development, performance narrative, and internal audit or QA requests to ensure the pod's delivery is consistently exceptional.
  • Track client churn and churn trends within the pod's book of business, and intervene early where risk signals appear.
  • Quality: own product quality for the pod through consistent, accountable QA processes, catching errors before they become client-facing or revenue-impacting.
  • Critical Error Management: intercept potential overspends and other revenue-impacting mistakes before they reach the client, and maintain rigorous adherence to planned spend and budget accuracy targets.
  • MCC & Business Manager Hygiene: maintain clean MCC and Business Manager structures across the pod's book of business to prevent access issues, suspensions, and disapprovals.
  • DI & MMT Quality: partner with the Data Intelligence team to ensure MMT implementation accuracy and drive ongoing optimization.
  • Systems fluency: demonstrate full working knowledge of the Power Circuit and the nova ecosystem, adapt to evolving internal processes, and contribute to operational excellence.
  • Innovation: lead channel-specific product development through structured innovation efforts, knowledge-sharing, and regular brainstorms; run and centralize the learnings from betas and tests.
  • New Tool & Partner Vetting: evaluate new tools, platforms, and partners, and build the business case for adoption where they strengthen the pod's product offering.
  • Partnership: collaborate with the Service Lead and key platform partners to stay ahead of channel trends and emerging opportunities.
  • AI adoption: leverage AI tools to optimize workflows, surface insights, improve performance, and model that adoption for the pod.
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Omega and nova), Team Pulse cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our diagnostic system) compliance across managed pod.
  • Case Studies: develop compelling case studies from the pod's work, and surface strong candidates to the Managing Director for the division's outcome-narrative pipeline.
  • Audits & Pitches — contribute to new business efforts by supporting audits, pitches, and prospective client opportunity identification
  • Service Expansion — identify and act on service expansion opportunities within the pod's existing book of business
  • Drive pod growth by leading recruitment efforts for [Channel] conducting interviews, assessing channel-specific skill, and building the business case for new hires.
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements

  • 7-8 years of digital marketing experience, with 5+ years in an agency setting.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on, expert-level experience in [Channel: Creative / Paid Media / Organic Search / Social].
  • 5+ years of experience managing a team, including performance management and development planning.
  • Demonstrated judgment and credibility that has earned the trust of a team of specialists.
  • Expert knowledge of how the channel functions within the broader marketing funnel and business strategy.

Other skills required

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including direct client-facing presence.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Self-motivated, with a strong desire to build something — both a team and a product — rather than simply maintain it.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and high emotional intelligence.
  • Strong work ethic and the ability to learn quickly and independently.
  • Genuine interest in a long-term relationship with a growing company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Client Book Revenue per Employee $10K
  • Pod Client Retention (bi-annual) 95%
  • Pod Service Contribution Margin 60%
  • Pod Revenue per Employee (RPE) Average $27K/ Person
  • Team Retention (direct reports) 95%

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Effectively manage the pod to create a positive team member experience aligned with company objectives.
  • Deliver a top-tier, consistently excellent product for clients through the pod's work.
  • Own the growth and evolution of the channel's product, not just its day-to-day delivery.
  • Oversee the growth and retention of both the team and its clients.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Prepaid Medicine Plan
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Berlin I Germany | EU I Remote
jobs.excerpt: How will you make an impact? As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph.
jobs.description:
How will you make an impact?

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You'll ship features that solve real customer problems, contribute to our CMS core, extend our platform capabilities, and help bring AI-powered features to life. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. You'll use your judgment, collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and customers, and move fast using modern AI-assisted development tools.

This role is for someone who sees engineering as a team sport, takes ownership without waiting for permission, and thrives in an environment where initiative matters more than instructions.

What you will be working on:

  • Core CMS development: Evolve the GraphQL-native CMS powering enterprise teams worldwide, improving performance, reliability, and developer experience.

  • CMS extensions and integrations: Develop and maintain extensions that expand what customers can do with Hygraph.

  • AI-powered features: Contribute to our AI roadmap by building intelligent capabilities into the product.

  • Customer-facing improvements: Use monitoring data, customer feedback, and your product instinct to identify and fix problems before they're reported proactively.

Some of your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in a cross-functional, autonomous team to deliver features and continuous improvements, often working from rough prototypes or early concepts rather than polished designs.

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions by working closely with the Product team. Occasionally, participate in customer conversations to validate that what you're building actually solves their problems.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, or similar) to accelerate development.

  • Proactively identify issues through monitoring and observability data. Then fix them, don't just flag them.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions that keep our platform scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

  • Share what you know, learn from others, and help your teammates grow. Engineering here is collaborative. We win together.

Expectations timeline

1 Month

You'll complete onboarding covering our product, tech stack, infrastructure, and vision. You'll meet people across the company, get familiar with our codebase, and ship your first contributions. You'll start building context on how our customers use Hygraph and what matters most to them.

3 Months

You'll be delivering features and improvements to production with confidence. You'll have a solid understanding of Hygraph's product and architecture, and you'll be contributing ideas, not just code. You'll have built working relationships with your team lead, PMs, designers, and fellow engineers through regular 1:1s, operational reviews, and day-to-day collaboration.

6 Months

By now, you'll be making significant contributions to both the product and the team. You'll bring fresh perspectives from your experience and help raise the bar across performance, architecture, and how we work. You'll be someone the team relies on. Not because you do everything, but because you make everyone around you better.

Requirements

What we expect from you:

Significant experience (typically 6+ years) building and owning production systems, with strong full-stack skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and deep backend expertise, scalability, and performance fundamentals (ideally ).

  • Experience building user interfaces, ideally with React.

  • Experience developing well-tested APIs with GraphQL.

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (especially PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization.

  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in your workflow.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native development (AWS, GCP).

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (New Relic, Datadog, or similar).

  • Openness and experience with on-call and operational work (investigations, incident response, etc.).

  • Ability to work with ambiguity: rough prototypes, evolving requirements, and imperfect information. You use judgment and experience to fill the gaps.

  • Strong product sense. You think about why you're building something, not just how. You care about the customer experience, not just the code.

Bonus points

  • Experience with Golang.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code tooling (Pulumi, Terraform).

  • Experience working directly with customers or in customer-facing roles.

  • Familiarity with headless CMS platforms or content infrastructure.

The Process

  • Intro call with People Team

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Technical Interview

  • C-Level Call and Reference Check (optional)

  • Job Offer

The response time after application, screening applications, and setting up the first intro call is usually within 1-2 weeks. You could expect some alterations when necessary.

About us

Hygraph is a dynamic Berlin-based startup and a GraphQL-native, API-first headless CMS built for teams delivering complex, composable digital experiences. Hygraph is on a mission to eliminate complexity for global teams and help them scale content without friction. Our platform empowers you to create, deliver, and distribute content faster and at scale. We’re a team committed to shaping the future of AI-powered content platforms. Trusted by over 50,000 teams worldwide, Hygraph powers structured content across websites, applications, product experiences, and AI-enabled systems.

As AI reshapes how digital experiences are created and operated, Hygraph is helping organizations build on structured, trusted content foundations that enable human-first, AI-accelerated experiences at scale. You will be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team committed to working collaboratively, transparently, and passionately. We believe in a remote-first approach where everyone is encouraged to do their best from wherever they are and work together with transparency, accountability, and ownership. We learn continuously through feedback and have a yearly learning budget to attend training and conferences.

Hygraph is an equal-opportunity employer committed to hiring people with diverse backgrounds. We believe that diversity, unique experiences, qualities, and different cultures enrich our workspace's productivity and promote innovation and creativity.

Note: We are fortunate to receive a large number of applications for our roles. To manage this effectively and give each application the attention it deserves, we use AI-assisted tools to help assess certain screening questions and handle application elements. This helps us ensure a consistent and timely review process. All final hiring decisions are made exclusively by our human recruitment team.

jobs.title: Junior BIM coördinator
jobs.excerpt: Als Junior BIM Coördinator zorg jij ervoor dat alle digitale projectinformatie samenkomt in één slim en overzichtelijk model.
jobs.description:
Als Junior BIM Coördinator zorg jij ervoor dat alle digitale projectinformatie samenkomt in één slim en overzichtelijk model. Je werkt samen met ontwerpers, engineers, werkvoorbereiders en projectteams om bouwprojecten digitaal tot in detail voor te bereiden.

Je leert hoe je BIM-processen organiseert, modellen coördineert en digitale samenwerking tussen verschillende disciplines mogelijk maakt.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het beheren en coördineren van BIM-modellen binnen projecten.
  • Het samenbrengen van informatie uit verschillende disciplines zoals constructie, civiele techniek en installaties.
  • Het uitvoeren van modelcontroles en het signaleren van clashes of knelpunten.
  • Het organiseren en ondersteunen van BIM-overleggen.
  • Het opstellen en beheren van BIM-uitvoeringsplannen.
  • Het ondersteunen van projectteams bij het werken met BIM-software.
  • Het bijdragen aan innovatieve en slimme digitale oplossingen voor onze projecten.
  • Het samenwerken met collega's, partners en specialisten binnen en buiten BESIX.

Waar kom je terecht?
​​​​​​​Je wordt onderdeel van het BIM-team binnen de vakgroep Projectbeheersing, Omgeving & Digitalisering. Een team van enthousiaste specialisten die elkaar helpen, kennis delen en samen werken aan de digitalisering van onze projecten.

Daarnaast heb je korte lijnen met het internationale Engineering Department van BESIX, waar tientallen BIM-specialisten actief zijn. Een ideale omgeving om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Bouwkunde, Civiele Techniek, Built Environment, Architectuur of vergelijkbaar.
  • Interesse in BIM, digitalisering en innovatieve bouwprocessen.
  • Basiskennis van software zoals Revit, Navisworks, Civil 3D of vergelijkbare tools is mooi meegenomen.
  • Een proactieve houding en de motivatie om veel te leren.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands. Engels is een pré.
  • Je werkt graag samen en bent niet bang om vragen te stellen.

Ervaring is niet het belangrijkste. We zoeken vooral een leergierige starter die zich wil ontwikkelen tot BIM-professional.

Wat kun je verwachten als je voor BESIX kiest?

  • Uitdagend project: Werk mee aan grote en complexe projecten in Nederland waar jij jezelf tot een ware BIM coördinator kan ontwikkelen.
  • Carrièregroei: Investeer in jezelf met on-the-job learning, interne en externe trainingen en de BESIX Academy. Bij ons groei je zowel persoonlijk als professioneel.
  • Aantrekkelijke beloning: Ontvang een goed salaris dat meegroeit met jouw ontwikkeling, uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Bouw & Infra, plus laptop en telefoon.
  • Korte lijnen & afwisselend werk: Dankzij de korte lijnen kun je direct schakelen met collega’s van verschillende disciplines en ervaar je volop afwisseling en verantwoordelijkheid in je dagelijkse werk.
  • Vrijheid & ondernemerschap: Bij BESIX krijg je de ruimte om je ideeën en initiatieven daadwerkelijk te realiseren.
  • Sterke teams & werksfeer: Geniet van dagelijkse lunches, wekelijkse borrels en een energieke, ondernemende omgeving met fijne collega’s waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn.
  • Bedrijfscultuur: Onze informele cultuur is gebaseerd op respect, uitmuntendheid, samenwerking, passie en eenheid met een flinke portie Bourgondische gezelligheid.

Zie jij jezelf al onderdeel uitmaken van het BESIX team? Solliciteer eenvoudig online door het sollicitatieformulier in te vullen en je CV en motivatiebrief te uploaden. Ook als je niet helemaal aan al onze wensen voldoet, maar wel enthousiast bent over het vak, horen we graag van je. Bij BESIX denken we graag met jou mee, want jouw toekomst begint hier!

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Aan vrijblijvend voorgestelde kandidaten kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend.

Sinds 1992 is BESIX Nederland een multidisciplinair bouwbedrijf met een sterke reputatie in complexe en innovatieve projecten. Van civiele kunstwerken zoals bruggen, sluizen en waterwerken tot iconische gebouwen zoals het Sluishuis, DPG mediavaert in Amsterdam, Grotiustorens in Den Haag, en POST Rotterdam en Terraced Tower: wij combineren technisch vernuft met duurzaamheid en innovatie. Ook infrastructurele projecten zoals de Krammersluizen, de A13-A16 en knooppunt De Nieuwe Meer, A27 Noord en de A15 laten zien hoe wij Nederland in beweging houden.

Ben jij net afgestudeerd in Civiele Techniek, Bouwkunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding? En krijg jij energie van digitalisering, 3D-modellen en slimme bouwprocessen? Dan is dit jouw kans om mee te werken aan enkele van de grootste en meest uitdagende bouw- en infraprojecten van Nederland.

Bij BESIX Nederland bouwen we niet alleen bruggen, tunnels, hoogbouw en waterwerken. We bouwen ook aan de toekomst van de bouwsector. Digitalisering speelt daarin een belangrijke rol en jij kunt daar vanaf dag één aan bijdragen.

jobs.description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

About the Role

We are seeking a Back-end Developer with strong programming skills and a solid foundation in scientific computing to build and optimize data-driven applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that support research and innovation in a dynamic environment.

Under general supervision, assists in designing, coding, testing, trouble-shooting and documenting engineering systems applications. Works on projects of moderate scope and complexity. Assists in developing test strategies used in the automated regression testing of these systems. Familiar with common software vulnerabilities and leading practices to mitigate.   • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions
  • Optimize and refactor existing code for performance and scalability
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues in applications and systems
  • Stay current with trends in full-stack development, data visualization, and cloud technologies
  • Maintain strong knowledge of modern development tools, standards, and best practices

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience (preferred)
  • Strong proficiency in Python programming
  • Hands-on experience with NumPy and Pandas
  • Familiarity with back-end frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django) is a plus
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and statistical analysis
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and statistical analysis
  • Knowledge of REST APIs and microservices architecture

·Agentic Pipeline Development: Experience or strong interest in building agentic pipelines using LLMs for dynamic data orchestration and automation.

Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2025 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. jobs.excerpt: Counterpart is an insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace.
jobs.description:
Counterpart is an insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace. We believe that when businesses lead with clarity and confidence, they become more resilient, more innovative, and better prepared for what’s ahead. That’s why we built the first Agentic Insurance™ system — where advanced AI and deep insurance expertise come together to proactively assess, mitigate, and manage risk. Backed by A rated carriers and trusted by brokers nationwide, our platform helps small businesses grow with confidence. Join us in shaping a smarter future, helping businesses Do More With Less Risk®.

As a member of the Claims team, you will be one of the initial users of, and key feedback providers for, our active claims management processes and systems. Your input will help to shape and improve how we fulfill our mission of providing world-class service through tightly managing legal costs, making data-driven decisions when analyzing a claim’s value, and ensuring that other potentially responsible parties pay their fair share. This will necessitate close collaboration with Claims leadership, our internal Data and Engineering teams, and our carrier partners.

YOU WILL

  • Complete accurate and timely investigations into the coverage, liability, and damages for each claim assigned to you.
  • Actively manage each claim assigned to you in a way that produces the most timely and cost-effective resolution.
  • Build and maintain positive and productive working relationships with internal and external customers, including policyholders, brokers, carrier partners, and Risk Engineers.
  • Direct and monitor assignments to experts and outside counsel, and hold those vendors accountable for meeting or exceeding our service standards.
  • Support our data collection efforts and models by effectively using the Counterpart claim system to fully and accurately capture critical details about each claim assigned to you.
  • Identify and escalate insights into emerging claims trends across industries, geographies, and key business segments.
  • Offer user-level feedback and insights to support the continuous improvement of our claim handling processes, guidelines, and systems.
  • Ensure that every touchpoint with our insureds and brokers is representative of our brand, mission, and vision.

YOU HAVE

  • At least 5 years of professional experience, with at least 2 years of experience litigating or managing claims in one or more of the following areas:
    • Employment Practices Liability
    • Miscellaneous Professional Liability
    • Directors and Officers Liability
    • Errors and Omissions Liability
  • Previous carrier or broker experience is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree required; law degree (J.D.) and professional designations (RPLU, AIC, etc.) highly preferred.
  • Must possess all required state claim adjuster licenses, or be able to obtain them within 90 days of hire.
  • Proven ability to work both independently on complex matters and collaboratively as a team player to assist others as needed.
  • High level of personal initiative and leadership skills.
  • Exceptional time management, problem solving and organizational skills.
  • Comfort and skill operating in a paperless claims environment and using Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, etc.). Additional familiarity with Google Docs Editors suite is a plus.
  • Willingness to use creative thinking and data-driven insights to overcome obstacles to resolution.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to succeed in a full remote workplace environment, and travel as necessary (approximately 10-15%).

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

  • Tobias Schuler, Head of Data Analytics: After becoming a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society and working as a consultant actuary at EY for several years, Tobias went on to drive the actuarial data & systems teams at QBE. He further leveraged his deep insurance and technical expertise at Munich Re Digital Partners in North America, where he headed data and analytics and oversaw the data infrastructure behind some of their largest programs.
  • Chris Shafer, Special Projects: Chris is a published scientific author, having studied the neural correlates of gratitude at the lauded Brain and Creativity Institute. He has since helped to launch numerous businesses in which he held a variety of critical roles from product management to business operations to strategic partnerships. Chris received his bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences from the University of Southern California.
  • Tanner Hackett, CEO & Founder: Having founded two other major startups, including Button and Lazada, Tanner now spends his time focused on mental health through his philanthropy,, in addition to reading, surfing, yoga, and enjoying the outdoors.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Stock Options: Every employee is able to participate in the value that they create at Counterpart through our employee stock option plan.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage: We care about your health and that of your loved ones. We cover up to 100% of your monthly contributions for health, dental, and vision insurance and up to 80% coverage for family members.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: We value your financial health and offer a 401(k) option to help you save for retirement.
  • Parental Leave: Birthing parents may take up to 12 weeks of parental leave at 100% of their regular pay following the birth of the employee’s child, and can choose to take an additional 4 unpaid weeks. Non-birthing parents will receive 8 weeks of parental leave at 100% of their regular pay.
  • Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
  • Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.
  • Home Office Allowance: As a new employee, you will receive a $300 allowance to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.
  • Wellness stipend: $100 per month to spend toward an item or service that supports your wellness (i.e. massage or gym membership, meditation app subscription, etc.)
  • Book stipend: To support your intellectual development, we offer a book stipend that allows you to purchase books, e-books, or educational materials relevant to your role or professional interests.
  • Professional Development Reimbursement: We provide up to $500 annually for you to invest in relevant courses, workshops, conferences, or certifications that will enhance your skills and expertise.
  • No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Charitable Contribution Matching: For every charitable donation you make, we will match it dollar for dollar, up to a maximum of $150 per year. This allows you to amplify your charitable efforts and support causes close to your heart.

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don’t cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren’t being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal.
  • Practice Omotenashi (“selfless hospitality”) - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely.Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

Our estimated pay range for this role is $120,000 to $160,000. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, market data, location, internal equitability, and experience.

Counterpart is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

We’re not building an AI to validate or pacify. We’re building something modeled after the relationships that transform us. Someone who asks the right questions at the right time. Someone who helps you look inward, and pushes you outward. We’ve been featured in TED Talks, Stanford and Harvard studies, the Lex Fridman podcast, because 40M+ people connect with Replika in a deeply human way. And we’re just getting started.

About the role

Replika is growing fast, and paid social is one of the biggest drivers of that growth. The ads people see on TikTok, Meta, and YouTube are often their first impression of Replika — and this role owns the motion behind them.

You’ll design and animate video ads and UGC creatives for our paid campaigns, working on a small growth team alongside producers and user acquisition managers. You’ll take a concept, turn it into a finished ad, put it live, and iterate based on how it performs — treating channel data and results as creative input, not an afterthought. It’s fast-paced and high-volume, and you own the craft from idea to final cut.

The goal is simple: creative that stops the scroll, gets people to try Replika, and looks and feels like Replika while doing it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Concept and animate video ads and UGC creatives for paid social — from first idea to finished, ready-to-run ad — for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and wherever attention moves next.

  • Bring your own concepts and hooks to the table — spot fresh angles, pitch them, and turn the best ones into ads worth testing.

  • Explore a range of creative styles — from polished motion to raw, native-feeling UGC — to find what breaks through.

  • Produce a steady stream of new creative and variations at the pace paid social demands, without dropping quality.

  • Work with producers and UAMs, and keep an eye on what’s working across the market, to turn briefs into winners — and winners into more winners.

  • Create and maintain an appealing, consistent Replika presence across social media.

  • Own the motion craft of our paid creative end-to-end: set the bar, ship fast, and keep raising it.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong motion design portfolio (a portfolio of ad creatives that performed in real paid campaigns is a plus).

  • Hands-on mastery of After Effects, Figma, and the rest of the Adobe Creative Suite — plus whatever visual editing tools get the job done.

  • Good taste and a strong eye for composition, colour, and easing — the details that make motion polished and pleasant to watch.

  • A feel for ad structure — hook, emotion, CTA — and the pacing and timing that hold attention in the first few seconds.

  • A knack for making stop-scrollers that still make Replika look and feel on brand.

  • You actively use AI models across your work — image, video, and sound — and know how to weave them into your workflow to get the best possible results out of generated media.

  • A real interest in the product and the people who use it.

  • You’re fast and self-directed. You ship, you learn, you tighten. No hand-holding.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (C1 or higher preferred).

Bonus Points

  • Comfort with vibe-coding — building little tools or automating parts of your workflow to save time. No CS background needed.

  • A solid understanding of the different AI models out there, and a habit of keeping up as the industry moves.

  • You’re proactive with ideas and can write your own hooks and short ad scripts.

  • You’re comfortable digging into ad performance data in Meta Ads Manager to see what’s working and why.

  • Fluent in internet culture — you know what’s funny, shareable, and trending, and can turn it into creative fast.

What You'll Get

  • Competitive compensation.

  • Flexible job schedule and generous vacation policy.

  • Access to the latest AI creative, video, and coding tools.

  • No corporate bs.

  • Direct impact on the company’s growth — your work is what brings the next millions of users in.

  • Freedom to test bold ideas and watch them run to millions of people within days.

  • Fully remote.

jobs.description:
Digital Student Ambassador — Volunteer Position

Part-Time | Remote | Canada | Volunteer — Unpaid

| Toronto, Ontario

About The Humane Choices Foundation

The Humane Choices Foundation is a 100% volunteer-driven Canadian nonprofit based in Toronto, Ontario. Our mission is to reduce the suffering of farm animals, protect our oceans from exploitation, and address the environmental harm caused by industrial animal agriculture — through education, advocacy, and meaningful community action.

We are not a single-issue organization. Our work sits at the intersection of animal welfare, ocean protection, environmental justice, public health, and food systems policy. We educate. We advocate. We hold powerful institutions accountable. And we support the farmers and communities ready to do things differently.

About This Role

No prior advocacy experience required. If you care about animals and the planet and want to do something meaningful with your platform, this role is built for you.

The HCF Digital Ambassador Program partners with student clubs at Canadian universities to amplify our mission through club social media. As a Digital Ambassador, you are the coordinating club member responsible for managing the partnership between your club and HCF.

No university permission is required. The content goes through your club social media — where your audience already is. You will manage HCF content, complete monthly creative briefs, and report your impact each semester. In return, you receive an official title, mentorship, a built-in career progression pathway, and a reference letter upon completion.

Your Commitment

This role requires a minimum four-month commitment — equivalent to one full academic semester. Start times are flexible and can align with any point in the academic year.

Ambassadors can expect to contribute approximately 30 to 60 hours over the course of a semester, depending on activity level. This makes the role well-suited for students seeking co-curricular recognition or credited volunteer placements through their university.

The commitment is structured around monthly post minimums and one dedicated content batch week per month — not rigid weekly quotas.

Monthly posting minimums ramp over the semester:

  • Month 1 — 6 posts minimum, any format, onboarding and introduction focus
  • Month 2 — 8 posts minimum, at least one original creative format
  • Month 3 onwards — 10 posts minimum per month, monthly creative brief required

One week per month is designated as the creative batch week. Ambassadors plan and create content for the following three to four weeks in a single session — no daily or weekly deadlines.

What You Will Do

  • Lead your club's social media advocacy for animal welfare, ocean protection, and food systems change using HCF-approved content and materials
  • Complete one monthly creative brief — a theme issued by HCF that your club interprets in any format you choose
  • Run at least one focused awareness campaign per semester on your club's social media channels
  • Connect digitally with at least one other student club or online community per semester and introduce them to HCF's mission
  • Organize or promote at least one off-campus activity per semester — a community screening, a meetup, or a peer conversation
  • Track and report your impact each semester — building the accountability and reporting skills employers look for

What You Will Receive

  • Official Digital Ambassador title — The Humane Choices Foundation — for your resume, LinkedIn, and co-curricular record from day one
  • Built-in career progression — as you grow in the role, your title and responsibilities evolve. You will learn more about this pathway during your welcome call.
  • Digital Content Kit — branded templates, caption guides, hashtag lists, and a private content library updated monthly
  • Monthly creative brief — a theme or prompt your club interprets creatively each month
  • Direct mentorship from the External Relations Manager within your time as a volunteer
  • Reference letter from the Director of Strategic Relations upon successful completion of your volunteer commitment
  • Access to the Foundation's growing national ambassador network

Who We Are Looking For

You are a strong fit if you:

  • Are currently enrolled at a Canadian university or college with at least one full academic year remaining (required)
  • Have a love and passion for animals, nature, and the planet
  • Are an active member of a student club focused on animal welfare, food systems, sustainability, or environmental advocacy
  • Are organized, reliable, and comfortable communicating professionally on behalf of your club
  • Want to advocate with a community that loves animals and the environment

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience managing a club social media account or creating content for an audience
  • Background in environmental studies, agriculture, veterinary science, or a related field
  • Bilingual ability in French and English

Our Values

Everything we do is guided by Compassion, Honesty, Courage, Collaboration, Hope, and Transparency. We expect our ambassadors to embody these values in how they represent the Foundation publicly.

How to Apply

Complete the application through this posting. Tell us about your club — its focus, its audience, and why you think there is an alignment with HCF's mission. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a 20-minute introductory call with our External Relations Manager.

Questions? Email or with the subject line: Digital Ambassador Inquiry.

The Humane Choices Foundation is a volunteer-led organization committed to building a food system that works for animals, for people, and for the planet.

jobs.description:
About Us

    Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

About the Role

    The Nurse Practitioner – Quality & Education Lead is a clinical leadership role that combines direct cardiovascular patient care with responsibility for advancing clinical quality, education, and clinician development. This individual will provide high-quality, evidence-based care in a virtual environment while leading initiatives that promote clinical excellence, consistency, and continuous improvement across the care team. The role will support clinician onboarding and ongoing education, conduct peer and chart reviews, provide coaching and performance feedback, and help develop and implement clinical quality programs and standards. Working collaboratively with cardiologists, advanced practice providers, primary care providers, and cross-functional partners, the Nurse Practitioner – Quality & Education Lead will serve as a trusted clinical resource and mentor while helping ensure exceptional, patient-centered cardiovascular care.

    Responsibilities

  • Patient Assessment: Conduct thorough patient assessments conducted via telehealth visits, including medical history reviews, physical examinations, and diagnostic tests, to evaluate cardiovascular health and identify cardiac conditions.

  • Diagnosis and Treatment: Formulate differential diagnoses and develop treatment plans for patients with various cardiac issues. Prescribe medications and order diagnostic tests.

  • Disease Management: Manage chronic cardiovascular conditions remotely, including hypertension, congestive heart failure, arrhythmias, and coronary artery disease. Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans as needed to achieve optimal outcomes.

  • Education and Counseling: Educate patients and their families about cardiovascular diseases, prevention strategies, and lifestyle modifications. Provide counseling on medication management, diet, exercise, and smoking cessation to promote heart health.

  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cardiologists, PCPs and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care for patients. Discuss complex cases and participate in multidisciplinary care teams.

  • Research and Evidence-Based Practice: Stay current with the latest developments in cardiology research and incorporate evidence-based practices into patient care. Participate in research studies or quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient outcomes.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and detailed patient records, including medical histories, assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and discharge summaries. Ensure compliance with legal and ethical standards.

  • Patient Advocacy: Serve as an advocate for patients' needs and preferences, ensuring that they receive appropriate care and support throughout their healthcare journey.

  • Continuing Education: Pursue ongoing education and professional development in the field of cardiology to stay updated on the latest advancements and maintain relevant certifications

  • Quality Assurance: Participate in quality assurance programs to monitor and improve the quality of cardiology care provided within the healthcare facility.

  • Lead and support clinical quality initiatives, including peer review and quality oversight of APPs and physicians.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve clinical quality programs and performance standards.

  • Design and deliver onboarding, training, and ongoing education programs for clinicians.

  • Conduct chart reviews, provide performance feedback, and promote adherence to evidence-based practices and organizational protocols.

  • Serve as a clinical resource and mentor, fostering excellence in patient care and clinician development.

About You

  • Education: Master’s or Doctoral degree in Nursing from an accredited Nurse Practitioner program.
  • Licensure & Certification: Current, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner/APRN license and active national board certification (e.g., AANP or ANCC). Must be eligible to obtain and maintain licensure in states required by the organization.
  • Clinical Experience: Strong clinical experience as a Nurse Practitioner, with experience managing patients with cardiovascular conditions such as hypertension, heart failure, arrhythmias, and coronary artery disease. Cardiology experience strongly preferred.
  • Clinical Expertise: Demonstrated ability to independently assess patients, develop differential diagnoses, create evidence-based treatment plans, prescribe medications, order and interpret diagnostic testing, and manage chronic cardiovascular conditions.
  • Quality & Performance Improvement: Experience with clinical quality initiatives, chart review, peer review, quality assurance, or performance improvement programs. Comfortable identifying opportunities for improvement and translating findings into actionable clinical standards and education.
  • Education & Clinician Development: Experience developing or delivering clinical education, onboarding, training, or ongoing professional development for clinicians. You are comfortable providing constructive feedback, coaching peers, and supporting clinician performance.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to serve as a clinical resource and mentor to APPs and other clinicians, with a collaborative approach to promoting clinical excellence and accountability.
  • Evidence-Based Practice: Strong knowledge of evidence-based cardiovascular care and a commitment to staying current with evolving clinical guidelines, research, and best practices.
  • Virtual Care: Comfortable delivering high-quality patient care through telehealth and using technology to effectively assess, educate, and engage patients in a virtual environment.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with cardiologists, PCPs, APPs, clinical leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Patient-Centered Approach: A strong commitment to patient advocacy, education, and shared decision-making, with the ability to communicate complex cardiovascular information in an accessible and compassionate way.
  • Professional Development: Commitment to ongoing continuing education and maintaining all required licenses, certifications, and professional credentials.

About Our Culture

    • We are remote-first: flexibility, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate
    • We care about diversity: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience

über die rolle

Als B2B Operations Manager entwickelst du die Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsweisen unseres B2B-Bereichs. Unser CRM befindet sich im finalen Aufbau. Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung dafür, wie B2B-Prozesse im CRM abgebildet werden: Du erkennst Engpässe in der Datenpflege und den Workflows, formulierst Anforderungen an Struktur und Automatisierung und setzt neue Abläufe gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams um - von der Abbildung von Lead-Qualifizierung und Onboarding über Pricing- und Konditionslogik bis zu Partnerkommunikation und Shop-Prozessen.

deine aufgaben

B2B-Prozesse & Operations (ca. 60%)

  • Du übernimmst 0-to-1-Ownership für unsere B2B-Prozesse, von der Lead-Qualifizierung über das Onboarding bis zur laufenden Partnerbetreuung. Wo heute kein sauberer Ablauf existiert, baust du einen.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu CRM und Automation: Du verstehst die Datenflüsse, erkennst Engpässe und formulierst klare Anforderungen, die Data & AI und IT technisch umsetzen. CRM-Hygiene ist für dich die Grundlage jeder verlässlichen Auswertung.
  • Du verbindest Sales, Supply Chain, Finance und Product zu reibungslosen Abläufen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran.

  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert: Du machst Best Practices zu Playbooks und SOPs und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Team wirklich genutzt werden.
Operatives Enabling (ca. 40%)
  • Du verantwortest B2B-Newsletter und Partner-Kommunikation: Du bringst die richtigen Aktionen zu den richtigen Partnergruppen und wertest ihre Wirkung aus (Open Rate, CTR, Conversion).
  • Du entwickelst unsere Pricing- und Konditionenlogik mit und pflegst sie sauber in Shop und CRM: kommerziell durchdacht, konsistent, nachvollziehbar.
  • Du betreust unseren B2B-Shop und den Education-Shop: Produktzugänge, Kollektionen, Bundles, kleinere Anpassungen, und du begleitest die Shop-Migration.
  • Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich.

dein profil

  • Du hast 3-4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Sales-Organisation, Commercial/Sales Operations, Strategieberatung oder einem Scale-up gesammelt. Ein Hintergrund in einer Strategieberatung oder Business Development ist ein Pluspunkt.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit HubSpot und bewegst dich sicher in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Workflows.
  • Du bist ein hands-on Generalist: Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, setzt selbst um statt zu delegieren, und dir ist keine Aufgabe zu klein.
  • Du hast bereits komplexe, bereichsübergreifende Projekte eigenständig geführt - von Scoping und Business Case über die Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Team (SOPs, Playbooks, Trainings).
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du erkennst Chancen, priorisierst nach Wirkung und Skalierbarkeit und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du arbeitest stark analytisch: Du bewegst dich sicher in großen Datenmengen und Spreadsheets und ziehst daraus klare, umsetzbare Schlüsse.
  • Du hast eine hohe KI- und Datenaffinität: Du hast KI-Tools bereits praktisch in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt und möchtest sie zu einem festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise machen. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und lernst schnell.
  • Du strukturierst fachliche Bedarfe und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Anforderungen an Prozesse, Daten und Systeme. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und zielgruppengerecht innerhalb des Unternehmens.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.

was uns wichtig ist

  • Stapelstein ist für dich kein Job - sondern eine Mission, hinter der du wirklich stehst.
  • Für dich ist ein respektvoller, empathischer Umgang keine Checkbox - sondern die Basis, auf der gute Zusammenarbeit entsteht.
  • Herausforderungen bremsen dich nicht - sie machen dich neugierig.
  • Du denkst kreativ und unternehmerisch - du findest Wege, wo andere Hindernisse sehen, und machst dich in deinen Rollen wirklich wirkungsvoll.
  • Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung und triffst Entscheidungen mit Überzeugung - ohne dass jemand fragen muss.
  • Du brauchst keine Struktur von außen - du schaffst sie dir selbst.
  • Du nutzt KI nicht, weil es alle tun - sondern weil du verstanden hast, dass es die Art, wie wir arbeiten, grundlegend verändert.

was wir bieten

  • Der Start ist jederzeit möglich.
  • Ein marktübliches, faires Gehaltspaket.
  • Remote-first - in Deutschland und zeitweise auch aus dem Ausland.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer gemeinsamen Kernzeit von 9-12 Uhr.
  • Überstunden werden vollständig durch Freizeitausgleich ausgeglichen.
  • Vollzeit bedeutet bei uns 36 Stunden pro Woche - für mehr Fokus und mehr Lebenszeit. Ergänzt wird das durch 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.
  • Monatliche Team-Meet-ups in Stuttgart oder Berlin. Zeit, um gemeinsam im selben Raum zu arbeiten, Projekte voranzubringen und sich persönlich auszutauschen.
  • Zwei inspirierende Offsites pro Jahr, weil echtes Teamgefühl trotz Remote-first seinen Raum braucht.
  • Flexible Benefits wie Einkaufsbudget, Mobilitätszuschuss oder Urban Sports - nach bestandener Probezeit.

Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.

• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.

Measures of Success

• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
