jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description:

GuidePoint Security is seeking an experienced Microsoft Security Engineer - Engagement Lead to oversee client relationships and drive successful delivery of cybersecurity consulting engagements. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise clients, ensuring projects are executed with precision, transparency, and measurable impact. The Engagement Lead will balance strategic oversight with hands on management, guiding cross functional teams, aligning solutions to client objectives and fostering long term partnerships.

This position is ideal for a professional who thrives in a boutique consulting environment, where agility, personalized service, and trusted advisory are central to delivering differentiated value.

About the Cloud Practice:

The Cloud Practice is responsible for providing advisory services as well as secure implementations specific to security tooling with the intent of protecting the customers' identities, endpoints, data, applications, and cloud infrastructure by designing, deploying, and operationalizing Cloud Solution Providers native security solutions. We focus specifically on ensuring cloud security, data security, identity and access management, as well as threat protection has been implemented following best practices across the organization.

Our team of Microsoft specialists focus on deploying Microsoft security, compliance, and identity solutions to protect identities, devices, data, apps, and infrastructure. We partner with other Cloud Solution Provider teams as well as internal resources to ensure the overall goals of the clients are achieved and align with industry standards and best practices.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Technical Oversight and Delivery: Oversee and coach technical delivery teams, ensuring quality, consistency, and alignment with client objectives.
  • Client Management: Build and maintain executive-level relationships, translating technical outcomes into business value.
  • Escalation Management: Experienced in managing and resolving escalations, balancing client satisfaction with project scope and delivery realities.
  • Account Executive Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives to identify growth opportunities, shape proposals, and support pre-sales activities.
  • Leadership and Communication: Utilize strong written and verbal communication skills when presenting to executives, leading workshops, and mentoring technical teams.
  • Architectural Leadership: Lead the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of practice services.
  • Pre-Sales and Delivery Support: Contribute to the creation of Statements of Work (SOWs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and pre-sales solution design in partnership with Account Executives and delivery teams.
  • Modern Workplace Strategy: Define and implement strategies for secure, efficient, and user-friendly adoption of services across enterprise environments.
  • Security and Compliance: Establish and enforce enterprise-wide security and compliance frameworks, including data protection, insider risk management, and data loss prevention (DLP).
  • Zero Trust Enablement: Apply Zero Trust principles across cloud and hybrid environments, leveraging identity, access, and threat protection controls such as MFA, conditional access, and continuous verification.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure teams to align cloud security architectures with regulatory, operational, and business requirements.
  • Integration Expertise: Design and implement integrations between cloud platforms, SaaS applications, security tools, and endpoint management solutions to ensure cohesive protection.
  • Automation and Optimization: Develop automation scripts, workflows, and orchestration processes to streamline administration, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Technical Mentorship: Provide leadership, mentoring, and oversight to engineers and delivery teams, fostering knowledge transfer and consistent execution across regions.
  • Resiliency and Monitoring: Establish high-availability, disaster recovery, and monitoring strategies to ensure resilient and continuously protected cloud services.
  • Governance and Adoption: Define governance models, lifecycle policies, and adoption frameworks to maximize business value and ensure sustainable security practices.
  • Thought Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert for cloud security initiatives, migrations, and transformations, contributing to client roadmaps, executive briefings, and industry discussions.

Required Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and:
    • 2 years of experience with Azure security suite capabilities, such as Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, WAF, APIM, Secure Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and related governance tools.
    • 2 years of experience with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security integration, including Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Governance, and cross-platform compliance alignment.
  • Proven track record leading enterprise-scale Azure deployments, migrations, and modernization projects across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS workloads.
  • Deep knowledge of Azure services, including Entra ID, Virtual Networks, Storage, Compute, App Services, and Kubernetes (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of Azure security and compliance capabilities, such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Key Vault, RBAC, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and scripting, including PowerShell, KQL, ARM/Bicep, Terraform, and Microsoft Graph API.
  • Solid understanding of cloud computing concepts, including multi-cloud and hybrid architectures, virtualization, containers, infrastructure security, data security, encryption, management plane, business continuity, and identity entitlement/access management.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender suite and Microsoft Sentinel, with experience designing and operationalizing SIEM/SOAR solutions for Azure environments.
  • Experience with lifecycle management of Azure resources, including provisioning, governance, cost optimization, and decommissioning.
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education:

  • Microsoft Certified: Microsoft 365 Certified Enterprise Administrator Expert, Security Administrator Associate, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • 10+ years of IT experience with at least 6+ years focused on Microsoft Azure architecture, administration, and security.

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 10% travel

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

jobs.description:
About your tasks

  • Shape the future of our enterprise hybrid cloud network by designing highly available Azure networking solutions that support business-critical services across Azure, GCP and on-premises environments. ExpressRoute, Virtual WAN, BGP, Azure Firewall and Private Link are all part of your core expertise.
  • Observability: Design next-level monitoring solutions using KQL, Azure Workbooks, Alerts and Azure Connection Monitor to proactively detect anomalies, monitor ExpressRoute connectivity and identify business-critical issues before they become incidents.
  • Modernize our network security architecture by analyzing and challenging existing designs, implementing Azure Firewall Premium capabilities, refining our Network Security Group strategy, enhancing micro segmentation, evolving our environment towards enterprise standards, improving scalability and reducing operational costs.
  • Drive the future of infrastructure automation by establishing Infrastructure as Prompt as a strategic capability within our platform. We want to explore how AI-driven infrastructure management can complement traditional Infrastructure as Code approaches, helping us shape the next generation of cloud operations while continuously improving automation, quality and delivery speed.
  • Your critical mission: Design and establish governance guardrails for our Azure networking platform that can evolve into Azure Policies, Blueprints and enterprise governance standards. Develop innovative concepts that enable decentralized network management without compromising security.
  • Strengthen our cyber resilience by developing disaster recovery strategies, challenging existing backup concepts, designing automated failover testing and recovery simulations, and ensuring our Azure network platform can be restored quickly and reliably after major incidents.
  • Build an intelligent security platform by integrating Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender and advanced network telemetry to automatically detect, investigate and respond to cyber threats before they impact the business. You’ll continuously enhance our security posture by leveraging automation and proactive response capabilities.
  • Collaborate across infrastructure, cloud and security teams, sharing networking expertise, supporting cross-team troubleshooting, optimizing connectivity and routing between Azure, GCP and on-premises environments, and working closely with teams operating Sophos-based network infrastructure. You’ll translate complex technical concepts into clear architectural recommendations and decision papers that support strategic decision-making.
  • Explore future network security technologies, including Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) with Microsoft Entra Private Access and Global Secure Access, helping us continuously evolve our enterprise connectivity strategy.

About you

  • You have deep expertise in Azure networking, including Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute, Virtual WAN, BGP, Private Link and enterprise Hub & Spoke architectures.
  • You have experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, KQL, Azure Monitor and cloud observability, enabling you to build intelligent monitoring, automate threat detection and proactively respond to security incidents.
  • You enjoy challenging existing architectures and are passionate about emerging new technologies such as Infrastructure as Prompt, AI-assisted infrastructure management and intelligent network automation. You thrive on evaluating innovative approaches that push enterprise networking beyond today’s standards.
  • Experience with Google Cloud networking, Sophos Firewall or enterprise on-premises networking is desired.
  • You have a passion for learning new technologies, sharing knowledge, simplifying complex networking topics for different audiences, and helping other engineering teams build secure and scalable solutions.

If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.

Working in a Microsoft-first cloud environment, you’ll combine architecture, automation, observability and cybersecurity to develop innovative networking solutions that empower engineering teams while protecting our enterprise platform. jobs.excerpt: Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you?
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

Principal Architect - Data Platforms & Architecture (SME)

The Principal Architect in Delivery leads architecture for large Azure programs that span applications,
platforms, and data. You connect business goals to cloud modernization roadmaps, define architecture
frameworks, and guide multi-team execution.

At this level, you act as an organization-wide technical leader. You set technical direction across practices,
orchestrate cross-team discovery, keep designs aligned across multiple teams, and turn successful patterns
into reusable models. You promote strong engineering, automation, and AI-assisted practices, mentor Senior Architects and Delivery Architects, and help build an inclusive, continuously improving engineering culture while supporting clear investment and modernization decisions for 3Cloud and our clients.

Responsibilities:

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership
• Lead architecture and technical strategy for large Azure programs and portfolios so solutions meet client goals for value, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
• Define modernization blueprints and reference architectures across applications, platforms, and data, including system and subsystem designs, patterns, and standards that simplify delivery and operations over time.
• Translate business and product strategy into cloud architecture roadmaps and execution plans that drive measurable outcomes and adapt based on production feedback and telemetry.
• Guide major architecture decisions across programs, promote shared design standards and reusable models, and resolve high-impact technical trade-offs.
• Work across teams to connect solutions into cohesive end-to-end architectures with clear ownership boundaries and integration contracts.
• Provide architectural oversight during delivery through design reviews, forums, and governance, keeping cross-cutting concerns (security, performance, resilience, availability, compliance, observability, and cost) aligned across teams.
• Promote modular design, clear boundaries, testability, CI/CD, and observability so non-functional requirements are treated as first-class and systems remain reliable and maintainable.
• Use AI tools to accelerate discovery, design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and scale successful practices so teams adopt them consistently.
• Own architectural standards for lakehouse, streaming, and AI-enabled data platforms.
• Guide large-scale Databricks implementations, including multi-region deployments.
• Expert knowledge of Data Management, Business Intelligence and Analytics concepts including:

• Data Movement (ETL/ELT).

• Data Warehousing (Designing and Implementing, Azure SQL, Synapse).
• Azure Storage Technologies (Data Lake, Blob Storage).
• Data Governance (including Data Quality and Profiling, Master Data Management, and Metadata Management).
• Business Intelligence, including Reporting and Visualizations (Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and Scorecards).
• Predictive, Prescription, and Descriptive Analytics.
• Expert knowledge of Microsoft Azure technologies.
• Azure DevOps (including building Stories and tasks, and using development pipelines and ARM templates for publishing code).


Delivery and Consulting Excellence:

• Lead or co-lead executive and senior stakeholder conversations on cloud modernization, platform strategy, AI adoption, and program roadmaps.
• Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, and shape delivery plans that balance value, cost, speed, and long-term system health.
• Set discovery strategy so program objectives flow into a clear, traceable backlog tied to architecture and business outcomes.
• Explain complex architecture and modernization strategies in clear language for executives, business leaders, and technical teams, including options, trade-offs, and recommendations.
• Build trusted relationships with technology and business leaders, influencing priorities and investment decisions in ways that help mature their engineering and architecture practices.
• Run structured decision-making forums (such as architecture reviews or steering committees) that produce clear decisions, documented rationale, and actionable next steps.
• Define architecture, discovery, and delivery frameworks and working agreements that support predictable, incremental delivery across multiple teams and time zones, including cadences, artifacts, escalation paths, and hybrid delivery guidelines.
• Align teams on shared outcomes, APIs, integration contracts, and operating models, ensuring crossteam dependencies are identified early, owned, and tracked through to completion.
• Support effective use of Agile methods at program scale so architecture, backlogs, and release plans support meaningful increments, stable team velocity, low defect escape, clear definitions of done, and course corrections based on telemetry and feedback.
• Track risks, technical debt, quality trends, and architectural drift across teams, and recommend adjustments that keep programs on track while balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term system health.
• Support cross-practice opportunity qualification and estimating using playbooks, benchmarks, and templates so the organization focuses on high-fit pursuits and improves proposal quality and confidence in value, risk, and margin.


Mentorship and Team Development:


• Mentor Senior Architects, Delivery Architects, and senior engineers, helping them grow systems thinking, architectural judgment, cross-team awareness, and their ability to lead multi-team initiatives.
• Provide architectural oversight across programs, modeling pragmatic decision-making, including when to keep solutions simple, when to standardize, when to extend patterns, and when to introduce new technologies.
• Help shape career paths and development plans for architects by clarifying expectations for operating at program scale and providing concrete examples of what “good” looks like.
• Create and maintain high-leverage learning assets—such as reference implementations, architecture decision records, playbooks, and mentoring guides—that accelerate onboarding and skill growth.
• Support hiring, calibration, and talent development by defining interview standards, participating in senior-level interviews and promotion reviews, and training others to apply those standards consistently.
• Set a high bar for executive-ready communication and storytelling, and coach others so their narratives support clear decisions and strengthen client trust.
• Help build a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement within and across teams, and support new ways of working that endure beyond a single project.


Growth and Innovation:


• Grow the company by identifying opportunities within your accounts across all our capabilities and pursuing them with the support of the account team.
• Intentionally build executive relationships within accounts to expand our partnership and create opportunities to provide strategic value.
• Drive sales opportunities by participating in pursuit teams as either the Pursuit Lead or Technical Solution Lead.
• Partner with sales, account, and practice leaders to shape technical strategy for strategic pursuits, projects and/or programs.
• Lead the creation of solution options, program-level architectures, and estimates, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and explaining how proposed approaches drive business value and reduce risk.
• Operate as a senior technical advisor whose guidance shapes multi-track initiatives and supports long-term account growth.
• Identify follow-on and adjacent opportunities—such as platform extensions, additional modernization waves, AI-enabled capabilities, or data estate modernization—that align with client strategies and 3Cloud’s strengths.
• Define and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, modernization playbooks, landing zone templates, workshops, accelerators, and starter repositories—that become standard patterns for delivery teams and reduce cycle time and rework while honoring architectural and nonfunctional requirements.
• Champion adoption of modern frameworks, cloud platform capabilities, automation practices, and AIassisted tools in a responsible and secure way, using pilots and experiments with clear success criteria to turn innovation into stable, repeatable practice.
• Contribute to internal cross-practice initiatives that share patterns and lessons from large programs and reinforce our credibility with clients and partners.
• Shape enablement programs that grow capabilities and reusable assets across accounts and package applied innovation into offerings and assets used in delivery and pursuits.

Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Analytics, or related field.
• 12+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary domain such as application development, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, or data and analytics, including significant work at enterprise scale.
• 7+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts at program scale.
• 10+ years of experience in analytics, data platforms, or enterprise architecture.
• Advanced SQL, PySpark and strong understanding of distributed data processing systems.
• of business process design and optimization, especially related to data and technology.
• Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based modernization, transformation, AI, or platform programs at enterprise scale.
• Experience defining solution and platform architectures that connect business strategy with scalable technical design, strong delivery practices, and measurable outcomes.
• Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and working with multiple stakeholders across time zones while maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery.
• Deep understanding of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in a primary domain, with the ability to apply them at system and program scale.
• Experience designing and integrating quality, automation, and observability practices at scale, including automated testing strategies and embedding quality checks into delivery workflows.
• Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI and machine learning capabilities into solutions (for example, using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services and tools for code, test, and documentation acceleration).
• Significant experience working in Agile or Scrum environments at scale, including backlog structuring, dependency management, integration planning, and release management.
• Proven success in consulting or professional services, including client-facing leadership and executive engagement.
• Familiarity with key Azure services used in modern solutions that are relevant to your domain (for example, messaging, compute, data, security, networking, management, and integration services).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
• Commitment to continuous learning in cloud, data, and AI, with the ability to turn that learning into practical improvements for teams and clients.
• Ability to foster culture, inclusion, and community participation across the organization in ways that support rapid cross-team collaboration.
• Relevant cloud architecture certifications (for example, Azure-focused architect certifications or comparable role-based certifications) are strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:


• Generative AI & Agentic Systems – applying RAG, prompt engineering, and orchestration with frameworks like Prompt Flow, Semantic Kernel, and AutoGen.
• MLOps & Model Lifecycle – CI/CD pipelines, deployment, monitoring, retraining, model governance, and compliance.

We’re looking for highly experienced Software Engineers to join the Ecommerce Portal team and help shape the future of e-commerce in the mining and construction industry.

This is a great opportunity to join a start-up-minded initiative within a large, successful organization, working on cutting-edge solutions across the entire e-commerce journey from machine events and product recommendations to checkout and order tracking.

Tasks

  • Build and continuously improve e-commerce solutions from sales triggers and product recommendations through to checkout and order tracking.

  • Develop end-to-end web solutions within an Azure environment.

  • Work as part of an Agile full-stack development team, translating requirements into scalable solutions.

  • Leverage Azure services and Agentic AI to enhance user experiences and automate processes.

  • Contribute to the digital transformation of a leading organization in the mining and construction industry.

Requirements

Non-negotiable:

  • 8+ years of .NET development, with strong web development experience
  • 8+ years hands-on experience with Azure App Services, including deployment, configuration and management
  • Strong understanding of how to build, deploy and manage web solutions in Azure

jobs.description:
We are looking for an DevOps Azure Cloud Engineer to join a strategic cloud transformation initiative focused on evolving an existing Azure Landing Zone into a secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready cloud platform.

You will play a key role in strengthening governance, security, networking, and operational processes while supporting the adoption of Azure services across the organization. The project is delivered in collaboration with a Microsoft partner and includes a strong focus on hybrid cloud environments integrating Azure with on-premises infrastructure.

Your Responsibilities

  • Maintain and enhance the Azure Landing Zone environment.
  • Support Azure Landing Zone hardening initiatives, focusing on security, compliance, and operational resilience.
  • Design and implement Azure platform services aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework best practices.
  • Manage and optimize Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke architectures.
  • Improve cloud operations, monitoring, incident management, and support processes.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external Microsoft partners.
  • Share Azure knowledge and contribute to the growth of cloud capabilities within the organization.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones and cloud governance.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure Networking (VNet, Hub-and-Spoke, VPN, ExpressRoute, Private Endpoints).
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), RBAC, and Azure security.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).
  • Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Background in supporting production environments, incident management, and troubleshooting.
  • Interest in hybrid cloud architectures (Azure + on-premises infrastructure).
  • Polish and English proficiency sufficient for working in an international environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with enterprise-scale Azure environments.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes platforms.
  • Experience with cloud migration and platform modernization initiatives.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call support.

jobs.excerpt: DVT is a leading technology consulting and software engineering company delivering innovative solutions across Africa and internationally.
jobs.description:
DVT is a leading technology consulting and software engineering company delivering innovative solutions across Africa and internationally. We partner with clients to solve complex business challenges through software engineering, cloud platforms, data, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation. Our teams combine deep technical expertise with a strong consulting mindset to create measurable business value.

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Fabric Cloud Platform Engineer to help clients establish, automate, and operationalise Microsoft Fabric environments using cloud engineering best practices.

This role is ideal for a cloud platform engineer who enjoys building secure, scalable foundations for data and analytics teams. You will work closely with cloud, security, architecture, and data engineering teams to design and implement Microsoft Fabric platforms that are reliable, governed, and ready for enterprise adoption.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Microsoft Fabric platform foundations, including capacities, workspaces, OneLake, environment structures, and platform configuration.

  • Establish and manage DEV, TEST, and PROD environments and deployment strategies.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and other automation technologies.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

  • Implement security, identity, and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID and RBAC.

  • Integrate Microsoft Fabric with Azure services and broader cloud platforms.

  • Develop reusable automation and deployment patterns to ensure consistency and scalability.

  • Support monitoring, logging, operational readiness, and platform governance.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to enable workloads and remove platform barriers.

  • Produce technical documentation, standards, and operational runbooks.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on Fabric platform architecture and engineering practices.

Essential Experience & Qualifications Required

  • 5+ years of Azure Cloud Engineering experience.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Azure certifications would be advantageous.

  • Terraform, DevOps, or cloud platform certifications are beneficial.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and its core platform components.

  • Experience implementing Fabric capacities, workspaces, and OneLake.

  • Strong Terraform and Infrastructure as Code experience.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience implementing Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, and cloud security controls.

  • Experience designing and managing Fabric environments across DEV, TEST, and PROD.

  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, governance, and operational best practices.

  • Experience automating cloud platforms using PowerShell and/or Python.

  • Experience working within enterprise cloud environments.

  • Good understanding of data platform concepts and how data workloads consume cloud infrastructure.

Advantageous Experience

  • Experience establishing a Microsoft Fabric platform from the ground up.

  • Experience with Fabric REST APIs and platform automation.

  • Experience integrating Fabric with Azure services.

  • Understanding of data ingestion workloads and notebook-based solutions within Fabric.

  • Experience working in regulated or governed cloud environments.

  • Exposure to FinOps and cloud cost optimisation practices.

  • Experience collaborating across Cloud Engineering, Data Engineering, Security, and Architecture teams.

Important to Know

This is a Cloud Platform Engineering role, not a Data Engineering role. The primary focus is establishing, automating, securing, and operating the Microsoft Fabric platform rather than building data pipelines, analytics models, or reporting solutions.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleBlueAlly is hiring a Senior Consultant to design, implement, and migrate Microsoft cloud infrastructure for clients across state and local government, education, healthcare, utilities and cooperatives, nonprofits, and midmarket enterprise.
jobs.description:
About the Role

BlueAlly is hiring a Senior Consultant to design, implement, and migrate Microsoft cloud infrastructure for clients across state and local government, education, healthcare, utilities and cooperatives, nonprofits, and midmarket enterprise.

This role spans Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, and Azure infrastructure. You will deliver across concurrent client engagements, contribute technical input to solution scoping and estimation, and act as a trusted technical point of contact for client stakeholders from IT administrators through executive sponsors.

We are looking for someone who can operate with incomplete information, make defensible assumptions, document them, and keep an engagement moving.

Responsibilities

Solution Design and Delivery

  • Assess client environments and requirements, and design solutions that meet stated business and technical objectives.
  • Lead or participate in Microsoft tenant migrations: tenant-to-tenant, on-premises to cloud, hybrid coexistence, and third-party platform sources.
  • Configure and remediate Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management, self-service password reset with password writeback, B2B and B2C, cross-tenant synchronization, hybrid identity, and ADFS-to-SAML modernization.
  • Deploy passwordless authentication, including Windows Hello for Business using cloud Kerberos trust and FIDO2 security keys.
  • Deploy and modernize endpoint management: Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Configuration Manager coexistence and transition, compliance policies, configuration profiles, update rings, application packaging, and OneDrive Known Folder Move.
  • Implement Microsoft Purview data protection: sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, retention and records management, and eDiscovery.
  • Deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, and Defender for Identity, including migration from third-party EDR platforms.
  • Manage and troubleshoot escalated issues across identity, data protection, and device management.

Azure Infrastructure

  • Perform Azure Migrate assessments and execute server and workload migrations, including wave planning, cutover scheduling, and application-owner validation.
  • Design and implement Azure networking, including VPN Gateway, Application Gateway and WAF, Bastion, and Front Door.
  • Implement Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery to meet client recovery objectives.
  • Size and deploy Azure compute and storage, including Azure Files and storage account configuration.
  • Deliver Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 proofs of value and production deployments.

Documentation and Enablement

  • Produce design documents, as-built documentation, runbooks, and migration plans.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer sessions and administrator training at project closeout.
  • Track time accurately against estimated hours and communicate variance early.
  • Stay current on Microsoft platform changes and share practice-level best practices internally.

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years delivering Microsoft cloud infrastructure in a consulting, managed services provider, or enterprise engineering capacity.
  • Demonstrated ownership of at least three end-to-end Microsoft 365 or Azure migration projects, including planning, execution, and cutover.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 workloads, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Microsoft Teams.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management.
  • Working knowledge of Azure IaaS: virtual machine sizing, storage, core networking, and backup.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Purview data protection and the Microsoft Defender suite.
  • PowerShell and Microsoft Graph proficiency for automation, reporting, and bulk operations.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent client engagements and shifting priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to lead a client-facing technical discussion independently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure Virtual Desktop or Windows 365 deployment experience.
  • Hypervisor migration experience, such as VMware to Hyper-V or VMware to Azure.
  • Third-party migration tooling: AvePoint Fly, Quest, BitTitan, or ShareGate.
  • macOS, iOS, and Android management.
  • Delivery experience in regulated or public-sector environments: HIPAA, CJIS, FERPA, SOC 2, or NERC CIP.
  • Microsoft Sentinel exposure.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and AI governance concepts.

Certifications

Preferred, not required. Candidates without current certifications who demonstrate equivalent hands-on depth will be considered, and BlueAlly supports certification attainment after hire.

  • SC-300: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  • MD-102: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
  • MS-102: Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert
  • AZ-104: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
  • SC-400: Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
  • AZ-305: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions ‘. tect Expert
  • AZ-140: Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty

Work Conditions

  • Remote-first, United States based. Preference for candidates in the Eastern or Central time zone.
  • Periodic evening and weekend work is required to support migration cutovers and client maintenance windows.
  • Target billable utilization of 80%.

About BlueAlly
BlueAlly is a leading provider of IT services and solutions, helping organizations conquer IT complexity across cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data, and application modernization. Headquartered in Atlanta,Georgia, with delivery teams across the United States and globally, BlueAlly serves clients ranging from mid-market enterprises to large public-sector and commercial organizations.

Founded in 2011, BlueAlly delivers across the full technology lifecycle — from strategy and design through implementation, managed services, and continuous optimization. The company is recognized on CRN's Tech Elite 150 and MSP 500 lists and partners deeply with leading technology vendors. As enterprise AI moves from pilot to production, BlueAlly is investing in the people, platforms, and practices required to deliver AI Factory outcomes for our clients — and this role is at the center of that investment.

BlueAlly does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

BlueAlly provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact our People team.

From cloud to cybersecurity, infrastructure to application modernization, we thrive on cutting-edge technologies and services. Turn complex decisions into clear opportunities with a trusted guide to technology that ensures the next digital advance will be your decisive advantage. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Azure Cloud Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $95,000–$125,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer to design, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. In this role you will own the end-to-end cloud engineering lifecycle, including architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security hardening, cost optimization, observability, and ongoing operational excellence for production workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across Azure services with strong DevOps engineering practices, and will partner closely with application development, security, and SRE teams to deliver cloud-native solutions that meet demanding business requirements for scalability, reliability, and compliance.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on Microsoft Azure in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure core services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform-as-a-service offerings.
  • Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD across infrastructure and applications.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation code.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies across distributed workloads.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification.
  • Experience operating hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd on AKS.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost-management tooling.
  • Experience with regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.

jobs.excerpt: About The Bridgespan GroupThe Bridgespan Group (“Bridgespan”) is a global nonprofit that aims to build a better world by strengthening the ability of mission-driven organizations, philanthropists, impact investors, and corporations to achieve breakthrough results in addressing society’s most important challenges and opportunities.
jobs.description:
About The Bridgespan Group

The Bridgespan Group (“Bridgespan”) is a global nonprofit that aims to build a better world by strengthening the ability of mission-driven organizations, philanthropists, impact investors, and corporations to achieve breakthrough results in addressing society’s most important challenges and opportunities.

Founded in 2000, Bridgespan has offices in Boston, Johannesburg, Mumbai, New York, San Francisco, and Singapore. Across these six locations, we have a diverse team of staff with varied backgrounds and experience across multiple sectors. We work with social change organizations such as TaRL Africa, Tiko, and CAMFED; philanthropies and foundations such as OSF, Women First Fund, and The Ford Foundation; impact investors such as TPG’s Rise Fund, Black Ambition, and AfricInvest; and bold funding collaboratives such as TED’s Audacious Project and Co-Impact.

Bridgespan aims for a world where all people have the opportunity to flourish. Given how society works today—as manifest in systems and mindsets that have developed over time—that opportunity is not accessible to all. We are committed to equity, specifically to doing work to help ensure that race, gender, and other dimensions of identity are not determinants of life outcomes and to building an organization where the diverse set of individuals we need can thrive in pursuit of their full professional potential, and to proactively addressing the systems that help or hinder these goals. It is a commitment to both external equity work and internal inclusivity that gets Bridgespan closer to achieving its mission.

Position

The Cloud Systems Engineer role is a cloud-first, execution-focused position responsible for administering, configuring, and operating modern IT infrastructure with a primary emphasis on Microsoft Azure and identity services within Microsoft Entra ID.

The role also contributes to cloud engineering and architecture initiatives, infrastructure automation, cloud governance, scalability planning, and modernization. The ideal candidate combines strong operational expertise with hands-on cloud engineering and automation experience.

Part of the IT Infrastructure team, this position ensures cloud and identity platforms are reliable, secure, and aligned with established architectural direction.

Objectives of the Role

  • Ensure reliability, performance, and security of identity systems using Microsoft Entra ID and integrated SaaS platforms.

  • Partner with IT leadership to implement and operationalize cloud and identity solutions.

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates to standardize and automate repeatable, scalable cloud infrastructure deployments.

  • Implements and maintains Azure governance including Azure Policy, RBAC standards, tagging, resource organization, and cost optimization.

  • Contribute significantly to cloud modernization and automation initiatives that improve scalability, resiliency, and operational efficiency.

  • Enhance monitoring, alerting, and observability to proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues, minimizing downtime and user impact.

  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Action.

  • Support containerized workloads and cloud-native platforms including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Docker-based deployments.

  • Support and mentor junior team members while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, Conditional Access policies, MFA, and identity lifecycle processes.

  • Administer and support Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, storage accounts, networking, and platform services.

  • Manage Windows Server environments hosted in Azure virtual machines, including Active Directory domain controllers, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.

  • Implement and support identity integrations for enterprise and SaaS applications using SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.

  • Support file storage solutions including Azure Files, SharePoint Online, and VM-based file services, ensuring appropriate access controls and data protection.

  • Monitor system performance and availability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related tools; respond to and resolve incidents within defined service levels.

  • Execute system updates, patching, vulnerability remediation, and configuration changes across cloud and identity platforms.

  • Support engineering and development teams by provisioning resources, managing access, and troubleshooting infrastructure and identity issues.

  • Manage and resolve infrastructure and identity-related tickets through the service management system, ensuring accurate documentation and timely resolution.

  • Track and contribute to project work, including executing assigned tasks, updating progress, and identifying risks or blockers.

  • Collaborate with security teams on compliance, risk management, and implementation of security best practices aligned with Zero Trust principles.

  • Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and procedures to ensure consistency and knowledge sharing.

  • Participate in change management processes including planning, testing, and documenting changes in alignment with ITIL practices.

  • Provide escalation support for complex technical issues and participate in on-call support as needed.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

  • 5–8+ years of experience in systems administration, with strong experience in Microsoft Azure cloud environments.

  • Azure certifications: AZ-104 (required), AZ-305 (preferred) and/or identity certifications SC-300 (preferred).

  • Hands-on experience managing Windows Server workloads including Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, and file services in cloud-hosted environments.

  • Strong experience administering Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, and identity governance concepts.

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Teams.

  • Proficiency with PowerShell and/or Azure CLI for automation and administration.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, Windows systems, and identity platforms.

  • Understanding of authentication and identity protocols including SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.

  • Experience working within ticketing systems and tracking operational and project-based work.

  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and support both operational and project-based initiatives.

  • Ability to work independently and remain flexible in a changing environment.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail.

PLEASE NOTE: YOU MUST BE ELIGIBLE TO WORK IN THE US WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP, THE BRIDGESPAN GROUP IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

At Bridgespan, we are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion because we are passionate about helping our clients achieve breakthrough results. An organization that reflects the diversity of our clients and their beneficiaries will produce deeper relationships, engagement, and insights. Bridgespan is committed to providing equal opportunities. We serve diverse organizations and are committed to non-discrimination. Bridgespan will not discriminate against any employee with respect to any term or condition of employment, including but not limited to less favorable treatment, exclusion from employment or employment opportunities (including hiring, assignment, performance assessment and promotion) on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, gender (including pregnancy), gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, expression, veteran’s status or other protected characteristics or status. We actively partner with organizations representing minority concerns and interests to build high-performing teams that mirror the communities we serve.

All company sponsored programs including training, job, social and recreational activities are required to be nondiscriminatory and all human resource practices are monitored to ensure equal opportunity.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than €4 million and most recently closed a €2.9 million seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and leading angels. Pandektes already serves more than 350 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

You'll have real room to shape both what we build and how we build it. You'll work across our most ambitious surfaces: the document viewer where lawyers read and annotate legislation and case law, the AI chat that walks them through complex legal reasoning, and the search and navigation layer that ties it all together.

This is a role for someone who cares about craft. We move fast, but we don't ship sloppy. You'll partner closely with design, product, and our backend and ML teams to take features from rough idea to polished production experience, and you'll have meaningful influence on the technical direction of the frontend as the team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end implementation of frontend features in our React, Next.js, and TypeScript codebase, from architecture decisions to shipping polished UI

  • Partner with design and product to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features that legal professionals actually love using

  • Raise the bar for quality across the team through code review, technical direction, and shared standards

What you’ll bring

About Utorg

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure for stablecoin payments: on- and off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Over 2 million users across 130+ countries already buy, hold, and spend crypto through our app. On the B2B side, the same rails power 2,100+ platforms, with $2.4B+ moved to date.

Fully MiCA-authorized across the EEA. PCI DSS Level 2 certified. Backed by Dragonfly, TA Ventures, and Hypra.

Location: Remote

Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, NATS JetStream, Redis, Jest, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform.

Blockchains: EVM-compatible, Bitcoin-family, Tron, Solana, TON.

What you’ll do:
  • Own backend architecture across two large-scale microservice platforms (30+ and 25+ services) — from system design and API contracts to data flow and inter-service communication.
  • Lead complex integrations — payment providers, card issuers, blockchain networks, third-party APIs — and take full responsibility for their reliability in production.
  • Drive performance and scalability — identify bottlenecks, design caching strategies, optimize database queries, and ensure the platform handles growing load.
  • Shape technical direction — make architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and influence the team’s engineering standards. You’ll partially offload the Tech Lead so the team can scale.
  • Build and improve AI-powered processes — our team actively uses LLM-based systems to automate operational and development workflows. You’ll contribute to and extend this direction.
  • Contribute to back-office frontends (~20% of your time) — maintain and extend React-based admin dashboards used by internal teams.
  • Own features end-to-end — from planning and architectural design to implementation, testing, production monitoring, and iterative improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and cross-functional teams — produce clear technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge.
  • Take part in a shared on-call rotation — roughly one week a month.
Who you are:
  • Technically strong with an architectural mindset — you don’t just write code, you design systems. You think about data flows, failure modes, and long-term maintainability before writing the first line.
  • Opinionated and able to defend your decisions — you bring an expert perspective to technical discussions and can articulate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver — you find issues before they become incidents and propose solutions without waiting to be asked.
  • Product-driven — most of your time goes into shipping features and solving real user problems, not open-ended refactoring.
  • Self-motivated and responsible — you thrive in small teams, enjoy autonomy, and take full ownership of the development process.
What you will bring:
  • 5+ years of production experience in backend development with Type Script/Node.js as the primary stack.
  • 2+ years with NestJS in production — modules, providers, middleware, guards, interceptors, microservice architecture with custom transports.
  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise — schema design, indexing (partial, GIN/GiST), query optimization, migrations with zero-downtime, database-per-service pattern.
  • Hands-on microservices experience — not a monolith split into modules. You’ve dealt with inter-service communication (RPC + pub/sub), message brokers, idempotency, eventual consistency, saga/outbox patterns.
  • System design experience — decomposing services, designing API contracts, data flow architecture, capacity planning. You can whiteboard a system and explain why you made each decision.
  • Complex integration experience — you’ve built and maintained integrations with third-party APIs, payment systems, or similar external services in production. You know how to handle retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  • Performance engineering— profiling, caching strategies, load analysis, bottleneck identification. You can optimize a slow query and a slow service alike.
  • Production blockchain experience (MUST-HAVE) — you’ve worked with on-chain transactions, multiple networks, and real user funds. You understand HD wallets (BIP32/BIP39), smart contracts, ABI, ERC-20/SPL tokens, and the differences between account-based and UTXO models. Experience with libraries like ethers.js, viem, and solana/web3.js.
  • AI-driven development (MUST-HAVE) — you actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your daily workflow. Beyond personal productivity, you have experience optimizing business or organizational processes with AI/LLMs—building automations, internal tools, or workflows powered by language models.
  • Strong testing discipline — unit tests (Jest), integration tests with real databases, microservice testing.
  • Security-conscious — in fintech and crypto, every code path can touch real user funds. You build accordingly.
  • Skilled in technical research — evaluating trade-offs, testing hypotheses, and making data-driven architectural decisions.
  • English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate. Fluent in the Russian language.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with NATS JetStream as a transport layer (streams, consumers, delivery policies).
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus + Grafana, structured logging (pino), distributed tracing.
  • Kubernetes beyond basics: Kustomize/Helm, deployment strategies, resource management.
  • Fintech domain knowledge: PCI DSS, GDPR, KYC/AML, payment systems.
  • Experience mentoring junior/middle developers.
  • React basics for back-office UIs (functional components, hooks, Redux, Material-UI).

Interaction with other teams:

Close collaboration with Product, QA, Frontend, and Mobile. Cross-functional communication is an essential part of the role. Partially offload the Tech Lead: own architectural and technical decisions, independently drive complex integrations, and influence the platform's technical direction. This is not an executor role. We need someone with strong expert opinions who can be relied upon for key technical decisions.

Key results (30-60-90):

30 days: First features shipped to production. Deep dive into the stack, architecture, and domain (blockchain, fintech). Clear understanding of core services and how they interact.

60 days: Independently drives a complex integration or a major feature. Participates in architectural code reviews. Brings first proposals for improvements.

90 days: Makes architectural decisions on their scope. Influences technical direction. Partially offloads the Tech Lead in decision-making. Participates in planning.

What we offer:
  • Work fully remote as part of an agile, international team reshaping the future of finance.
  • An engineering culture that encourages the adoption of modern tools and development practices, giving engineers real influence over technologies, workflows, and technical decisions.
  • Two career tracks — grow into Tech Lead or deepen your expertise as Staff/Principal IC. You choose the path.
  • Career progression and professional development in a forward-thinking fintech environment.
  • Competitive salary range based on individual performance review.
  • Transparent feedback and a culture that values ownership, open dialogue, and visible impact.
Recruitment Process

  2. Application Review. Our team reviews your experience and qualifications.

  4. Technical Interview. Assessment of your technical expertise, system design skills, and relevant experience.

At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
We are seeking an experienced AWS Principal Software Engineer to join our AWS practice Managed Service's team. This is a fully remote opportunity based in the Philippines.
TTEC is a global company that is 46,000+ employees strong. Together, we are transforming the world of customer experience by helping our clients design and deliver simpler, more effective, efficient, and human customer service experiences that inspire customer loyalty and boost company profits.
As a technical member of the Managed Services team, you will maintain the AWS Practice’s designed solution for our clients. Maintaining the production systems will involve identifying and addressing issues the client is experiencing, building, testing, and deploying those changes to the client's system. AWS Engineers will work to refine the process of delivering projects by building internal tools, suggesting new methods for designing and building systems, and providing feedback to clients on issues they are experiencing.
This is a permanent, fully remote position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be willing to work US business hours to support our global clients and operations.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Daily meetings with the internal team

  • Weekly meetings with clients and TTEC Digital client account managers

  • Requirements analysis and design conversations when you have a new enhancement to build.

  • Working on issues in Jira with your team - building systems, creating CloudFormation/Serverless templates to deploy resources, etc.

  • Learning best practices used in the NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python communities

  • Working with your mentor/team lead to further knowledge of AWS Services, tools, or even new languages to address client issues

  • Learning new ways of doing things and sharing new learnings with internal team members

  • You need to be ready to learn quickly!

What You Bring to the Role

  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture

  • 5+ years’ development experience with 3+ years of development experience with a focus on TypeScript/, working with AWS services

  • Functional knowledge of agile methodologies such as Scrum

  • The ideal candidate seeks to understand before prescribing a solution.

  • A love for technology and the latest and greatest in development best practices, especially the latest services from AWS

About Us

TTEC Digital and our 1,800+ employees, pioneer engagement and growth solutions that fuel the exceptional customer experience (CX). Our sister company, TTEC Engage, is a 60,000+ employee service company, with customer service representatives located around the world. TTEC Holdings Inc. is the parent company for both Digital and Engage. When clients have a holistic need, they can draw from these independently managed centers of excellence, TTEC Digital and TTEC Engage.
We are also delighted to share that TTEC has been awarded the Great Place To Work 2024-2025 certification based on outstanding employee experience across 14 countries.
TTEC is a proud equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability. TTEC has fully embraced and is committed to expanding our diverse and inclusive workforce. We strive to reflect the communities we serve while delivering amazing service and technology centered around humanity.
Rarely do applicants meet all desired job qualifications, so if you feel you would succeed in the role above, please take a moment and share your qualifications.

jobs.title: [8BE] DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Software Mind is seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to support one of our client's e-commerce replatforming initiative.
jobs.description:
Software Mind is seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to support one of our client's e-commerce replatforming initiative. The client is migrating its storefront and order-management capabilities from a legacy platform to a modern Shopify Hydrogen-based platform backed by a custom cloud-native microservices architecture. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and observability tooling that support a distributed delivery team.

In addition to a competitive salary rate and a positive work environment committed to delivering high-quality technology solutions, we also offer:

  • Flexible schedules and authentic work-life balance
  • Opportunities for continuing education
  • Social activities per country sponsored by the company
  • Birthday celebration
  • Payment in US Dollars

About the Role

You will be the DevOps owner for a distributed, multi-vendor delivery team — ensuring reliable, secure, and repeatable deployments across environments while collaborating closely with backend engineering, QA automation, and the client's internal IT team.

Main Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for a .NET-based microservices backend and Shopify Hydrogen storefront, enabling frequent, low-risk releases across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Provision and manage AWS infrastructure (compute, networking, messaging, secrets, and security services) using infrastructure-as-code.
  • Implement and maintain security controls including WAF/ALB configuration, secrets management, and key management.
  • Support configuration and operational maintenance of OAuth2/OIDC identity providers used for service-to-service and customer-facing authentication.
  • Stand up and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting across microservices and message-driven workflows.
  • Configure and support asynchronous messaging infrastructure (queues, topics, dead-letter handling) for order, inventory, and catalog processing between services.
  • Manage environment configuration, versioning, and release coordination across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Participate in troubleshooting production issues, define rollback and contingency procedures, and drive post-incident reviews.
  • Produce clear infrastructure and operational documentation, including runbooks.
  • Coordinate with backend engineering, QA automation, and the client's internal IT team on environment needs, deployment schedules, and infrastructure changes.

Requirements:

  • +90% English written and oral (B2 level minimum) — strong written and verbal communication is essential.
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps/infrastructure engineering experience, including production support for cloud-native applications.
  • Strong experience with AWS services (compute, networking, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, KMS, WAF, ALB).
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for containerized or microservices-based applications.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments and troubleshooting service-to-service communication issues.
  • Solid understanding of OAuth2/OIDC identity and access management concepts.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tooling in a distributed systems environment.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-vendor, distributed delivery environment across time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with e-commerce platform migrations (Shopify or similar SaaS commerce platforms).
  • Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL data stores in production environments.
  • Experience with Keycloak or similar identity providers.
  • Exposure to CQRS/event-driven architecture patterns.
  • Prior consulting or staff-augmentation experience in a multi-vendor delivery environment.

Required Skills/Experience:

  • AWS (SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, KMS, WAF, ALB), CI/CD pipelines, Terraform/CloudFormation
  • .NET/C# deployment support, OAuth2/OIDC, monitoring and observability
  • Strong documentation and cross-team communication skills

Critical Technology Proficiency: AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, Docker, .NET/C#, OAuth2/OIDC, SQS/SNS



We are accepting applications from LATAM countries.

We are Software Mind, an awesome team of engineers who are ready to ramp up any top-notch company’s projects! Our aim? To always be one step ahead. Become part of a multicultural company in constant growth with an excellent work environment certified by Great Place To Work!
